label: Prop. 11.12

label: Prop. 11.14

name: prop:quant-premise-necessary

label: Prop. 11.36
name: prop:quotient-factor-law
statement: Proves the pushforward, Shannon, and Hartley equalities through the observer kernel.

label: Prop. 12.3
name: prop:quotient-simulation
statement: Defines the quotient reduction system and the projection as a reduction morphism, proves transport of length-indexed paths and of reachability, and evaluates the two-state chain fixture.

label: Prop. 9.14
name: prop:rary-duplicator-laws
statement: Proves $r$-blind runtime and length, $\#b(t_i)=ri+1$, the closed form and envelopes of $\mathrm{Con}_r$, the live-orbit sums, action and partition identities, crossover bounds and minimality, dominance, unbounded inefficiency for $rw>0$, the storage law for carrier and projection, recovery of the binary laws at $r=1$, the scaled-weight identity with its correction term, and the $rm+1$ occurrence count.

label: Prop. 9.8
name: prop:record-emission-beyond
statement: Proves the two-occurrence conclusion for many-sorted families, depth separation for faithful externalized traces, the semantic-regime transfer under the coherence condition, and the unique regime classification.

label: Prop. 9.6
name: prop:record-emission-dynamic
statement: Defines the step rule closed under frames and the stage terms, proves the step between consecutive stages, frame emission and generator preservation at positive stages, the two distinct generator positions from the positional theorem, and inhabitation of the sequence for positive height.

label: Prop. 7.13
name: prop:recursor-license-instances
statement: Proves the licenses and collisions on the live stages, injectivity of the counter observer on one trace, the lossy execution license on all terms, the constant termination verdict of a well-founded relation, the loop characterization, and the equal-rank collision with opposite termination status.

label: Prop. 15.18
name: prop:reflection-family
statement: Classifies the dependency-pair confession as a reflection-family ascent, proves that the compiled G\"odel profile for $Q$ realizes the six-step shape and is compatible with the dependency-pair profile, and replaces the soundness assumption by Theorem 15.1 for finite systems with the variable condition.

label: Prop. 11.11
name: prop:reflective-pairs
statement: Defines the licensed step, proves well-foundedness of the lexicographic rank on budget and the Dershowitz and Manna multiset order, strict descent of every licensed step, well-foundedness of the licensed relation, the blocked identity and rank-tie transitions, the absence of cycles, and the instance.

label: Prop. 6.9
name: prop:retrieval-vs-resolution
statement: View accessibility implies initial recovery; initial recovery excludes sequential resolution; sequential resolution implies view inaccessibility.

label: Prop. 10.4
name: prop:role-split-law
statement: Proves the trichotomy, both characterizations of the role split, value blindness of value-factored maps, exogeneity of separators, surjectivity of the payload value projection, and the refuse, lift, and exogeneity facts on the frame and active occurrences of an arbitrary payload term.

label: Prop. 11.31
name: prop:shannon-uniqueness
statement: Proves the description-length identity, strict excess of the repeated-carrier envelope for cell weight at least two, index at least two, and glue overhead below the index, and the reversal at $i=0$.

label: Prop. 4.1
name: prop:side-channel-minimum
statement: Proves the embedding criterion for arbitrary sets, the finite alphabet and bit-width minima, the zero-symbol and one-symbol criteria, and a deterministic executable encoder and decoder at the optimum.

label: Prop. 8.7
name: prop:signature-hypothesis
statement: Proves distinctness of the pair, identification under every constant-third-argument fold, separation under the counter-height fold, failure of the constancy hypothesis for that algebra, and the conjunction of the two facts.

label: Prop. 10.6
name: prop:structural-identity-under-direct-measure
statement: Proves that the weighted mass profiles of the recursor execution and the same-start self-embedding orbit agree if and only if $c_G=2c_\delta$ for $k>0$, the factor-two calibration instance, and inequality at every positive index under unit costs.

label: Prop. 3.1
name: prop:target-kernel-quotient
statement: Proves that the target-kernel quotient licenses the target, that an observer licenses the target if and only if it refines the quotient, and uniqueness up to kernel; the lattice isomorphism places the quotient among all observers.

label: Prop. 7.17
name: prop:terminal-record-complete-quant
statement: On the sorted term model, proves the positive-depth terminal-record map injective in base, payload, and depth, that depth zero forgets the payload, that an unsorted base slot admits a depth and base collision, and the bound $K^2\beta\le 2 \mathrm{Con}(K,Y)$.

label: Prop. 11.13
name: prop:trace-action-law
statement: Proves $2A(k)=k(k+1)(w+1)+2(k+1)c$ and the limit $A(k)/\allowbreak{}k^2\to(w+1)/\allowbreak{}2$.

label: Prop. 7.3
name: prop:trace-law
statement: Defines the trace and proves the duplicating-step law with counter and payload coordinates; the step relation is functional, the trace steps enumerate the stages, the derivation length is unique, and the payload count at stage $i$ is $i+1$.

label: Prop. 11.37
name: prop:verdict-zero-entropy
statement: Proves the point-mass law, zero entropy, the recursor instance of the termination verdict, and the family instance, using the free recursor's termination theorem.

label: Prop. 10.7
name: prop:whole-term-indistinguishability
statement: Proves that observers factoring through the mass profile cannot separate the recursor execution from the self-embedding prefix under the factor-two calibration or from the two-cycle under unit costs, and that the counter projection decreases on the extracted call.

label: Prop. 11.4
name: prop:workload-semantics
statement: one-trace and repeated-prefix identities, strict positive-payload separation, and zero-payload boundary.

label: Prop. 11.10
name: prop:zero-deficit-stopping

label: Thm. 11.44
name: thm:accepted-set
statement: Proves that the strict checker accepts a bit list if and only if it is a padded encoding of the words of the constructed certificate, that every accepted list decodes to that certificate, that the standard serialization is the unique shortest accepted list, and the padded successor control.

label: Thm. 15.1
name: thm:ag-equivalence
statement: Proves the chain-step argument as a reduction followed by passage to a subterm, the well-foundedness from strong normalization, the sequence form, the finite computable reducts, the bounded-run equivalence, and the fresh-rule control: no dependency pair, no termination, and a reduct for every variable.

label: Thm. 15.5
name: thm:ag-rca
statement: Proves well-foundedness of the pair relation, the bounded-normalization and counter-bound equivalence, rank equal to the counter, and height $\omega$; the base derivation of $x<S(x)$; the derivations of zero-or-successor and predecessor descent from the base and one induction sentence, in every theory containing both; and the two underivability results.

label: Thm. 3.4
name: thm:aumann-agreement
statement: Proves the meet-cell characterization through the generated equivalence relation, the agreement theorem for signed fiber ratios by summing the assignments over the fibers inside the meet cell, and the two fixtures in which a zero mass or absent common knowledge defeats the conclusion.

label: Thm. 2.7
name: thm:beth-gap
statement: Proves the Padoa direction, the gap decomposition, the Beth property from completeness and closure, and the three fixtures separating soundness, completeness, and closure.

label: Thm. 11.43
name: thm:bit-machine
statement: Proves that on every bit list the machine run with fuel $3n+1$ halts with the parser's output, unread suffix, and inspection count, that reachable states consume the input left to right, the run on the constructed certificate followed by a suffix, and the zero-width and zero-payload controls.

label: Thm. 5.2
name: thm:blackwell-deterministic
statement: Proves that refinement implies risk domination, that domination for the target $q_2$ under two-point priors implies refinement, the equivalence, the garbling inequality for every finite rational model and kernel, and the constant-target control.

label: Thm. 5.3
name: thm:blackwell-finite
statement: Proves the garbling inequality, the converse by separating the target from the convex hull of the deterministic post-processings with a hyperplane and reading the separating functional as a utility, the observer equivalence, the gain form, the restriction to zero-one utilities, which on observers is refinement and is the Bayes-risk order of Theorem 5.2, and the two controls.

label: Thm. 8.1
name: thm:canonical-instance
statement: Proves that every grammar expression ignores the payload or fails to orient the duplicating carrier, and that the step-argument instance satisfies the operational-incompleteness predicate together with its license form.

label: Thm. 6.3
name: thm:channel-compactness
statement: Proves that a common finite channel exists if and only if every finite set of requirements has one, and the stagewise form for monotone sequences of observers.

label: Thm. 13.11
name: thm:confluence-calibration
statement: Proves the structural $\Pi^1_1$ classification of the sentence and the quantifier-free classification of joinability, satisfaction of the sentence in the standard model and satisfiability with the basic axioms, the order-type record of the multiset order with the trace bound and the $\varepsilon_0$ comparison, and the guarded-Newman record.

label: Thm. 12.2
name: thm:confluence-transport
statement: Proves the confluence criterion, the two-transport theorem, the equivalences of confluence with unique normal forms under conversion and with unique reachable normal forms for terminating TRSs, the TRS form of the transport, the non-injective three-state instance, and the terminating non-confluent fork.

label: Thm. 14.16
name: thm:construction-confession-orders
statement: Proves that a decreasing rank is counter-determined if and only if it has the counter's full order, that counter-determined ranks correspond to strictly increasing maps of $\mathbb N$, and that an independent invariant coordinate yields infinitely many full-order classes.

label: Thm. 2.4
name: thm:definition-unification
statement: Proves the equivalence under soundness, completeness, and dimension visibility; with a total context relation, the equivalence with dimension presence plus failure of the license; the license form of clause (ii); and three fixtures in which one hypothesis fails and the equivalence fails.

label: Thm. 8.6
name: thm:dp-not-signature-derivable
statement: Proves that every $\Sigma$-homomorphism into an algebra whose recursor operation is constant in its third argument assigns equal images to the two displayed terms.

label: Thm. 5.4
name: thm:entropy-fiber-bound
statement: Proves the bound in nats and in bits, equality if and only if every positive-mass fiber realizes $m$ values uniformly, zero entropy if and only if the license on the support, and the nonuniform and zero-mass controls.

label: Thm. 13.1
name: thm:eqw-non-derivable
statement: Proves disequality is not expressible in the declared sigma grammar unconditionally.

label: Thm. 14.10
name: thm:faithful-recursor-realization
statement: For every injective constructor fold, proves relation isomorphisms for $R_0$, $D_0$, and $R_{\mathrm{ctx}}$, well-foundedness and confluence of the generated relations, contextual generation by interpreted contexts, transported normalizers and step counts, soundness of the transported extraction, the role separator, and certificate depths one and two.

label: Thm. 5.8
name: thm:fd-license
statement: Proves the license identification, soundness and completeness of Armstrong's rules with the two-tuple Boolean instance refuting every non-derivable dependency, the list form and the family form over attributes, the two consistent-answer statements, the repair count, the fiber formula for $g_3$ and its identity with the uniform Bayes risk, the certain-answer form of $g_2$, the pair count for $g_1$, the two inequalities, and the three zero criteria.

label: Thm. 5.6
name: thm:finite-family-sufficiency
statement: Proves the factorization criterion, the proportional-posterior characterization, minimal sufficiency of the posterior map, and the zero-prior control on a two-by-two family.

label: Thm. 6.2
name: thm:finite-license-bound
statement: Proves kernel stability from stage $B=\max\{|q(X)|-1,0\}$ under observation compatibility, persistence of licensing if and only if licensing at $B$, a first loss by $B$, and attainment of the bound.

label: Thm. 6.6
name: thm:first-sufficient-horizon
statement: Proves persistence of history licenses, the first-sufficient-horizon dichotomy and its uniqueness, the least refined licensing memory, and the revealing and forgetting controls.

label: Thm. 7.1
name: thm:free-context-normalization
statement: Proves well-foundedness of the reversed root and contextual step relations, determinism and confluence of the root relation, confluence of the contextual relation, and that the normalizer reaches a normal form of every term and characterizes joinability by equal normal forms.

label: Thm. 10.2
name: thm:free-role-selection
statement: Proves that the computed channel separates frame from active, that the decoders are the channels with distinct values, that no function of the common generator value decodes the decision, and the entropy, posterior, and gap values for every role law.

label: Thm. 10.1
name: thm:free-root-extraction
statement: Proves the extraction equivalence, determinism, termination, and confluence of $D_0$ with its length and endpoint, and the criterion for extensions by new root edges.

label: Thm. 14.9
name: thm:free-witness-depths
statement: Proves that the truth hierarchy has a certificate at depth $k$ if and only if $1\le k$ and the boundary hierarchy if and only if $2\le k$, with minimum depths one and two.

label: Thm. 13.12
name: thm:generic-binary-profile
statement: Proves the certified raw and licensed profiles of a forward-closed binary fork and their transport along the image isomorphism.

label: Thm. 8.8
name: thm:homomorphic-inexpressibility
statement: Proves naturality of evaluation along a proof-carrying homomorphism, the factorization obstruction, the term-definability obstruction from a fixed truth token and a collapsed positive pair, its record form, and the disequality specialization.

label: Thm. 12.5
name: thm:hypothesis-necessity
statement: Proves the conjunction of the twenty-six fixture statements, each read off its fixture theorem, including three fixtures introduced here: a rotation without observation compatibility, an infinite fiber, and a task without certificates.

label: Thm. 10.16
name: thm:info-equiv-mod-dp
statement: Proves information equivalence of the step duplicator and circular-reference families under the DP projection.

label: Thm. 15.12
name: thm:lcel-structural-identity
statement: Proves that the six-clause comparison transports realization in both directions and exists for any two realized instances, and that the comparison and comparison-certificate types are subsingletons.

label: Thm. 6.1
name: thm:license-cutoff
statement: Proves that along a monotone sequence of observers, each refining the next, either every stage licenses the target or a unique first loss index exists, with a pair separated before it and identified from it on.

label: Thm. 3.5
name: thm:license-galois
statement: Proves the antitone Galois connection between equivalence relations and Boolean target families, $K(B(E))=E$, the closure laws, and the inclusion classification.

label: Thm. 3.3
name: thm:license-lattice
statement: Constructs the order isomorphism from observers modulo mutual refinement onto equivalence relations and onto partitions, and proves the kernels of the joint observer and of the join, the lower-bound property of the join, the license theory of the meet for pairs and families, the chain characterization, the join inclusion, and the parity control.

label: Thm. 3.7
name: thm:license-stabilizer
statement: Proves that licensing is invariance under the observer stabilizer, that fibers are stabilizer orbits, that refinement is stabilizer inclusion, the product decomposition over fibers, the finite factorial count, and the definability form.

label: Thm. 5.7
name: thm:lift-or-refuse
statement: Proves the collision law, refusal as decoding, the maximal refusals, the two maximal refusals and the relabeled lift at a collision, the least lift, the mixed-repair criterion, least refusal as Bayes risk, attainment and minimality of the least refused weight for $k$ symbols, its values at zero and one, antitonicity, convexity, the vanishing criterion, and the two-state fixture.

label: Thm. 8.4
name: thm:min-instance
statement: Proves that among structurally complete members the absence of an additive direct certificate holds only for the duplicating member, and the three-class classification of all six members.

label: Thm. 12.1
name: thm:normal-form-faithful-transport
statement: $\mathrm{UN}^{\to}$ for arbitrary relations and first-order TRS $\mathrm{UN}^{=}$ transfer under simulation, normality, and normal-form injectivity; termination transfers under target well-foundedness plus strict rank descent on stutters; both premises have necessity controls.

label: Thm. 10.3
name: thm:one-bit
statement: Proves that the deficit of the two-valued termination verdict equals the zero-evidence gap of the three-state fork, the dependency-pair exchange law for the overproduction gap, and the one-bit exchange.

label: Thm. 10.9
name: thm:progress-dp-direction
statement: Proves $r_m D_0 r_n$ if and only if $m=n+1$, the reversed-call and finite-prefix isomorphisms with wrapper expansion, and that no map preserves every expansion step as a forward $D_0$ step.

label: Thm. 10.8
name: thm:progress-quotient
statement: Proves that index transport is a relation isomorphism, that the quotient of the disjoint union by index is isomorphic to $(I,J)$, and that the quotient has more than one point when $I$ does.

label: Thm. 13.9
name: thm:quant-repair-cover
statement: Proves the ceil of defect-count over max-cover-size lower bound, and equality with defect count when repairs are independent singletons.

label: Thm. 13.7
name: thm:quant-terminal-characterization
statement: Under local normalization, proves source confluence iff terminal multiplicity is one, equivalently iff terminal Hartley entropy is zero.

label: Thm. 11.45
name: thm:rary-certificate
statement: For every arity $r$, proves that a strict certificate exists if and only if the pair is an $r$-ary root step, the same for $F$-headed steps of the $r$-ary relation, soundness of the checker, and the $G$-frame control; equality of $r$-ary terms is decided structurally.

label: Thm. 9.15
name: thm:rary-license-information
statement: Entropy chain law, actual dependency-pair partition, uniform map agreement, arbitrary binary specialization, and zero-frame boundary.

label: Thm. 9.3
name: thm:record-emission-necessity
statement: Proves that emitting a new record frame while preserving the generator forces payload duplication.

label: Thm. 11.7
name: thm:recursor-stopping
statement: Actual live-stage cost, Bellman maximum, an attaining stopping time and policy, and the all-finite-horizons criterion.

label: Thm. 4.2
name: thm:relational-recovery
statement: Fiber-common-certificate equivalence, pairwise/global counterexample, and full-information/restricted-language counterexample.

label: Thm. 4.3
name: thm:relational-side-channel
statement: Proves that cellwise common-certificate recovery holds if and only if every bad fiber subset is non-monochromatic, the two-color strict control, and the capacity form of the least alphabet.

label: Thm. 6.12
name: thm:repeat-depth-license
statement: Proves that the depth values on a fiber of size $k$ are $0,\dots,k-1$, that the least side alphabet for depth is the largest fiber size with the matching binary cost, the zero-or-one-bit cost of the repeat status, its fiber multiplicity of zero, one, or two, and that no fixed finite alphabet serves every horizon.

label: Thm. 3.6
name: thm:rule-invariant-galois
statement: Proves the Galois law, the Galois connection after order reversal, idempotence of both closures, and the six-part repair statement: containment, preservation, maximality, least exclusion, partition, and disjointness.

label: Thm. 6.5
name: thm:sequential-memory
statement: Proves that the history refines every retained stage and grows monotonically, the current-forgets and history-retains control, and the first-sufficient-horizon dichotomy.

label: Thm. 4.4
name: thm:set-valued-capacity
statement: Proves gluing of fiber colorings, that a $k$-symbol channel exists if and only if the capacity is at most $k$, attainment and optimality, that the search returns the capacity when every state has a certificate and none if and only if some state has none, the singleton specialization to the fiber multiplicity, and the three-way control with capacity two.

label: Thm. 11.9
name: thm:snell-envelope
statement: Proves the least-majorant property by induction on the horizon, attainment by the envelope stopping rule with a classical choice of an attaining action, and the stop-if-and-only-if criterion; one legal action gives the recursor instance.

label: Thm. 11.42
name: thm:strict-certificate
statement: Whole-message rejection of trailing data, certificate existence iff root step, recursive all-input bit-inspection bounds, standard-prefix inspection, and separate proof-checker operation bounds.

label: Thm. 15.16
name: thm:structural-identity
statement: Proves that both profiles realize the six-step shape, the G\"odel side on compiled arithmetic for $Q$ without conditions, that comparison at the shape layer is membership in the realized reflection family with subsingleton comparison types, and that the G\"odel checker ascent maps into the quotation ascent while the orientation and quotation ascents admit no morphism in either direction.

label: Thm. 5.5
name: thm:sufficiency-definability
statement: Proves the sufficiency criterion and its full-support license form, the risk-attainment equivalence, the minimal sufficient statistic, the fully noisy separation, the set-level definability criterion, and the empty-world control.

label: Thm. 10.12
name: thm:trs-iso-mod-lq
statement: Proves the three-field linear-growth agreement of the counter-indexed recursor family and the circular-reference orbit under the one-point quotient, and the orbit-system isomorphism.

label: FieldAffineMeasure
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.FieldAffineMeasure
statement:
structure FieldAffineMeasure (S : StepDuplicatingSchema) (K : Type*)
    [CommSemiring K] [PartialOrder K] [IsStrictOrderedRing K] where
  eval : S.T → K
  c_base : K
  succ_bias : K
  succ_scale : K
  wrap_const : K
  wrap_left : K
  wrap_right : K
  recur_const : K
  recur_base : K
  recur_step : K
  recur_counter : K
  eval_base : eval S.base = c_base
  eval_succ : ∀ t, eval (S.succ t) = succ_bias + succ_scale * eval t
  eval_wrap : ∀ x y, eval (S.wrap x y) = wrap_const + wrap_left * eval x + wrap_right * eval y
  eval_recur :
    ∀ b s n,
      eval (S.recur b s n) =
        recur_const + recur_base * eval b + recur_step * eval s + recur_counter * eval n
  h_wrap_left_pos : (1 : K) ≤ wrap_left
  h_wrap_right_pos : (1 : K) ≤ wrap_right
  h_wrap_const_nonneg : 0 ≤ wrap_const
  h_eval_nonneg : ∀ t, 0 ≤ eval t
  h_succ_bias_nonneg : 0 ≤ succ_bias
  h_succ_scale_nonneg : 0 ≤ succ_scale
  h_recur_const_nonneg : 0 ≤ recur_const
  h_recur_base_nonneg : 0 ≤ recur_base
  h_recur_step_nonneg : 0 ≤ recur_step
  h_recur_counter_nonneg : 0 ≤ recur_counter

label: ArtsGieslSingleApplicationAudit
name: OperatorKO7.ArtsGieslDerivationalComplexity.ArtsGieslSingleApplicationAudit
statement:
structure ArtsGieslSingleApplicationAudit (R : FixedFiniteTRS) where
  constructionConstant : Nat
  baseOrderProofLength : Nat → Nat
  soundnessConstant : Nat
  graphConstructionCost : Nat
  baseOrderCheckCost : Nat
  soundnessInvocationCost : Nat
  totalProofLength : Nat
  graphConstruction_le :
    graphConstructionCost ≤ R.graphConstructionBound constructionConstant
  baseOrderCheck_le :
    baseOrderCheckCost ≤ baseOrderProofLength R.dependencyPairCount
  soundnessInvocation_le : soundnessInvocationCost ≤ soundnessConstant
  total_eq :
    totalProofLength =
      graphConstructionCost + baseOrderCheckCost + soundnessInvocationCost

statement:
theorem arts_giesl_derivational_overhead_polynomial

label: BaseOrderProofLength
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ArtsGieslProofLengthBySize.BaseOrderProofLength
statement:
structure BaseOrderProofLength where
  /-- Proof length of discharging `n` extracted pairs. -/
  length : Nat → Nat
  /-- Cost of a single pair. -/
  perPair : Nat
  /-- Additivity, stated rather than assumed. -/
  additive : ∀ n, length n = n * perPair

label: FiniteTRSShape
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ArtsGieslProofLengthBySize.FiniteTRSShape
statement:
structure FiniteTRSShape where
  /-- Number of rules. -/
  ruleCount : Nat
  /-- Maximum size of a single rule. This is the parameter the construction stage depends
  on; signature cardinality does not bound it. -/
  maxRuleSize : Nat
  /-- Number of extracted dependency pairs. -/
  pairCount : Nat

label: agProofLength_le_of_nonempty
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ArtsGieslProofLengthBySize.agProofLength_le_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem agProofLength_le_of_nonempty
    (L : BaseOrderProofLength) (R : FiniteTRSShape)
    (hrule : 1 ≤ R.ruleCount) (hsize : 1 ≤ R.maxRuleSize) :
    agProofLength L R
      ≤ 2 * (R.ruleCount * R.ruleCount * R.maxRuleSize) + L.length R.pairCount

label: agProofLength_recursor_closed_form

theorem agProofLength_recursor_closed_form (m : Nat) :

label: confessionCertificateLength_recursor

theorem confessionCertificateLength_recursor (m K : Nat) :

label: constructionCost_unbounded_in_ruleSize

statement:
theorem constructionCost_unbounded_in_ruleSize (bound : Nat) :
    ∃ R : FiniteTRSShape,
      R.ruleCount = 1 ∧ bound < constructionCost R

label: licenseOverhead_constant_in_input

label: ArtsGieslExactTheoremCalibration
name: OperatorKO7.ArtsGieslReverseMathCalibration.ArtsGieslExactTheoremCalibration
statement:
structure ArtsGieslExactTheoremCalibration where
  calibration : ReverseMathCalibration artsGieslPrincipleProfile
  targetTheory :
    calibration.targetProfile.theory = FormalTheory.RCA0_WO_omega3
  targetOrdinal :
    calibration.targetProfile.ordinalCeiling? =
      some OperatorKO7.ReverseMathSupport.omegaPowThree
  upperTheory :
    calibration.upperBound.theoryProfile.theory = FormalTheory.RCA0_WO_omega3
  upperOrdinal :
    calibration.upperBound.theoryProfile.ordinalCeiling? =
      some OperatorKO7.ReverseMathSupport.omegaPowThree
  upperTheoremLevel :
    calibration.upperBound.evidenceStatus = EvidenceStatus.theoremLevel
  lowerBound :
    ∃ lb : ReverseMathLowerBound artsGieslPrincipleProfile,
      calibration.lowerBound? = some lb
        ∧ lb.theoryProfile.theory = FormalTheory.RCA0_WO_omega3
        ∧ lb.theoryProfile.ordinalCeiling? =
            some OperatorKO7.ReverseMathSupport.omegaPowThree
        ∧ lb.evidenceStatus = EvidenceStatus.theoremLevel
  statusExact :
    calibration.status = CalibrationStatus.exact

label: additive_table_classes
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.additive_table_classes
statement:
theorem additive_table_classes {S : StepDuplicatingSchema} (M : AdditiveMeasure S) :
    M.toScalarCoeffTable.structuralClasses =
      [ ScalarBarrierClass.additive
      , ScalarBarrierClass.affine
      , ScalarBarrierClass.restrictedQuadratic
      , ScalarBarrierClass.boundedCrossTermQuadratic ]

label: affine_table_classes
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.affine_table_classes
statement:
theorem affine_table_classes {S : StepDuplicatingSchema} (M : AffineMeasure S) :
    M.toScalarCoeffTable.structuralClasses =
      (if M.succ_scale = 1 && M.wrap_left = 1 && M.wrap_right = 1 &&
            M.recur_base = 1 && M.recur_step = 1 && M.recur_counter = 1
        then [ ScalarBarrierClass.additive
             , ScalarBarrierClass.affine
             , ScalarBarrierClass.restrictedQuadratic
             , ScalarBarrierClass.boundedCrossTermQuadratic ]
        else [ ScalarBarrierClass.affine
             , ScalarBarrierClass.restrictedQuadratic
             , ScalarBarrierClass.boundedCrossTermQuadratic ])

label: quadratic_table_classes
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.quadratic_table_classes
statement:
theorem quadratic_table_classes {S : StepDuplicatingSchema} (M : QuadraticCounterMeasure S) :
    M.toScalarCoeffTable.structuralClasses =
      (if M.recur_quad = 0 then
        if M.succ_scale = 1 && M.wrap_left = 1 && M.wrap_right = 1 &&
              M.recur_base = 1 && M.recur_step = 1 && M.recur_counter = 1 then
          [ ScalarBarrierClass.additive
          , ScalarBarrierClass.affine
          , ScalarBarrierClass.restrictedQuadratic
          , ScalarBarrierClass.boundedCrossTermQuadratic ]
        else
          [ ScalarBarrierClass.affine
          , ScalarBarrierClass.restrictedQuadratic
          , ScalarBarrierClass.boundedCrossTermQuadratic ]
      else
        [ ScalarBarrierClass.restrictedQuadratic
        , ScalarBarrierClass.boundedCrossTermQuadratic ])

    (S : StepDuplicatingSchema) (α : Type) (eval : S.T → α) (lt : α → α → Prop) where
  b : S.T
  s : S.T
  n : S.T
  fails : ¬ lt (eval (S.wrap s (S.recur b s n))) (eval (S.recur b s (S.succ n)))

label: max_failure_at_base
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.max_failure_at_base
statement:

    {S : StepDuplicatingSchema} (M : MaxMeasure S) (s : S.T)
    (hs : maxThreshold M ≤ M.eval s) :
    ¬ (M.eval (S.wrap s (S.recur S.base s S.base)) <
        M.eval (S.recur S.base s (S.succ S.base)))

name: OperatorKO7.BarrierFactorization.ko7_barrier_ablation_facts

theorem ko7_barrier_ablation_facts :
    (∃ μ : Trace → Nat,
        ∀ {a b : Trace}, LinearStep a b → μ b < μ a) ∧
      (∀ M : TypedBarrierSurvival.AdditiveMeasure,
        ¬ (∀ (b : TypedBarrierSurvival.Term TypedBarrierSurvival.Ty.res)
             (s : TypedBarrierSurvival.Term TypedBarrierSurvival.Ty.step)
             (n : TypedBarrierSurvival.Term TypedBarrierSurvival.Ty.cnt),
          M.evalRes (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.wrap s (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.recur b s n)) <
            M.evalRes (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.recur b s (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.succ n)))) ∧
      (∀ M : TypedBarrierSurvival.AffineMeasure,
        TypedBarrierSurvival.HasTypedStepPump M →
          ¬ (∀ (b : TypedBarrierSurvival.Term TypedBarrierSurvival.Ty.res)
               (s : TypedBarrierSurvival.Term TypedBarrierSurvival.Ty.step)
               (n : TypedBarrierSurvival.Term TypedBarrierSurvival.Ty.cnt),
            M.evalRes (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.wrap s (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.recur b s n)) <
              M.evalRes (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.recur b s (TypedBarrierSurvival.Term.succ n)))) ∧
      (∀ b s n : SharingBarrierLift.SharedTerm,
        SharingBarrierLift.sharedCounter (SharingBarrierLift.SharedTerm.shareApp s
          (SharingBarrierLift.SharedTerm.recur b s n)) <
        SharingBarrierLift.sharedCounter (SharingBarrierLift.SharedTerm.recur b s
          (SharingBarrierLift.SharedTerm.succ n)))

label: countable_recovers_finite_role_exchange
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.CountableRoleExchange.countable_recovers_finite_role_exchange

    (nu : C → Real) (hnu0 : ∀ c, 0 ≤ nu c) (hnu1 : ∑ c, nu c = 1) :
    countableRoleDivergence nu (uniformMass C) = klFromUniform nu

      ClassificationResult.blocked cert) ∨
    (∃ data, classifyDeclaredMethod method =
      ClassificationResult.constructionEscape data) ∨
    (∃ data, classifyDeclaredMethod method =
      ClassificationResult.projectionEscape data) ∨
    (∃ description, classifyDeclaredMethod method =
      ClassificationResult.outsideDeclaredUniverse description)

label: MeasureExpr.eval
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.DirectMeasureGrammarClosure.MeasureExpr.eval
statement:
def MeasureExpr.eval : MeasureExpr → Nat → Nat → Nat
  | counter,  c, _ => c
  | payload,  _, p => p
  | const n,  _, _ => n
  | add e f,  c, p => e.eval c p + f.eval c p
  | mul e f,  c, p => e.eval c p * f.eval c p
  | max e f,  c, p => Nat.max (e.eval c p) (f.eval c p)
  | smul n e, c, p => n * e.eval c p

label: MeasureExpr.payloadEffective?
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.DirectMeasureGrammarClosure.MeasureExpr.payloadEffective?
statement:
def MeasureExpr.payloadEffective? : MeasureExpr → Bool
  | counter => false
  | payload => true
  | const _ => false
  | add e f => e.payloadEffective? || f.payloadEffective?
  | mul e f =>
      (e.payloadEffective? && f.positiveFloor?) ||
        (e.positiveFloor? && f.payloadEffective?) ||
          (e.payloadEffective? && f.payloadEffective?)
  | max e f => e.payloadEffective? || f.payloadEffective?
  | smul n e => decide (0 < n) && e.payloadEffective?

label: MeasureExpr.positiveFloor?
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.DirectMeasureGrammarClosure.MeasureExpr.positiveFloor?
statement:
def MeasureExpr.positiveFloor? : MeasureExpr → Bool
  | counter => false
  | payload => false
  | const n => decide (0 < n)
  | add e f => e.positiveFloor? || f.positiveFloor?
  | mul e f => e.positiveFloor? && f.positiveFloor?
  | max e f => e.positiveFloor? || f.positiveFloor?
  | smul n e => decide (0 < n) && e.positiveFloor?

statement:
inductive MeasureExpr where
  | counter
  | payload
  | const (n : Nat)
  | add (e f : MeasureExpr)
  | mul (e f : MeasureExpr)
  | max (e f : MeasureExpr)
  | smul (n : Nat) (e : MeasureExpr)

label: PayloadEffective
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.DirectMeasureGrammarClosure.PayloadEffective
statement:
inductive PayloadEffective : MeasureExpr → Prop where
  | payload : PayloadEffective MeasureExpr.payload
  | add_left {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadEffective e) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.add e f)
  | add_right {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadEffective f) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.add e f)
  | max_left {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadEffective e) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.max e f)
  | max_right {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadEffective f) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.max e f)
  | smul_pos {n : Nat} {e : MeasureExpr}
      (hn : 0 < n) (h : PayloadEffective e) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.smul n e)
  | mul_left_floor {e f : MeasureExpr}
      (he : PayloadEffective e) (hf : PayloadPositiveFloor f) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.mul e f)
  | mul_right_floor {e f : MeasureExpr}
      (he : PayloadPositiveFloor e) (hf : PayloadEffective f) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.mul e f)
  | mul_both {e f : MeasureExpr}
      (he : PayloadEffective e) (hf : PayloadEffective f) :
      PayloadEffective (MeasureExpr.mul e f)

label: PayloadPositiveFloor
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.DirectMeasureGrammarClosure.PayloadPositiveFloor
statement:
inductive PayloadPositiveFloor : MeasureExpr → Prop where
  | const_pos {n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.const n)
  | add_left {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadPositiveFloor e) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.add e f)
  | add_right {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadPositiveFloor f) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.add e f)
  | mul {e f : MeasureExpr}
      (he : PayloadPositiveFloor e) (hf : PayloadPositiveFloor f) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.mul e f)
  | max_left {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadPositiveFloor e) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.max e f)
  | max_right {e f : MeasureExpr} (h : PayloadPositiveFloor f) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.max e f)
  | smul_pos {n : Nat} {e : MeasureExpr}
      (hn : 0 < n) (h : PayloadPositiveFloor e) :
      PayloadPositiveFloor (MeasureExpr.smul n e)

label: EchoLawCrown
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.EchoForkTrapCrown.EchoLawCrown
statement:
structure EchoLawCrown (E : Episode) : Prop where
  /-- Echo is equivalent to non-informativeness. -/
  classification : ∀ s : E.State, EchoAt E s ↔ ¬ InformativeAt E s
  /-- The law: an echo state emits no licensed non-null record. -/
  law : LicensedSound E → ObjectWitnessed E →
    ∀ s : E.State, EchoAt E s → ¬ ∃ r, E.licensedEmits s r ∧ E.nonnull r
  /-- The positive form: every licensed non-null record forces an exogenous channel. -/
  positive_form : LicensedSound E → ObjectWitnessed E →
    ∀ (s : E.State) (r : E.Record),
      E.licensedEmits s r → E.nonnull r → InformativeAt E s
  /-- The diagnosis: raw emission at an echo state is false formal legitimacy. -/
  diagnosis : LicensedSound E → ObjectWitnessed E →
    ∀ s : E.State, EchoAt E s → (∃ r, E.rawEmits s r ∧ E.nonnull r) →
      FalseFormalLegitimacyAt E s
  /-- False formal legitimacy implies that the raw emission graph is not confluent at the source. -/
  fork : ¬ E.nonnull E.null →
    ∀ s : E.State, E.rawEmits s E.null → FalseFormalLegitimacyAt E s →
      ¬ ConfluentAt (RawEmitStep E) (EmitNode.state s)
  /-- An `EchoDynamics` run increases mass by `n` and keeps the state fixed. -/
  trap : ∀ (D : EchoDynamics E) (t : D.Trace) (n : Nat),
    D.mass (run D t n) = D.mass t + n ∧ D.stateOf (run D t n) = D.stateOf t
  /-- An exogenous state either remains exogenous along `R` or reaches an echo state along `R`. -/
  dynamic : LicensedSound E → ObjectWitnessed E →
    ∀ (R : E.State → E.State → Prop) (s : E.State), Exogenous E s →
      PersistentExogenous E R s
        ∨ ∃ y, Relation.ReflTransGen R s y ∧ EchoAt E y
            ∧ ¬ ∃ r, E.licensedEmits y r ∧ E.nonnull r

label: echo_fork_trap
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.EchoForkTrapCrown.echo_fork_trap
statement:
theorem echo_fork_trap
    {X : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype E.Object]
    (hsound : LicensedSound E) (hwit : ObjectWitnessed E)
    (post : E.Answer → X → ℝ) (o₀ : E.Object)
    (μ : Fin 1 → ℝ) (ν : Fin 1 → E.Object → ℝ) (hν1 : ∀ w, ∑ c, ν w c = 1)
    (D : EchoDynamics E) (t : D.Trace)
    (hecho : EchoAt E (D.stateOf t))
    (hnull : ¬ E.nonnull E.null)
    (hnullRaw : E.rawEmits (D.stateOf t) E.null)
    (hraw : ∃ r, E.rawEmits (D.stateOf t) r ∧ E.nonnull r) :
    deficit μ ν (channelConditional E post (D.stateOf t)) = 0
      ∧ FalseFormalLegitimacyAt E (D.stateOf t)
      ∧ ¬ ConfluentAt (RawEmitStep E) (EmitNode.state (D.stateOf t))
      ∧ (∀ n, D.mass (run D t n) = D.mass t + n)
      ∧ (∀ n, D.stateOf (run D t n) = D.stateOf t)
      ∧ (∀ n, ¬ ∃ r, E.licensedEmits (D.stateOf (run D t n)) r ∧ E.nonnull r)

statement:
structure EchoDynamics (E : Episode) where
  /-- Execution traces. -/
  Trace : Type
  /-- Accumulated record mass. -/
  mass : Trace → Nat
  /-- The licensing state a trace sits at. -/
  stateOf : Trace → E.State
  /-- One echo step. -/
  step : Trace → Trace
  /-- The step appends exactly one record. -/
  mass_grows : ∀ t, mass (step t) = mass t + 1
  /-- The step moves no licensing coordinate. -/
  state_fixed : ∀ t, stateOf (step t) = stateOf t

  /-- Emitted records. -/
  Record : Type
  /-- The null record. -/
  null : Record
  /-- Which records are non-null. -/
  nonnull : Record → Prop
  /-- The query channel. -/
  answer : State → Object → Answer
  /-- The target distinction a non-null record asserts. -/
  Distinction : State → Prop
  /-- Unguarded emission. -/
  rawEmits : State → Record → Prop
  /-- Guarded emission. -/

label: ReflectedScalarFamilyGrammar
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.FamilyGrammarSubsumption.ReflectedScalarFamilyGrammar
statement:
inductive ReflectedScalarFamilyGrammar (S : StepDuplicatingSchema) where
  | additive (M : AdditiveMeasure S)
  | affine (M : AffineMeasure S) (unbounded : HasUnboundedRange M)
  | quadratic (M : QuadraticCounterMeasure S) (unbounded : HasUnboundedRangeQ M)
  | crossQuadratic (M : CrossTermQuadraticMeasure S) (unbounded : HasUnboundedRangeX M)
      (dominated : CrossTermBoundedAtBase M)
  | multilinear (M : BoundedMultilinearMeasure S) (unbounded : HasUnboundedRangeML M)
      (dominated : MultilinearDominatedAtBase M)
  | polynomial (M : BoundedPolynomialMeasure S) (unbounded : HasUnboundedRangePoly M)
      (dominated : EventuallyDominatedAtBase M)
  | maxPlus (M : MaxMeasure S) (unbounded : HasUnboundedRangeMax M)

  srcVal : ι → Nat
  /-- Attained value on the target side of the duplicating step. -/
  tgtVal : ι → Nat

label: DupStepIndex
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.FamilyGrammarSubsumption.DupStepIndex
statement:
structure DupStepIndex where
  /-- Counter coordinate on the target side; the source side sits at `counter + 1`. -/
  counter : Nat
  /-- Payload coordinate before the duplicated copy is added. -/
  payload : Nat
  /-- Size of the duplicated payload copy. -/
  copy : Nat
  /-- The duplicated copy is nonempty, matching the `1 ≤ L` binder of `OrientsDupStep`. -/
  copy_pos : 1 ≤ copy

label: GatedReadout
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.ReadoutGate.GatedReadout
statement:
structure GatedReadout (E : Episode) where
  /-- The branch consulted where the distinction holds. -/
  reading : E.Object → E.Answer
  /-- The branch returned where the distinction fails. -/
  silence : E.Answer
  /-- On the distinction region the answer is the reading of the probe. -/
  reads : ∀ s, E.Distinction s → ∀ o, E.answer s o = reading o
  /-- Off the distinction region the answer is constant. -/
  silent : ∀ s, ¬ E.Distinction s → ∀ o, E.answer s o = silence
  /-- First named probe. -/
  probe₀ : E.Object
  /-- Second named probe. -/
  probe₁ : E.Object
  /-- The reading tells the two probes apart. -/
  separates : reading probe₀ ≠ reading probe₁

    {X0 W0 C0 X1 W1 C1 : Type}
    [Fintype X0] [Fintype W0] [Fintype C0]

theorem omega_dp_exchange_law :
    (∀ (r : Fin 1 → Role → Fin 2 → ℝ) (v : Fin 1 → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ w c, r w c = v w) →
      overproductionGap Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface roleWeights r = 1 ∧
      BoundaryEvent Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface roleWeights r) ∧
    deficitBits unitSurface roleWeights roleResolving = 1 ∧
    overproductionGap Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface roleWeights
      roleResolving = 0 ∧
    ¬ BoundaryEvent Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface roleWeights
      roleResolving ∧
    (overproductionGap Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface roleWeights roleEcho -
      overproductionGap Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface roleWeights
        roleResolving = 1) ∧
    (∀ b s n : OperatorKO7.Trace,
      actualDPChannel b s n (((), Role.frame) : Occ Unit) ≠
        actualDPChannel b s n (((), Role.active) : Occ Unit))

label: omega_dp_exchange_ko7_law
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.OverproductionGap.omega_dp_exchange_ko7_law
statement:
theorem omega_dp_exchange_ko7_law :
    (∀ (s : Trace) (R : Fin 1 → Occ Trace → Fin 2 → ℝ)
        (g : Fin 1 → Trace → Fin 2 → ℝ),
      (∀ w o, R w o = g w o.1) →
      overproductionGap LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source unitSurface roleWeights
          (pairConditional s R) = 1 ∧
      BoundaryEvent LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source unitSurface roleWeights
        (pairConditional s R)) ∧
    (∀ b s n : Trace,
      deficitBits unitSurface roleWeights (dpEvidence b s n) = 1 ∧
      overproductionGap LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source unitSurface roleWeights
          (dpEvidence b s n) = 0 ∧
      ¬ BoundaryEvent LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source unitSurface roleWeights
          (dpEvidence b s n)) ∧
    (∀ b s n : Trace,
      overproductionGap LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source unitSurface roleWeights
          roleEcho -
        overproductionGap LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source unitSurface roleWeights
          (dpEvidence b s n) =
      branchEntropy (terminalMultiplicity LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source) -
        branchEntropy (terminalMultiplicity LocalLicensed EqWBreakerNode.source)) ∧
    (∀ b s n : Trace,
      actualDPChannel b s n (((), Role.frame) : Occ Unit) ≠
        actualDPChannel b s n (((), Role.active) : Occ Unit)) ∧
    ((branchEntropy (terminalMultiplicity LocalRaw EqWBreakerNode.source) -
        branchEntropy (terminalMultiplicity LocalLicensed EqWBreakerNode.source) =
      branchEntropy 2) ∧
      structuralHartleyCollapse LocalRaw LocalLicensed EqWBreakerNode.source = 1)

label: rary_license_is_active_bit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.OverproductionGapRoleExchangeGeneral.rary_license_is_active_bit
statement:
theorem rary_license_is_active_bit {r : Nat} (hr : 1 <= r)
    (ia ib ia' ib' k r' : Nat) :
    Fintype.card (RaryOcc r) = r + 1 ∧
      (∀ y : OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RTerm, ∀ o : RaryOcc r,
        raryContractumPayload r y o = y) ∧
      (∀ x y n : OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RTerm,
        OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RStep r
          (.F x y (.S n))
          (.G (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin r =>
            raryContractumPayload r y (Sum.inl i)))
            (.F x (raryContractumPayload r y (Sum.inr ())) n))) ∧
      (∀ o x : RaryOcc r,
        raryDPEvidence r o x =
          dpChannel r 0 (raryOccEquiv r o) (raryOccEquiv r x)) ∧
      (∀ y : OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RTerm,
        ¬ ∃ q : OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RTerm -> Bool,
          ∀ o : RaryOcc r, raryDPChannel o = q (raryValue y o)) ∧
      deficitBits unitSurface (uniformRoleWeights (r + 1)) (dpChannel r) =
        Real.logb 2 (r + 1 : Nat) -
          ((r : Real) / (r + 1 : Nat)) * Real.logb 2 (r : Real) ∧
      overproductionGap (starStep (r + 1)) 0 unitSurface
          (uniformRoleWeights (r + 1)) (dpChannel r) =
        ((r : Real) / (r + 1 : Nat)) * Real.logb 2 (r : Real) ∧
      (OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RStepsTo r
          (OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.rOrbit (.base ia) (.pay ib) k r 0)
          (k + 1)
          (OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.rOrbit (.base ia) (.pay ib) k r (k + 1)) ∧
        OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.RStepsTo r'
          (OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.rOrbit (.base ia') (.pay ib') k r' 0)
          (k + 1)
          (OperatorKO7.Meta.Recursor.RaryDuplicator.rOrbit (.base ia') (.pay ib') k r' (k + 1)))

      (μ : W → ℝ) (ν : W → Cn → ℝ) (r : W → Cn → X → ℝ),
      overproductionGap RA source μ ν r =
        overproductionGap RB (e.toEquiv source) μ ν r) ∧
    ForwardSimulation fork3Collapse Fork3Step BoolForkStep ∧
    (overproductionGap Fork3Step Fork3.source unitSurface uniformChannelWeights echoChannel ≠
      overproductionGap BoolForkStep (fork3Collapse Fork3.source)
        unitSurface uniformChannelWeights echoChannel) ∧
    Nonempty (ReleaseIso staticBoolBoundaryIso releaseDataA releaseDataA)

    {X W Cn : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype W] [Fintype Cn]
    (μ : W → ℝ) (ν : W → Cn → ℝ) (r : W → Cn → X → ℝ) :
    overproductionGap RA source μ ν r =
      overproductionGap RB (e.toEquiv source) μ ν r

label: relIso_terminalHartleyEntropy_eq

statement:

label: two_void_boundary
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.TwoVoidBoundary.two_void_boundary
statement:
theorem two_void_boundary :
    (voidValue voidFrame = voidValue voidActive ∧ voidFrame ≠ voidActive) ∧
    (∀ f : Occ Trace → Bool, ValueFactored voidValue f → f voidFrame = f voidActive) ∧
    (∃ f : Occ Trace → Bool, f voidFrame ≠ f voidActive) ∧
    (∀ f : Occ Trace → Bool, f voidFrame ≠ f voidActive → ¬ ValueFactored voidValue f) ∧
    ((∃ S : Set (Occ Trace),
        OperationalInexpressibility.LiftOrRefuse.MaximalLicensedOn S voidValue
          (fun o : Occ Trace => o) ∧ voidFrame ∈ S ∧ voidActive ∉ S) ∧
      ∃ T : Set (Occ Trace),
        OperationalInexpressibility.LiftOrRefuse.MaximalLicensedOn T voidValue
          (fun o : Occ Trace => o) ∧ voidActive ∈ T ∧ voidFrame ∉ T) ∧
    (¬ ∃ G : Set (Occ Trace),
        OperationalInexpressibility.LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn G voidValue (fun o : Occ Trace => o) ∧
          ∀ S : Set (Occ Trace),
            OperationalInexpressibility.LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn S voidValue
              (fun o : Occ Trace => o) → S ⊆ G) ∧
    ((∃ s : Fin 2 → Fin 2,
        OperationalInexpressibility.LicenseCriterion.Licensed
          (OperationalInexpressibility.Confusability.augmentObserver
            (fun i : Fin 2 => voidValue (voidPair i)) s) voidPair) ∧
      ¬ ∃ s : Fin 2 → Fin 1,
        OperationalInexpressibility.LicenseCriterion.Licensed
          (OperationalInexpressibility.Confusability.augmentObserver
            (fun i : Fin 2 => voidValue (voidPair i)) s) voidPair) ∧
    (Equiv.swap voidFrame voidActive ∈
        OperationalInexpressibility.LicenseStabilizer.licenseStabilizer voidValue ∧
      ∀ o : Occ Trace,
        boolSeparator voidFrame (Equiv.swap voidFrame voidActive o) = boolSeparator voidActive o) ∧
    ((∀ decoder : Trace × Trace → DistinctionBoundary.ObservationalDiagonalFork.MapCone,
        ¬ (DistinctionBoundary.ObservationalDiagonalFork.RecordCorrect voidFrame voidFrame
              (decoder (voidValue voidFrame, voidValue voidFrame)) ∧
            DistinctionBoundary.ObservationalDiagonalFork.RecordCorrect voidFrame voidActive
              (decoder (voidValue voidFrame, voidValue voidActive)))) ∧
      ∃ decoder, DistinctionBoundary.ObservationalDiagonalFork.ObservedDecoderCorrect
        (fun o : Occ Trace => (voidValue o, o.2)) decoder) ∧
    ((Step (eqW void void) void ∧ Step (eqW void void) (integrate (merge void void))) ∧
      ¬ ∃ t : SafeStep.SigmaFreeAlgebra.SigmaTerm,
        ∀ a b : SafeStep.SigmaFreeAlgebra.SigmaTerm,
          (a ≠ b) ↔
            (SafeStep.SigmaFreeAlgebra.evalSigma a b t ≠
              SafeStep.SigmaFreeAlgebra.SigmaTerm.void))

label: two_void_inside_outside
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryGeneral.TwoVoidBoundary.two_void_inside_outside
statement:
theorem two_void_inside_outside :
    (∀ f : Occ Trace → Bool, f voidFrame ≠ f voidActive →
        (f voidFrame = boolSeparator voidFrame voidFrame ∧
            f voidActive = boolSeparator voidFrame voidActive) ∨
          (f voidFrame = boolSeparator voidActive voidFrame ∧
            f voidActive = boolSeparator voidActive voidActive)) ∧
    (boolSeparator voidFrame voidFrame = !boolSeparator voidActive voidFrame ∧
      boolSeparator voidFrame voidActive = !boolSeparator voidActive voidActive) ∧
    (∀ f : Occ Trace → Bool,
        (∀ o, f (Equiv.swap voidFrame voidActive o) = f o) ↔ f voidFrame = f voidActive) ∧
    (∀ o : Occ Trace, voidValue o = void → o = voidFrame ∨ o = voidActive)

statement:
theorem actual_resolution_has_boundary_event {X A Q V : Type*}
    (q : X → Q) (step : A → X → X) (e : Experiment A Q V) :
    ∀ x y, q x = q y → evaluate q step e x ≠ evaluate q step e y →
      ∃ (before : List A) (a : A) (afterX afterY : List A),
        executedTrace q step e x = before ++ a :: afterX ∧
        executedTrace q step e y = before ++ a :: afterY ∧
        q (run step before x) = q (run step before y) ∧
        q (step a (run step before x)) ≠ q (step a (run step before y))

label: kernel_translation_invisible
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.kernel_translation_invisible
statement:
theorem kernel_translation_invisible {K V W : Type} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (v : V) (hv : v ∈ LinearMap.ker M) :
    (Equiv.addRight v : Equiv.Perm V) ∈
      {σ : Equiv.Perm V | ∀ x : V, M (σ x) = M x} ∧
    (v ≠ 0 → ∀ x : V, x ≠ x + v ∧ M x = M (x + v))

label: kernel_witness_excludes_readout
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.kernel_witness_excludes_readout
statement:
theorem kernel_witness_excludes_readout (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (L : V →ₗ[K] K)

    ¬ ∃ f : W → K, ∀ x, L x = f (M x)

label: no_bottom_only_consistency_detector
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.no_bottom_only_consistency_detector

label: no_row_certificate_iff_kernel_witness
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.no_row_certificate_iff_kernel_witness
statement:
theorem no_row_certificate_iff_kernel_witness (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K)

    (¬ ∃ c : I → K, ∑ i, c i • rows i = L) ↔
      ∃ k, (∀ i, rows i k = 0) ∧ L k ≠ 0

label: no_solution_iff_annihilator
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.no_solution_iff_annihilator
statement:
theorem no_solution_iff_annihilator (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (b : W) :
    (¬ ∃ x, M x = b) ↔ ∃ l : W →ₗ[K] K, l.comp M = 0 ∧ l b ≠ 0

label: no_solution_iff_row_refutation
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.no_solution_iff_row_refutation
statement:
theorem no_solution_iff_row_refutation (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (b : I → K) :
    (¬ ∃ x, Satisfies rows b x) ↔
      ∃ c : I → K, (∑ i, c i • rows i) = 0 ∧ (∑ i, c i * b i) ≠ 0

label: observation_eq_iff_kernel_difference
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.observation_eq_iff_kernel_difference
statement:
theorem observation_eq_iff_kernel_difference (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (x y : V) :
    M x = M y ↔ M (x - y) = 0

label: row_certificate_sound
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.row_certificate_sound
statement:
theorem row_certificate_sound (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (L : V →ₗ[K] K)
    (b c : I → K) (hc : ∑ i, c i • rows i = L) (x : V) (hx : Satisfies rows b x) :
    L x = ∑ i, c i * b i

label: solution_iff_kernel_translate
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.solution_iff_kernel_translate
statement:
theorem solution_iff_kernel_translate (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (b : W) (p x : V)
    (hp : M p = b) : M x = b ↔ ∃ k, M k = 0 ∧ x = p + k

label: source_certificate_trichotomy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.source_certificate_trichotomy
statement:
theorem source_certificate_trichotomy (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (b : I → K)
    (L : V →ₗ[K] K) :
    (∃ c : I → K, (∑ i, c i • rows i) = 0 ∧ (∑ i, c i * b i) ≠ 0) ∨
    (∃ (p : V) (c : I → K), Satisfies rows b p ∧ (∑ i, c i • rows i) = L) ∨
    (∃ p k, Satisfies rows b p ∧ (∀ i, rows i k = 0) ∧ L k ≠ 0)

label: target_forced_iff_kernel
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.target_forced_iff_kernel

theorem target_forced_iff_kernel (M : V →ₗ[K] W) (L : V →ₗ[K] K)

label: target_forced_iff_row_certificate
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.AffineSelfObservation.target_forced_iff_row_certificate

theorem target_forced_iff_row_certificate (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K)

statement:
theorem binaryEntropyDeficit_def (ε : ℝ) :

label: binaryEntropyDeficit_ge_two_div_log_two_mul_sq

statement:

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.binaryEntropyDeficit_two_sided
statement:
theorem binaryEntropyDeficit_two_sided (ε : ℝ) (hε : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    2 / Real.log 2 * ε ^ 2 ≤ binaryEntropyDeficit ε ∧ binaryEntropyDeficit ε ≤ 4 * ε ^ 2

label: gate_count_eq_two_log_two_mul_fisher_count
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.gate_count_eq_two_log_two_mul_fisher_count
statement:
theorem gate_count_eq_two_log_two_mul_fisher_count (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : ε ≠ 0) :
    Real.log 2 / (2 * ε ^ 2) = 2 * Real.log 2 * (1 / (4 * ε ^ 2))

label: readings_count_two_sided
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.readings_count_two_sided
statement:
theorem readings_count_two_sided (c ε : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hε0 : ε ≠ 0) (hε : |ε| ≤ 1 / 2) :
    c / (4 * ε ^ 2) ≤ c / binaryEntropyDeficit ε ∧
      c / binaryEntropyDeficit ε ≤ c * Real.log 2 / (2 * ε ^ 2)

label: sq_div_two_log_two_le_one_sub_binEntropy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.sq_div_two_log_two_le_one_sub_binEntropy
statement:
theorem sq_div_two_log_two_le_one_sub_binEntropy (t : ℝ) (ht : |t| ≤ 1) :
    t ^ 2 / (2 * Real.log 2) ≤ 1 - Real.binEntropy ((1 + t) / 2) / Real.log 2

label: two_div_log_two_sharp
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryEntropyDeficitBounds.two_div_log_two_sharp
statement:
theorem two_div_log_two_sharp (C : ℝ) (hC : 2 / Real.log 2 < C) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ 1 / 2 ∧ binaryEntropyDeficit ε < C * ε ^ 2

    (hA : (A.map (BoundedContinuousFunction.toContinuousMapₐ ℝ)).SeparatesPoints)

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.integral_approximation_bound

theorem integral_approximation_bound {E : Type*} [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [BorelSpace E] (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (f g : E →ᵇ ℝ) {K : Set E} (hK : MeasurableSet K) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hg : ∀ x, |g x| ≤ ‖f‖ + δ) (hnear : ∀ x ∈ K, |g x - f x| ≤ δ) :
    |(∫ x, g x ∂μ) - ∫ x, f x ∂μ| ≤ δ + (2 * ‖f‖ + δ) * μ.real Kᶜ

label: pairReport_coordinates

statement:
theorem pairReport_coordinates (L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    L = pairReport (L ![1, 0]) (L ![0, 1])

label: pairReport_normalize
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairReport_normalize
statement:
theorem pairReport_normalize (n : ℕ) (s t : ℝ) :
    (pairReport s t).comp (normalizePair n) =
      pairReport (s / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ))

label: pairSumLaw_charFun
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairSumLaw_charFun
statement:
theorem pairSumLaw_charFun (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (s t : ℝ) :
    charFunDual (pairSumLaw r hr n) (pairReport s t) = (pairKernel r s t : ℂ) ^ n

label: pairSumLaw_succ
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairSumLaw_succ
statement:
theorem pairSumLaw_succ (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) :
    pairSumLaw r hr (n + 1) =
      ((pairLaw r hr).prod (pairSumLaw r hr n)).map
        (fun z : (Fin 2 → ℝ) × (Fin 2 → ℝ) => z.1 + z.2)

label: pairTotalLaw_all_characteristic_limit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_all_characteristic_limit
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_all_characteristic_limit (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1)
    (L : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => charFunDual (pairTotalLaw r hr n) L) atTop
      (𝓝 (charFunDual (GaussianTotals.pairNormal r) L))

label: pairTotalLaw_bounded_test_limit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_bounded_test_limit
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_bounded_test_limit (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (f : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →ᵇ ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, f x ∂pairTotalLaw r hr n) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂GaussianTotals.pairNormal r))

label: pairTotalLaw_box_tail
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_box_tail
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_box_tail (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (pairTotalLaw r hr n).real
      (Set.Icc (fun _ : Fin 2 => -R) (fun _ : Fin 2 => R))ᶜ ≤ 8 / R ^ 2

label: pairTotalLaw_charFun
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_charFun
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_charFun (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (s t : ℝ) :
    charFunDual (pairTotalLaw r hr n) (pairReport s t) =
      (pairKernel r (s / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) : ℂ) ^ n

label: pairTotalLaw_characteristic_limit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_characteristic_limit
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_characteristic_limit (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (s t : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => charFunDual (pairTotalLaw r hr n) (pairReport s t)) atTop
      (𝓝 ((Real.exp (-(s ^ 2 + t ^ 2 + 2 * r * s * t) / 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))

label: pairTotalLaw_coordinate_charFun
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_coordinate_charFun
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_coordinate_charFun (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ)
    (j : Fin 2) (t : ℝ) :
    charFunDual (pairTotalLaw r hr n)
      (t • (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 2 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) =
        (Real.cos (t / Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) : ℂ) ^ n

label: pairTotalLaw_coordinate_tail
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pairTotalLaw_coordinate_tail
statement:
theorem pairTotalLaw_coordinate_tail (r : ℝ) (hr : |r| ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (j : Fin 2)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) : (pairTotalLaw r hr n).real {x | R < |x j|} ≤ 4 / R ^ 2

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.pair_kernel_variance_limit

label: scaled_cos_identity
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.scaled_cos_identity
statement:
theorem scaled_cos_identity (c : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (n : ℝ) * (Real.cos (c / Real.sqrt n) - 1) =
      -(c ^ 2 / 2) * (Real.sinc (c / (2 * Real.sqrt n))) ^ 2

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.scaled_cos_limit

label: tight_algebra_integral_limit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.tight_algebra_integral_limit
statement:
theorem tight_algebra_integral_limit {E : Type*} [MetricSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E]
    [BorelSpace E] (μs : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure E) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure E)
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range (fun n => (μs n : Measure E)) ∪ {(μ : Measure E)}))
    (A : Subalgebra ℝ (E →ᵇ ℝ))
    (hA : (A.map (toContinuousMapₐ ℝ)).SeparatesPoints)
    (hconv : ∀ g ∈ A, Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, g x ∂(μs n : Measure E)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, g x ∂(μ : Measure E)))) (f : E →ᵇ ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => ∫ x, f x ∂(μs n : Measure E)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂(μ : Measure E)))

label: tight_charFunDual_limit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BinaryPairLimit.tight_charFunDual_limit
statement:
theorem tight_charFunDual_limit {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μs : ℕ → ProbabilityMeasure E) (μ : ProbabilityMeasure E)
    (htight : IsTightMeasureSet (Set.range (fun n => (μs n : Measure E)) ∪ {(μ : Measure E)}))
    (hchar : ∀ a : NormedSpace.Dual ℝ E,
      Tendsto (fun n => charFunDual (μs n : Measure E) a) atTop
        (𝓝 (charFunDual (μ : Measure E) a))) : Tendsto μs atTop (𝓝 μ)

label: condEntropy_uniform
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.condEntropy_uniform
statement:
theorem condEntropy_uniform {X Q : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Nonempty X]
    (q : X → Q) :
    entropy (fun _ : X => (1 : ℝ) / Fintype.card X) -
        entropy (fun y : Q =>
          ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card X) =
      ∑ y : Q, (((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card X) *
        Real.log ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card)

label: condEntropy_uniform_eq_log_card_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.condEntropy_uniform_eq_log_card_iff
statement:
theorem condEntropy_uniform_eq_log_card_iff {X Q : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    [Nonempty X] (q : X → Q) :
    (∑ y : Q, (((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card X) *
        Real.log ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card)) = Real.log (Fintype.card X) ↔
      ∀ x x', q x = q x'

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.condEntropy_uniform_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem condEntropy_uniform_eq_zero_iff {X Q : Type*} [Fintype X] [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    [Nonempty X] (q : X → Q) :

      Function.Injective q

label: majority_error_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.majority_error_le
statement:
theorem majority_error_le (N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) (b : Bool) :
    (∑ ys : Fin N → Bool,
        if 2 * (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => ys i = b)).card < N then
          ∏ i, (if ys i = b then 1 / 2 + ε else 1 / 2 - ε)
        else 0) ≤ Real.exp (-2 * N * ε ^ 2)

label: minority_weight_sq_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.minority_weight_sq_le
statement:
theorem minority_weight_sq_le {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hqp : q ≤ p) (k d : ℕ) :
    (p ^ k * q ^ (k + d)) ^ 2 ≤ (p * q) ^ (2 * k + d)

label: negMulLog_add_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.negMulLog_add_le
statement:
theorem negMulLog_add_le {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) :
    Real.negMulLog (u + v) ≤ Real.negMulLog u + Real.negMulLog v

label: negMulLog_half
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.negMulLog_half
statement: theorem negMulLog_half : Real.negMulLog (1 / 2 : ℝ) = Real.log 2 / 2

label: one_sub_binEntropy_expansion
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.one_sub_binEntropy_expansion
statement:
theorem one_sub_binEntropy_expansion :
    Asymptotics.IsBigO (nhds (0 : ℝ))
      (fun ε : ℝ => Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 + ε) - 2 * ε ^ 2)
      (fun ε : ℝ => ε ^ 4)

label: pair_condEntropy_one_bit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.pair_condEntropy_one_bit
statement:
theorem pair_condEntropy_one_bit :
    entropy (fun _ : Bool => (1 : ℝ) / 2) - entropy (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ℝ)) = Real.log 2

label: pair_system_log_card
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.pair_system_log_card
statement:
theorem pair_system_log_card (X : Type*) [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] :
    Real.log (Fintype.card (X × Bool)) = Real.log (Fintype.card X) + Real.log 2

label: readingJoint_diff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingJoint_diff
statement:
theorem readingJoint_diff (ε : ℝ) {b y : Bool} (h : y ≠ b) :
    readingJoint ε b y = 1 / 2 * (1 / 2 - ε)

label: readingJoint_marginal_label
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingJoint_marginal_label
statement: theorem readingJoint_marginal_label (ε : ℝ) (b : Bool) : ∑ y, readingJoint ε b y = 1 / 2

label: readingJoint_marginal_reading
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingJoint_marginal_reading
statement: theorem readingJoint_marginal_reading (ε : ℝ) (y : Bool) : ∑ b, readingJoint ε b y = 1 / 2

label: readingJoint_same
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingJoint_same
statement: theorem readingJoint_same (ε : ℝ) (b : Bool) : readingJoint ε b b = 1 / 2 * (1 / 2 + ε)

label: readingWeight_entropy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingWeight_entropy
statement:
theorem readingWeight_entropy (ε : ℝ) (b : Bool) :
    Real.negMulLog (if true = b then 1 / 2 + ε else 1 / 2 - ε) +
        Real.negMulLog (if false = b then 1 / 2 + ε else 1 / 2 - ε) =
      Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 + ε)

label: readingWeight_sum
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingWeight_sum
statement:
theorem readingWeight_sum (ε : ℝ) (b : Bool) :
    (if true = b then 1 / 2 + ε else 1 / 2 - ε) + (if false = b then 1 / 2 + ε else 1 / 2 - ε) =
      (1 : ℝ)

label: reading_condEntropy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.reading_condEntropy
statement:
theorem reading_condEntropy (ε : ℝ) :
    entropy (fun z : Bool × Bool => readingJoint ε z.1 z.2) -
        entropy (fun y : Bool => ∑ b, readingJoint ε b y) = Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 + ε)

label: reading_exact_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.reading_exact_iff
statement:
theorem reading_exact_iff (ε : ℝ) :
    (∀ b y, y ≠ b → readingJoint ε b y = 0) ↔ ε = 1 / 2

label: reading_independent_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.reading_independent_iff
statement:
theorem reading_independent_iff (ε : ℝ) :
    (∀ b y, readingJoint ε b y =
        (∑ y', readingJoint ε b y') * (∑ b', readingJoint ε b' y)) ↔ ε = 0

label: reading_mutualInfo
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.reading_mutualInfo
statement:
theorem reading_mutualInfo (ε : ℝ) :
    entropy (fun b : Bool => ∑ y, readingJoint ε b y) +
        entropy (fun y : Bool => ∑ b, readingJoint ε b y) -
        entropy (fun z : Bool × Bool => readingJoint ε z.1 z.2) =
      Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 + ε)

label: readingsJoint_marginal_label
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readingsJoint_marginal_label
statement:
theorem readingsJoint_marginal_label (N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (b : Bool) :
    ∑ ys, readingsJoint N ε b ys = 1 / 2

label: readings_mutualInfo_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.readings_mutualInfo_le
statement:
theorem readings_mutualInfo_le (N : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) :
    entropy (fun b : Bool => ∑ ys, readingsJoint N ε b ys) +
        entropy (fun ys : Fin N → Bool => ∑ b, readingsJoint N ε b ys) -
        entropy (fun z : Bool × (Fin N → Bool) => readingsJoint N ε z.1 z.2) ≤
      min (Real.log 2) (N * (Real.log 2 - Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 + ε)))

label: repeat_same_kernel
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.repeat_same_kernel
statement:
theorem repeat_same_kernel {X Q : Type*} (q : X → Q) (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) (x y : X) :
    ((fun _ : Fin N => q x) = (fun _ : Fin N => q y)) ↔ q x = q y

label: selfTest_bits_eq_logb_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.selfTest_bits_eq_logb_iff
statement:
theorem selfTest_bits_eq_logb_iff (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Real.binEntropy (1 / (n : ℝ)) / Real.log 2 = Real.logb 2 n ↔ n = 2

label: selfTest_entropy_eq_log_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.selfTest_entropy_eq_log_iff
statement:
theorem selfTest_entropy_eq_log_iff (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) :

label: selfTest_one_bit_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.selfTest_one_bit_iff
statement:
theorem selfTest_one_bit_iff (n : ℕ) :

label: sum_negMulLog_prod_bool
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.sum_negMulLog_prod_bool
statement:
theorem sum_negMulLog_prod_bool (g : Bool → ℝ) (hg : g true + g false = 1) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ ys : Fin N → Bool, Real.negMulLog (∏ i, g (ys i)) =
      N * (Real.negMulLog (g true) + Real.negMulLog (g false))

label: sum_prod_bool
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.sum_prod_bool
statement:
theorem sum_prod_bool (g : Bool → ℝ) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ ys : Fin N → Bool, ∏ i, g (ys i) = (g true + g false) ^ N

label: uniformProductProjection_condEntropy_bits
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BitDivision.uniformProductProjection_condEntropy_bits
statement:
theorem uniformProductProjection_condEntropy_bits (X : Type*)
    [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] :

label: uniformProductProjection_condEntropy_one_bit

label: boundary_three_descriptions
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.Boundary.boundary_three_descriptions
statement:
theorem boundary_three_descriptions {X Q : Type} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q]
    (q : X → Q) (x₀ x₁ : X) (hne : x₀ ≠ x₁) :
    (q x₀ = q x₁ ↔
      ∃ σ ∈ OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.LicenseStabilizer.licenseStabilizer q,
        σ x₀ = x₁) ∧
    (q x₀ = q x₁ ↔
      ∀ (Y : Type) [Fintype Y] (K : BoundaryPole.Reading X Y),
        FactorsThroughRecordRange q K →
          BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination K x₀ x₁ = 0)

label: recordDetermined_iff_range_factor
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.Boundary.recordDetermined_iff_range_factor
statement:

label: same_record_nontrivial_control
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.Boundary.same_record_nontrivial_control
statement:
theorem same_record_nontrivial_control :
    (false : Bool) ≠ true ∧
    ((fun _ : Bool => ()) false = (fun _ : Bool => ()) true) ∧
    (∃ σ ∈ OperatorKO7.Meta.OperationalInexpressibility.LicenseStabilizer.licenseStabilizer
        (fun _ : Bool => ()), σ false = true) ∧
    (∀ (Y : Type) [Fintype Y] (K : BoundaryPole.Reading Bool Y),
      FactorsThroughRecordRange (fun _ : Bool => ()) K →
        BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination K false true = 0)

label: unequal_record_separating_reading_control

    ∃ K : BoundaryPole.Reading Bool Bool,
      FactorsThroughRecordRange (id : Bool → Bool) K ∧
      BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination K false true = 2

statement:
theorem boundary_iff_blind {X Q : Type} (q : X → Q) {x₀ x₁ : X} (hne : x₀ ≠ x₁) :
    IsMergedPair q x₀ x₁ ↔
      ∀ (A Y : Type) [Fintype A] [Fintype Y] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y)
        (K : List (A × Y) → A → Reading X Y),
        (∀ h a, RecordDetermined q (K h a)) →
        (∀ h a b, p.observation h a b = K h a (pairState x₀ x₁ b)) →
        (∀ n bank, HistoryBank n bank → terminalMI p n bank = 0) ∧ informationLimit p = 0

label: boundary_iff_infinite_cost
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundaryInfiniteCost.boundary_iff_infinite_cost
statement:
theorem boundary_iff_infinite_cost {X Q : Type} (q : X → Q) {x₀ x₁ : X} (hne : x₀ ≠ x₁)
    (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) :
    (IsMergedPair q x₀ x₁ ↔
      ∀ (A Y : Type) [Fintype A] [Fintype Y] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y)
        (K : List (A × Y) → A → Reading X Y),
        (∀ h a, RecordDetermined q (K h a)) →
        (∀ h a b, p.observation h a b = K h a (pairState x₀ x₁ b)) →
        (∀ h a, 1 ≤ p.cost h a) →
        ∀ n bank, HistoryBank n bank → terminalMI p n bank < c) ∧
    (q x₀ ≠ q x₁ →
      1 ≤ terminalMI (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁) 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) ∧
        expectedCost (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁) 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = 1)

label: indicatorProtocol_observation
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundaryInfiniteCost.indicatorProtocol_observation
statement:
theorem indicatorProtocol_observation {X Q : Type} (q : X → Q) (x₀ x₁ : X)

    (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁).observation h a b = indicatorReading q x₀ (pairState x₀ x₁ b)

label: indicator_protocol_split
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundaryInfiniteCost.indicator_protocol_split
statement:
theorem indicator_protocol_split {X Q : Type} (q : X → Q) {x₀ x₁ : X} (hq : q x₀ ≠ q x₁) :
    RecordDetermined q (indicatorReading q x₀) ∧
      (∀ h a b, (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁).observation h a b =
        indicatorReading q x₀ (pairState x₀ x₁ b)) ∧
      (∀ h a, 1 ≤ (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁).cost h a) ∧
      readingDiscrimination (indicatorReading q x₀) x₀ x₁ = 2 ∧
      1 ≤ terminalMI (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁) 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) ∧
      expectedCost (indicatorProtocol q x₀ x₁) 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = 1

statement:
theorem independentExclusiveSeed_branch_survival {H0 Y : Type} [Fintype H0] [Fintype Y]
    (ν : FiniteLaw H0) (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (u : H0) (n : ℕ) :
    activeMass ((independentExclusiveSeed ν μ P Q).given u) n true =
        μ.mass true * (1 - exclusiveMass P Q) ^ n ∧
      activeMass ((independentExclusiveSeed ν μ P Q).given u) n false =
        μ.mass false * (1 - exclusiveMass Q P) ^ n

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundaryInfiniteCostConditional.seededDisjointReading_fair_frontier
statement:
theorem seededDisjointReading_fair_frontier
    (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (h : ∀ y, P.mass y = 0 ∨ Q.mass y = 0)
    (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) :
    ∃ p : ConditionalProtocol Bool Bool Unit Y,
      (∀ u z, p.initialJoint.mass (u, z) =
        p.initialRecord.mass u * ResolutionAttainment.fairLaw.mass z) ∧
      (∀ u hs a z, (p.given u).observation hs a z = PairResolution.row P Q z) ∧
      (∀ u hs a, (p.given u).cost hs a = 1) ∧
      conditionalMI p 1 (historyBank Unit Y 1) = c ∧
      conditionalExpectedCost p 1 (historyBank Unit Y 1) = c ∧
      conditionalInformationLimit p = c ∧
      conditionalExtendedCost p = ENNReal.ofReal c

label: seeded_finite_limiting_frontier
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundaryInfiniteCostConditional.seeded_finite_limiting_frontier
statement:
theorem seeded_finite_limiting_frontier (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1) :
    (∃ p : ConditionalProtocol Bool Bool Unit Bool,
      (∀ u z, p.initialJoint.mass (u, z) =
        p.initialRecord.mass u * binaryPrior (1 / 2) z) ∧
      (∀ u h a z y, ((p.given u).observation h a z).mass y =
        if y = z then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ u h a, (p.given u).cost h a = 1) ∧
      conditionalMI p 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = c ∧
      conditionalExpectedCost p 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = c ∧
      conditionalInformationLimit p = c ∧
      conditionalExtendedCost p = ENNReal.ofReal c) ∧
    (∀ (H0 Z A : Type) [Fintype H0] [Fintype Z] [Fintype A]
      (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Bool),
      (∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u →
        ∀ h a, 1 ≤ (p.given u).cost h a) →
      ENNReal.ofReal (conditionalInformationLimit p) ≤ conditionalExtendedCost p)

    (hK0 : ∀ b y, 0 ≤ K b y) (hK1 : ∀ b, ∑ y, K b y = 1) :

label: boundary_singularity
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundarySingularity.boundary_singularity
statement:
theorem boundary_singularity {X Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (q : X → Y) (x x' : X) :
    (discrimination ((StochasticGraph.deterministic q).prob x)
      ((StochasticGraph.deterministic q).prob x') = 0 ↔ q x = q x') ∧
    (∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y) (δ c : ℝ), PairMenu p δ →
      0 < δ → ∀ (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))), HistoryBank n bank →
        c ≤ terminalMI p n bank → c * Real.log 2 / δ ≤ expectedCost p n bank) ∧
    (∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y), PairMenu p 0 →
      informationLimit p = 0)

label: chi_term_le_discrimination_term
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.BoundarySingularity.chi_term_le_discrimination_term
statement:

def evalNeg (env : ℕ → ℕ) : Formula → Prop
  | .eq s t => evalTerm env s = evalTerm env t
  | .not (.eq s t) => evalTerm env t = 0 ∧ evalTerm env s ≠ 0
  | .not (.not _) => False
  | .not (.imp _ _) => False
  | .not (.all x φ) => ¬ evalNeg env (.all x φ)
  | .imp φ ψ => evalNeg env φ → evalNeg env ψ
  | .all x φ => ∀ n : ℕ, evalNeg (envUpdate env x n) φ

label: evalFormIn_subst_free
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.CheckerGaps.evalFormIn_subst_free
statement:
theorem evalFormIn_subst_free (M : ArithStructure) (x : ℕ) (u : Term)
    (hu : ∀ y, y ≠ x → termHasVar y u = false) :
    ∀ (φ : Formula) (env : ℕ → M.Carrier),
      evalFormIn M env (substForm x u φ) ↔
        evalFormIn M (envUpdateIn M env x (evalTermIn M env u)) φ
  | .eq s t, env => by
      simp only [substForm, evalFormIn, evalTermIn_subst]
  | .not φ, env => by
      simp only [substForm, evalFormIn, evalFormIn_subst_free M x u hu φ env]
  | .imp φ ψ, env => by
      simp only [substForm, evalFormIn, evalFormIn_subst_free M x u hu φ env,
        evalFormIn_subst_free M x u hu ψ env]
  | .all y φ, env => by
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst hyx
        rw [show substForm y u (Formula.all y φ) = Formula.all y φ from if_pos rfl]
        simp only [evalFormIn]
        refine forall_congr' (fun a => evalFormIn_env_eq_aux M φ (fun z => ?_))
        simp only [envUpdateIn]
        by_cases hz : z = y <;> simp [hz]
      · rw [show substForm x u (Formula.all y φ) = Formula.all y (substForm x u φ) from if_neg hyx]
        simp only [evalFormIn]
        refine forall_congr' (fun a => ?_)
        rw [evalFormIn_subst_free M x u hu φ]
        have hval : evalTermIn M (fun w => if w = y then a else env w) u = evalTermIn M env u :=
          evalTermIn_fresh M y u (hu y hyx) env a
        rw [hval]
        exact evalFormIn_env_eq_aux M φ (fun z => envUpdateIn_if_comm M env hyx _ a z)

label: evalNeg_iff_evalForm
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.CheckerGaps.evalNeg_iff_evalForm
statement:
theorem evalNeg_iff_evalForm : ∀ (φ : Formula), noNeg φ = true → ∀ env : ℕ → ℕ,
    (evalNeg env φ ↔ evalForm env φ)
  | .eq s t, _, env => Iff.rfl
  | .not _, h, _ => by simp [noNeg] at h
  | .imp φ ψ, h, env => by
      simp only [noNeg, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      simp only [evalNeg, evalForm]
      exact imp_congr (evalNeg_iff_evalForm φ h.1 env) (evalNeg_iff_evalForm ψ h.2 env)
  | .all x φ, h, env => by
      simp only [noNeg] at h
      simp only [evalNeg, evalForm]
      exact forall_congr' (fun n => evalNeg_iff_evalForm φ h (envUpdate env x n))
