statement:
theorem evalNeg_subst_closed (x : ℕ) (u : Term) (hu : isClosedTerm u = true) :
    ∀ (φ : Formula) (env : ℕ → ℕ),
      evalNeg env (substForm x u φ) ↔ evalNeg (envUpdate env x (evalTerm env u)) φ
  | .eq s t, env => by simp only [substForm, evalNeg, evalTerm_subst]
  | .not (.eq s t), env => by simp only [substForm, evalNeg, evalTerm_subst]
  | .not (.not φ), env => by simp only [substForm, evalNeg]
  | .not (.imp φ ψ), env => by simp only [substForm, evalNeg]
  | .not (.all y φ), env => by
      have ih := evalNeg_subst_closed x u hu (.all y φ) env
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · rw [show substForm x u (Formula.all y φ) = Formula.all y φ from if_pos hyx] at ih
        rw [show substForm x u (Formula.not (Formula.all y φ)) =
          Formula.not (Formula.all y φ) by simp [substForm, hyx]]
        simp only [evalNeg]
        exact not_congr ih
      · rw [show substForm x u (Formula.all y φ) = Formula.all y (substForm x u φ) from
          if_neg hyx] at ih
        rw [show substForm x u (Formula.not (Formula.all y φ)) =
          Formula.not (Formula.all y (substForm x u φ)) by simp [substForm, hyx]]
        simp only [evalNeg]
        exact not_congr ih
  | .imp φ ψ, env => by
      simp only [substForm, evalNeg]
      exact imp_congr (evalNeg_subst_closed x u hu φ env) (evalNeg_subst_closed x u hu ψ env)
  | .all y φ, env => by
      by_cases hyx : y = x
      · subst hyx
        rw [show substForm y u (Formula.all y φ) = Formula.all y φ from if_pos rfl]
        simp only [evalNeg]
        refine forall_congr' (fun n => ?_)
        rw [show envUpdate (envUpdate env y (evalTerm env u)) y n = envUpdate env y n from
          funext (fun z => envUpdate_same env y (evalTerm env u) n z)]
      · rw [show substForm x u (Formula.all y φ) = Formula.all y (substForm x u φ) from if_neg hyx]
        simp only [evalNeg]
        refine forall_congr' (fun n => ?_)
        rw [evalNeg_subst_closed x u hu φ (envUpdate env y n),
          isClosedTerm_eval_indep u hu (envUpdate env y n) env]
        rw [show envUpdate (envUpdate env y n) x (evalTerm env u) =
            envUpdate (envUpdate env x (evalTerm env u)) y n from
          funext (fun z => envUpdate_comm env hyx (evalTerm env u) n z)]

  | delta t => snCtx_delta (snCtx_all t)
  | integrate t => snCtx_integrate (snCtx_all t)

    (D : Finset (Fin n)) (available : (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool)
    (combines : Finset (Fin n) → (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool) :
    Option ((Fin n → Fin k) × (Fin k → Fin m)) → Prop
  | some sw => available sw.1 = true ∧ combines D sw.1 = true ∧
      ∀ i ∈ D, table (sw.2 (sw.1 i)) i = true
  | none => ¬ ∃ (s : Fin n → Fin k) (ws : Fin k → Fin m), available s = true ∧ combines D s = true ∧
      ∀ i ∈ D, table (ws (s i)) i = true

label: licensedSearch_empty_iff
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensedSearch_empty_iff
statement:
theorem licensedSearch_empty_iff {n m k : ℕ} (table : Fin m → Fin n → Bool)
    (D : Finset (Fin n)) (available : (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool)
    (combines : Finset (Fin n) → (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool) :
    licensedSearch n m k table D available combines = ∅ ↔
      ¬ ∃ (s : Fin n → Fin k) (ws : Fin k → Fin m), available s = true ∧ combines D s = true ∧
        ∀ i ∈ D, table (ws (s i)) i = true

label: licensedSearch_mem_iff
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensedSearch_mem_iff
statement:
theorem licensedSearch_mem_iff {n m k : ℕ} (table : Fin m → Fin n → Bool)
    (D : Finset (Fin n)) (available : (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool)
    (combines : Finset (Fin n) → (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool)
    (sw : (Fin n → Fin k) × (Fin k → Fin m)) :
    sw ∈ licensedSearch n m k table D available combines ↔
      available sw.1 = true ∧ combines D sw.1 = true ∧ ∀ i ∈ D, table (sw.2 (sw.1 i)) i = true

label: licensedSearch_nonempty_iff
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensedSearch_nonempty_iff
statement:
theorem licensedSearch_nonempty_iff {n m k : ℕ} (table : Fin m → Fin n → Bool)
    (D : Finset (Fin n)) (available : (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool)
    (combines : Finset (Fin n) → (Fin n → Fin k) → Bool)
    (menu : RepairMenu (Fin n) (Fin m) (tableProblem table))
    (ha : ∀ s, available s = true ↔ s ∈ menu.allowed k)
    (hc : ∀ (E : Finset (Fin n)) s, combines E s = true ↔ menu.combines (E : Set (Fin n)) k s) :
    (licensedSearch n m k table D available combines).Nonempty ↔
      RepairFeasible (tableProblem table) menu (D : Set (Fin n)) k

theorem licensed_alphabet_denied :

      licensedColoringAlphabet (⟨fun _ _ => True⟩ : Problem Unit Unit) deniedMenu Set.univ = ⊤ ∧
      minimumAlphabet (⟨fun _ _ => True⟩ : Problem Unit Unit) = some 1

label: licensed_coloring_iff
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensed_coloring_iff
statement:
theorem licensed_coloring_iff {I : Type u} [Fintype I] {W : Type v}
    (P : Problem I W) (menu : RepairMenu I W P) (D : Set I) (k : ℕ) :
    RepairFeasible P menu D k ↔
      ∃ s ∈ menu.allowed k, menu.combines D k s ∧ ColorsOn P D k s

label: licensed_coloring_iff_of_finite
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensed_coloring_iff_of_finite
statement:
theorem licensed_coloring_iff_of_finite {I : Type u} {W : Type v} (P : Problem I W)
    (menu : RepairMenu I W P) {D : Set I} (hD : D.Finite) (k : ℕ) :
    RepairFeasible P menu D k ↔ LicensedColoring P menu D k

label: licensed_leastFinite_eq_of_finite
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensed_leastFinite_eq_of_finite
statement:
theorem licensed_leastFinite_eq_of_finite {I : Type u} {W : Type v} (P : Problem I W)
    (menu : RepairMenu I W P) {D : Set I} (hD : D.Finite) :
    leastFinite (fun k => RepairFeasible P menu D k) =
      leastFinite (fun k => LicensedColoring P menu D k)

label: licensed_selector_least_alphabet
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensed_selector_least_alphabet
statement:
theorem licensed_selector_least_alphabet {I : Type u} [Finite I] {W : Type v}
    (P : Problem I W) (menu : RepairMenu I W P) (D : Set I) :
    licensedMinimumAlphabet P menu D = licensedColoringAlphabet P menu D ∧
      ((∀ k, ¬ RepairFeasible P menu D k) ↔
        licensedMinimumAlphabet P menu D = ⊤ ∧ licensedColoringAlphabet P menu D = ⊤) ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, licensedMinimumAlphabet P menu D = (k : ℕ∞) ↔
        RepairFeasible P menu D k ∧ ∀ j, j < k → ¬ RepairFeasible P menu D j

name: UniversalObservation.Demand.licensed_solver_replays
statement:
theorem licensed_solver_replays (n m k : ℕ) (table : Fin m → Fin n → Bool)

theorem maximal_retained_iff_insert {I W : Type*} (P : Problem I W)

label: maximal_retained_iff_obstruction
name: UniversalObservation.Demand.maximal_retained_iff_obstruction
statement:
theorem maximal_retained_iff_obstruction {I : Type*} [Fintype I] {W : Type*}
    (P : Problem I W) (D : Set I) (k : ℕ) (s : I → Fin k) :
    MaximalRetained P D k s ↔ ColorsOn P D k s ∧
      ∀ i, i ∉ D → ∃ B : Finset I, i ∈ B ∧ (B : Set I) ⊆ insert i D ∧
        MinimalBad P B ∧ ∃ j : Fin k, ∀ x ∈ B, s x = j

    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] (M : V →ₗ[K] (I → K))
    (R : (I → K) ≃ₗ[K] (J → K)) (b : I → K) :
    Witnesses (equationProblem (fun x => R (M x)) (R b)) Set.univ =
      Witnesses (equationProblem M b) Set.univ

label: affine_source_certificate_trichotomy
name: UniversalObservation.Transport.affine_source_certificate_trichotomy
statement:
theorem affine_source_certificate_trichotomy {K V I : Type} [Field K] [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V] [Fintype I] (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (b : I → K)
    (L : V →ₗ[K] K) :
    (∃ c : I → K, (∑ i, c i • rows i) = 0 ∧ (∑ i, c i * b i) ≠ 0) ∨
    (∃ (p : V) (c : I → K), p ∈ Witnesses (affineEquationProblem rows b) Set.univ ∧
      (∑ i, c i • rows i) = L) ∨
    (∃ p k, p ∈ Witnesses (affineEquationProblem rows b) Set.univ ∧
      (∀ i, rows i k = 0) ∧ L k ≠ 0)

theorem forward_budget_transport {I J W V B C : Type*} [Preorder B] [Preorder C]
    (P : Problem I W) (Q : Problem J V) (di : I → J) (wi : W → V)
    (hs : ∀ w i, P.sat w i → Q.sat (wi w) (di i))
    (cost : W → B) (cost' : V → C) (phi : B → C) (hp : Monotone phi)
    (hc : ∀ w, cost' (wi w) ≤ phi (cost w)) (D : Set I) (b : B) :
    (∃ w, w ∈ Witnesses P D ∧ cost w ≤ b) →
      ∃ v, v ∈ Witnesses Q (di '' D) ∧ cost' v ≤ phi b

    (hm : e.MenuCorrespondence p q) (D : Set I) (k : ℕ)
    (cost : LicensedPlan P p D k → ℕ → ℝ)

label: boundary_singularity_limits
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.DiscriminationLimits.boundary_singularity_limits
statement:
theorem boundary_singularity_limits {X Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (q : X → Y) (K : ℕ → BoundaryPole.Reading X Y) (x x' : X)
    (hx : ∀ y, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (K n x).mass y) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (pointMass (q x) y)))
    (hx' : ∀ y, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (K n x').mass y) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (pointMass (q x') y))) :
    (q x = q x' →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination (K n) x x')
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
        (∀ n, 0 < BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination (K n) x x') →
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n => c * Real.log 2 / BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination (K n) x x')
          Filter.atTop Filter.atTop) ∧
    (q x ≠ q x' →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => BoundaryPole.readingDiscrimination (K n) x x')
        Filter.atTop (nhds 2))

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.DiscriminationLimits.exists_zero_error_decoder_iff_discrimination_eq_two

theorem exists_zero_error_decoder_iff_discrimination_eq_two {Y : Type} [Fintype Y]

       (if d (delayedRead stage true) = true then 1 else 0)) / 2 ≤ delayedPay stage) ∧
    (∃ d : Option Bool → Bool,

       (if d (delayedRead stage true) = true then 1 else 0)) / 2 = delayedPay stage)

label: checkE
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.EqualityRepair.checkE
statement:
def checkE : ProofTree → Option Formula
  | .ax φ => if isAxiomE φ then some φ else none
  | .mp p q =>
      match checkE p, checkE q with
      | some (Formula.imp a b), some c => if a = c then some b else none
      | _, _ => none
  | .gen x p =>
      match checkE p with
      | some φ => some (Formula.all x φ)
      | none => none
  | .spec x t p =>
      match checkE p with
      | some (Formula.all y φ) =>
          if decide (x = y) && isClosedTerm t then some (substForm x t φ) else none
      | _ => none

  | Formula.imp (Formula.eq s s') (Formula.imp (Formula.eq t t')
      (Formula.eq (Term.add a b) (Term.add a' b'))) =>
      decide (a = s ∧ a' = s' ∧ b = t ∧ b' = t')
  | _ => false

label: check_to_checkE
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.EqualityRepair.check_to_checkE
statement:
theorem check_to_checkE :
    ∀ p : ProofTree, ∀ φ : Formula, check p = some φ → checkE p = some φ
  | .ax ψ, φ, h => by
      simp [check] at h
      rcases h with ⟨hax, rfl⟩
      simp [checkE, isAxiomE_of_isAxiom hax]
  | .mp p q, φ, h => by
      cases hp : check p with
      | none => simp [check, hp] at h
      | some a =>
        cases hq : check q with
        | none => simp [check, hp, hq] at h
        | some c =>
          cases a with
          | imp u v =>
              simp [check, hp, hq] at h
              rcases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
              have hpE := check_to_checkE p (Formula.imp u v) hp
              have hqE := check_to_checkE q u hq
              simp [checkE, hpE, hqE]
          | eq _ _ => simp [check, hp, hq] at h
          | not _ => simp [check, hp, hq] at h
          | all _ _ => simp [check, hp, hq] at h
  | .gen x p, φ, h => by
      cases hp : check p with
      | none => simp [check, hp] at h
      | some ψ =>
          simp [check, hp] at h
          cases h
          have hpE := check_to_checkE p ψ hp
          simp [checkE, hpE]
  | .spec x t p, φ, h => by
      cases hp : check p with
      | none => simp [check, hp] at h
      | some a =>
        cases a with
        | all y ψ =>
          simp [check, hp] at h
          rcases h with ⟨⟨rfl, ht⟩, rfl⟩
          have hpE := check_to_checkE p (Formula.all x ψ) hp
          simp [checkE, hpE, ht]
        | eq _ _ => simp [check, hp] at h
        | not _ => simp [check, hp] at h
        | imp _ _ => simp [check, hp] at h

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.EqualityRepair.pE_closed_numeral
statement:
theorem pE_closed_numeral : ∀ t : Term, isClosedTerm t = true →
    ProvableE (Formula.eq t (numeral (evalTerm env0 t)))
  | Term.zero, _ => pE_refl Term.zero
  | Term.succ t, h => pE_succ (pE_closed_numeral t h)
  | Term.add s t, h => by
      simp only [isClosedTerm, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      exact pE_trans (pE_add (pE_closed_numeral s h.1) (pE_closed_numeral t h.2)) (pE_numAdd _ _)
  | Term.mul s t, h => by
      simp only [isClosedTerm, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
      exact pE_trans (pE_mul (pE_closed_numeral s h.1) (pE_closed_numeral t h.2)) (pE_numMul _ _)
  | Term.var _, h => by simp [isClosedTerm] at h

    ∀ n : Nat, ProvableE (Formula.eq (Term.add (numeral m) (numeral n)) (numeral (m + n)))
  | 0 => pE_q3 m
  | n + 1 => pE_trans (pE_q4 m n) (pE_succ (pE_numAdd m n))

  | 0 => pE_q5 m
  | n + 1 => pE_trans (pE_trans (pE_q6 m n) (pE_add (pE_numMul m n) (pE_refl (numeral m))))
      (pE_numAdd (m * n) m)

label: godel_equality_repair
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.EqualityRepairGodel.godel_equality_repair
statement:
theorem godel_equality_repair :
    (∀ φ, Provable φ → ProvableE φ) ∧
    Primrec₂ proofRelE ∧
    (∀ φ, (∃ n, proofRelE n (encodeFormula φ) = true) ↔ ProvableE φ) ∧
    (∀ φ, ProvableE φ → ∀ env, evalForm env φ) ∧
    (∀ s t : Term, isClosedTerm s = true → isClosedTerm t = true →
      (ProvableE (Formula.eq s t) ↔ evalTerm env0 s = evalTerm env0 t)) ∧
    (∃ γE : Formula, IsSentence γE ∧ (evalForm env0 γE ↔ ¬ ProvableE γE) ∧ ¬ ProvableE γE ∧
      ¬ ProvableE (Formula.not γE)) ∧
    (∀ prf : ℕ → ℕ → Bool, Primrec₂ prf → (∀ φ, ProvBy prf φ → evalForm env0 φ) →
      ∃ γ : Formula, IsSentence γ ∧ (evalForm env0 γ ↔ ¬ ProvBy prf γ) ∧ ¬ ProvBy prf γ ∧
        ¬ ProvBy prf (Formula.not γ))

label: godel_equality_repair_corollary
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.EqualityRepairGodel.godel_equality_repair_corollary
statement:
theorem godel_equality_repair_corollary :
    DirectGrammarBoundary.OperationallyInexpressibleAt provabilityObserverE truthTarget
      gammaE (Formula.not gammaE) ∧
    (((∃ S : Set Formula,
          LiftOrRefuse.MaximalLicensedOn S provabilityObserverE truthTarget ∧
          gammaE ∈ S ∧ Formula.not gammaE ∉ S) ∧
      ∃ T : Set Formula,
          LiftOrRefuse.MaximalLicensedOn T provabilityObserverE truthTarget ∧
          Formula.not gammaE ∈ T ∧ gammaE ∉ T) ∧
      ¬ ∃ G : Set Formula,
          LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn G provabilityObserverE truthTarget ∧
          ∀ S : Set Formula, LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn S provabilityObserverE truthTarget → S ⊆ G) ∧
    (∀ (C : Type) (s : Formula → C),
      LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn gammaEPair
        (Confusability.augmentObserver provabilityObserverE s) truthTarget ↔
      s gammaE ≠ s (Formula.not gammaE)) ∧
    Equiv.swap gammaE (Formula.not gammaE) ∈
      LicenseStabilizer.licenseStabilizer provabilityObserverE ∧
    (∃ Bew : Formula → Formula, ∀ φ, evalForm env0 (Bew φ) ↔ ProvableE φ) ∧
    (∀ Bew : Formula → Formula, (∀ φ, evalForm env0 (Bew φ) ↔ ProvableE φ) →
      ProvableE (Formula.imp (Formula.not (Bew falsum)) gammaE) →
      DirectGrammarBoundary.OperationallyInexpressibleAt provabilityObserverE truthTarget
        (Formula.not (Bew falsum)) (Formula.not (Formula.not (Bew falsum)))) ∧
    ProtocolResolution.entropy (ProtocolResolution.binaryPrior (1 / 2)) = 1

label: exclusiveCut_activeMass
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasurePriorCompletion.exclusiveCut_activeMass
statement:
theorem exclusiveCut_activeMass (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y)
    (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hr : ∀ h a z, p.observation h a z = PairResolution.row P Q z)
    (n : ℕ) (z : Bool) :
    activeMass (exclusiveCut p P Q) n z =
      p.prior.mass z * (1 - labelExclusive P Q z) ^ n

label: exclusiveCut_active_children
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasurePriorCompletion.exclusiveCut_active_children
statement:
theorem exclusiveCut_active_children (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y)
    (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hr : ∀ h a z, p.observation h a z = PairResolution.row P Q z)
    (n : ℕ) (z : Bool) (h : List (A × Y)) :
    (∑ e : A × Y,
      if (h ++ [e]).length = n + 1 ∧ (exclusiveCut p P Q).stop (h ++ [e]) = false
      then prefixMass (exclusiveCut p P Q) z (h ++ [e]) else 0) =
    (if h.length = n ∧ (exclusiveCut p P Q).stop h = false
      then prefixMass (exclusiveCut p P Q) z h else 0) * (1 - labelExclusive P Q z)

      p.prior = μ ∧
      (∀ h a z, p.observation h a z = PairResolution.row P Q z) ∧
      (∀ h a, 1 ≤ p.cost h a) ∧
      ZeroError p d ∧ extendedCost p < ⊤) ↔

      (∃ y, 0 < Q.mass y ∧ P.mass y = 0)

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasurePriorCompletion.firstExclusiveWith_positive_prior_recovery
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_positive_prior_recovery
    (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (ha : 0 < exclusiveMass P Q) (hb : 0 < exclusiveMass Q P) :
    (∀ z, Tendsto (fun n => activeMass (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) n z)
      atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
    ZeroError (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) (firstExclusiveDecoder Q) ∧
    informationLimit (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) = entropy μ.mass ∧
    extendedCost (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) =
      ENNReal.ofReal
        (μ.mass true / exclusiveMass P Q +
          (1 - μ.mass true) / exclusiveMass Q P) ∧
    extendedCost (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (max (1 / exclusiveMass P Q) (1 / exclusiveMass Q P))

label: erasure_fixed_horizon_ambiguous
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.erasure_fixed_horizon_ambiguous
statement:
theorem erasure_fixed_horizon_ambiguous (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)
    (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ z : Bool,
      stoppedMass (PairResolution.repeatProtocol (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 true)
        (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 false) n) n z (erasureHistory n) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - p) ^ n) ∧
    (∀ decoder : List (Unit × Option Bool) → Bool,
      ∃ z : Bool, decoder (erasureHistory n) ≠ z ∧
        0 < stoppedMass (PairResolution.repeatProtocol (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 true)
          (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 false) n) n z (erasureHistory n))

label: erasure_fixed_horizon_positive_error
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.erasure_fixed_horizon_positive_error
statement:
theorem erasure_fixed_horizon_positive_error
    (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) (n : ℕ) :
    (∀ z : Bool,
      PairResolution.likelihood (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 true)
        (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 false) z (erasureHistory n) =
        (1 - p) ^ n) ∧
    0 < (1 - p) ^ n ∧
    (∀ decoder : List (Unit × Option Bool) → Bool,
      ∃ z : Bool, decoder (erasureHistory n) ≠ z ∧
        0 < stoppedMass (PairResolution.repeatProtocol (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 true)
          (erasureLaw p hp0 hp1 false) n) n z (erasureHistory n))

label: exclusive_outputs_recovery
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.exclusive_outputs_recovery
statement:
theorem exclusive_outputs_recovery (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hP : ∃ y, 0 < P.mass y ∧ Q.mass y = 0) (hQ : ∃ y, 0 < Q.mass y ∧ P.mass y = 0) :
    (∀ z : Bool, Tendsto (fun n => activeMass (firstExclusive P Q) n z) atTop (𝓝 0)) ∧
    (∀ z : Bool, ∀ h : List (Unit × Y), firstExclusiveDecoder Q h ≠ z →
      transcriptMass (firstExclusive P Q) z h = 0) ∧
    informationLimit (firstExclusive P Q) = 1 ∧
    labelCost (firstExclusive P Q) true = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / exclusiveMass P Q) ∧
    labelCost (firstExclusive P Q) false = ENNReal.ofReal (1 / exclusiveMass Q P) ∧
    (∀ z : Bool, labelCost (firstExclusive P Q) z ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (max (1 / exclusiveMass P Q) (1 / exclusiveMass Q P))) ∧
    extendedCost (firstExclusive P Q) =
      ENNReal.ofReal ((1 / exclusiveMass P Q + 1 / exclusiveMass Q P) / 2) ∧
    extendedCost (firstExclusive P Q) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (max (1 / exclusiveMass P Q) (1 / exclusiveMass Q P))

label: exists_zeroError_finite_cost_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.exists_zeroError_finite_cost_iff
statement:
theorem exists_zeroError_finite_cost_iff (P Q : FiniteLaw W) :
    (∃ (p : FiniteProtocol Bool Unit W) (d : List (Unit × W) → Bool),
      p.prior = ResolutionAttainment.fairLaw ∧ (∀ h a z, p.observation h a z = row P Q z) ∧
      (∀ h a, 1 ≤ p.cost h a) ∧ ZeroError p d ∧ extendedCost p < ⊤) ↔
      (∃ y, 0 < P.mass y ∧ Q.mass y = 0) ∧ (∃ y, 0 < Q.mass y ∧ P.mass y = 0)

label: expectedCost_ge_activeMass
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.expectedCost_ge_activeMass
statement:

    c * ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range n, activeMass p ℓ z ≤ expectedCost p n (historyBank A W n)

label: extendedCost_eq_sum_labelCost

theorem firstDefinite_expectedCost_geom (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1)

theorem firstDefinite_expected_cost (p : ℝ) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p < 1) :

label: firstDefinite_prefixMass_wrong

label: firstExclusiveWith_activeMass
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_activeMass
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_activeMass (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (n : ℕ) (z : Bool) :
    activeMass (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) n z = μ.mass z * (1 - labelExclusive P Q z) ^ n

label: firstExclusiveWith_active_children
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_active_children
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_active_children (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (n : ℕ) (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    (∑ e : Unit × Y,
      if (h ++ [e]).length = n + 1 ∧ (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q).stop (h ++ [e]) = false
      then prefixMass (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) z (h ++ [e]) else 0) =
    (if h.length = n ∧ (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q).stop h = false
      then prefixMass (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) z h else 0) * (1 - labelExclusive P Q z)

label: firstExclusiveWith_cost_tendsto
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_cost_tendsto
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_cost_tendsto (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 < μ.mass z → 0 < labelExclusive P Q z) :
    Tendsto (fun n => expectedCost (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) n (historyBank Unit Y n))
      atTop (𝓝 (∑ z : Bool, μ.mass z / labelExclusive P Q z))

label: firstExclusiveWith_expectedCost_at
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_expectedCost_at
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_expectedCost_at (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)

    expectedCost (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) n (historyBank Unit Y n) =
      ∑ z : Bool, μ.mass z * ∑ ℓ ∈ Finset.range n, (1 - labelExclusive P Q z) ^ ℓ

theorem firstExclusiveWith_expectedCost_sum_active (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)

label: firstExclusiveWith_extendedCost
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_extendedCost
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_extendedCost (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 < μ.mass z → 0 < labelExclusive P Q z) :
    extendedCost (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) =
      ENNReal.ofReal (∑ z : Bool, μ.mass z / labelExclusive P Q z)

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_extendedCost_le_max
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_extendedCost_le_max (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)

    extendedCost (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal (max (1 / exclusiveMass P Q) (1 / exclusiveMass Q P))

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_historyCost

theorem firstExclusiveWith_historyCost (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)

label: firstExclusiveWith_information
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_information
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_information (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hpos : ∀ z, 0 < μ.mass z → 0 < labelExclusive P Q z) :
    informationLimit (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q) = entropy μ.mass

label: firstExclusiveWith_prefixMass_eq_zero

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_stop_append
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_stop_append (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (h : List (Unit × Y)) (ay : Unit × Y) :
    (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q).stop (h ++ [ay]) = true ↔
      (firstExclusiveWith μ P Q).stop h = true ∨ Decisive P Q ay.2

label: firstExclusiveWith_stop_append_false
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_stop_append_false
statement:
theorem firstExclusiveWith_stop_append_false (μ : FiniteLaw Bool) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)

label: firstExclusiveWith_stop_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ErasureReading.firstExclusiveWith_stop_iff
statement:

    BoundarySingularity.discrimination P Q ^ 2 / (8 * Real.log 2) ≤

label: fair_bound_attained_split
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FairReadingBound.fair_bound_attained_split
statement:
theorem fair_bound_attained_split {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (y₀ y₁ : Y)
    (hne : y₀ ≠ y₁) :
    ProtocolResolution.jointMI (fun by_ : Bool × Y =>
        ProtocolResolution.binaryPrior (1 / 2) by_.1 *
          (if by_.2 = (if by_.1 then y₀ else y₁) then 1 else 0)) = 1 ∧
      BoundarySingularity.discrimination (fun y => if y = y₀ then (1 : ℝ) else 0)
        (fun y => if y = y₁ then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 2

label: fair_entropy_gap_point_eq
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FairReadingBound.fair_entropy_gap_point_eq
statement:
private theorem fair_entropy_gap_point_eq (a b : ℝ) (hs : 0 < a + b) :
    ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm ((a + b) / 2) -
        (ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm a + ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm b) / 2 =
      ((a + b) / 2) * (1 - Real.binEntropy (a / (a + b)) / Real.log 2)

label: fair_entropy_gap_point_ge
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FairReadingBound.fair_entropy_gap_point_ge
statement:
private theorem fair_entropy_gap_point_ge (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    ((a - b) ^ 2 / (a + b)) / (4 * Real.log 2) ≤
      ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm ((a + b) / 2) -
        (ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm a + ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm b) / 2

label: fair_entropy_gap_point_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FairReadingBound.fair_entropy_gap_point_le
statement:

    ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm ((a + b) / 2) -
        (ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm a + ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm b) / 2 ≤
      ((a - b) ^ 2 / (a + b)) / 2

label: fair_information_eq_sum_gap
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FairReadingBound.fair_information_eq_sum_gap
statement:
private theorem fair_information_eq_sum_gap {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] (K : Bool → Y → ℝ)
    (hK1 : ∀ b, ∑ y, K b y = 1) :
    ProtocolResolution.jointMI
        (fun by_ : Bool × Y => ProtocolResolution.binaryPrior (1 / 2) by_.1 * K by_.1 by_.2) =
      ∑ y, (ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm ((K true y + K false y) / 2) -
        (ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm (K true y) +
          ProtocolResolution.entropyTerm (K false y)) / 2)

statement:

    (hK0 : ∀ b y, 0 ≤ K b y) (hK1 : ∀ b, ∑ y, K b y = 1) :
    BoundarySingularity.discrimination (K true) (K false) ^ 2 / (8 * Real.log 2) ≤
        totalVariation (K true) (K false) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.log 2) ∧
      totalVariation (K true) (K false) ^ 2 / (2 * Real.log 2) ≤
        ProtocolResolution.jointMI
          (fun by_ : Bool × Y => ProtocolResolution.binaryPrior (1 / 2) by_.1 * K by_.1 by_.2) ∧
      BoundarySingularity.discrimination (K true) (K false) / (4 * Real.log 2) ≤
        ProtocolResolution.jointMI
          (fun by_ : Bool × Y => ProtocolResolution.binaryPrior (1 / 2) by_.1 * K by_.1 by_.2) ∧
      ProtocolResolution.jointMI
          (fun by_ : Bool × Y => ProtocolResolution.binaryPrior (1 / 2) by_.1 * K by_.1 by_.2) ≤
        BoundarySingularity.discrimination (K true) (K false) / 2

    (hdisc : ∀ b c, b ≠ c →
      Δmin ≤ discrimination (K b).mass (K c).mass)
    (hml : ∀ h b, fiberLikelihood K b h ≤ fiberLikelihood K (g h) h) :

label: finite_negMulLog_mix_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.finite_negMulLog_mix_le
statement:
private theorem finite_negMulLog_mix_le {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (w a : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) (ha : ∀ b, 0 ≤ a b) :
    Real.negMulLog (∑ b, w b * a b) -
        ∑ b, w b * Real.negMulLog (a b) ≤
      (∑ b, w b * (a b * (a b - ∑ c, w c * a c))) /
        (∑ b, w b * a b)

label: finite_negMulLog_pairwise_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.finite_negMulLog_pairwise_le
statement:
private theorem finite_negMulLog_pairwise_le {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (w a : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) (ha : ∀ b, 0 ≤ a b)
    (hw1 : ∑ b, w b = 1) :
    Real.negMulLog (∑ b, w b * a b) -
        ∑ b, w b * Real.negMulLog (a b) ≤
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) *
        (∑ b, ∑ c, (w b + w c) * (a b - a c) ^ 2 / (a b + a c))

label: finite_ordered_weight_count
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.finite_ordered_weight_count
statement:
private theorem finite_ordered_weight_count {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℝ)
    (hw1 : ∑ b, w b = 1) :
    (∑ b, ∑ c, if b ≠ c then w b + w c else 0) =
      2 * ((n : ℝ) - 1)

label: finite_pairwise_chi_bound
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.finite_pairwise_chi_bound
statement:
private theorem finite_pairwise_chi_bound {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (w a : B → ℝ) (hw : ∀ b, 0 ≤ w b) (ha : ∀ b, 0 ≤ a b) :
    (∑ b, ∑ c, w b * w c * (a b - a c) ^ 2 /
      (∑ d, w d * a d)) ≤
    (∑ b, ∑ c, (w b + w c) * (a b - a c) ^ 2 / (a b + a c))

label: finite_weighted_variance
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.finite_weighted_variance
statement:
private theorem finite_weighted_variance {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    (w a : B → ℝ) (hw1 : ∑ b, w b = 1) :
    (∑ b, w b * (a b * (a b - ∑ c, w c * a c))) =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (∑ b, ∑ c, w b * w c * (a b - a c) ^ 2)

label: massUncertainty_le_error_split
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.massUncertainty_le_error_split
statement:
private theorem massUncertainty_le_error_split {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (m : Fin n → ℝ) (hm : ∀ z, 0 ≤ m z) (g0 : Fin n) :
    massUncertainty m ≤
      massUncertainty (fun b : Bool => cond b (∑ z, if g0 ≠ z then m z else 0) (m g0)) +
        (∑ z, if g0 ≠ z then m z else 0) * Real.log ((n : ℝ) - 1) / Real.log 2

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.pairwise_chi_term_le
statement:

    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hM : w * a + v * b ≤ m) :
    w * v * (a - b) ^ 2 / m ≤ (w + v) * (a - b) ^ 2 / (a + b)

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FiberResolution.prefixMass_repeatFiber

          ProtocolResolution.conditionalExtendedCost p

label: fisher_local_conditional_limit_reciprocal
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.FisherDiscrimination.fisher_local_conditional_limit_reciprocal
statement:
theorem fisher_local_conditional_limit_reciprocal {H0 A Y : Type}
    [Fintype H0] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y]
    (P : ℝ → Y → ℝ) (θ ε : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ y, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun t => P t y))
    (hpos : ∀ y, 0 < P θ y) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∀ᶠ t in nhds θ, ∀ (p : ProtocolResolution.ConditionalProtocol H0 Bool A Y)
      (_ : BoundarySingularity.ConditionalPairMenu p
        (BoundarySingularity.discrimination (P θ) (P t)))
      (c budget : ℝ), 0 ≤ budget →
      c ≤ ProtocolResolution.conditionalInformationLimit p →
      ProtocolResolution.conditionalExtendedCost p ≤ ENNReal.ofReal budget →
      t ≠ θ →
      c * Real.log 2 / ((fisherInformation P θ / 2 + ε) *
        (t - θ) ^ 2) ≤ budget

    (hsπ : s ≤ Real.pi) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (htπ : t ≤ Real.pi) (h1 : |s - t| ≤ β) (h2 : β ≤ s + t)
    (h3 : β + s + t ≤ 2 * Real.pi) :
    ∃ a b c : ℝ, a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 + c ^ 2 = 1 ∧ a = Real.cos s ∧

    (h02 : covarianceMatrix (fun i x => x i) μ 0 2 = FourTestTables.corr d false false)
    (h03 : covarianceMatrix (fun i x => x i) μ 0 3 = FourTestTables.corr d false true)
    (h12 : covarianceMatrix (fun i x => x i) μ 1 2 = FourTestTables.corr d true false)
    (h13 : covarianceMatrix (fun i x => x i) μ 1 3 = FourTestTables.corr d true true) :
    FourTestTables.HasVectors d

    Var[L; μ] = ∑ i, ∑ j,

label: godel_pair_corollary
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.GodelPairSideSymbol.godel_pair_corollary
statement:
theorem godel_pair_corollary :
    DirectGrammarBoundary.OperationallyInexpressibleAt provabilityObserver truthTarget
      arithGodelSentence (Formula.not arithGodelSentence) ∧
    (((∃ S : Set Formula,
          LiftOrRefuse.MaximalLicensedOn S provabilityObserver truthTarget ∧
          arithGodelSentence ∈ S ∧ Formula.not arithGodelSentence ∉ S) ∧
      ∃ T : Set Formula,
          LiftOrRefuse.MaximalLicensedOn T provabilityObserver truthTarget ∧
          Formula.not arithGodelSentence ∈ T ∧ arithGodelSentence ∉ T) ∧
      ¬ ∃ G : Set Formula,
          LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn G provabilityObserver truthTarget ∧
          ∀ S : Set Formula, LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn S provabilityObserver truthTarget → S ⊆ G) ∧
    (∀ (C : Type) (s : Formula → C),
      LiftOrRefuse.LicensedOn godelPair
        (Confusability.augmentObserver provabilityObserver s) truthTarget ↔
      s arithGodelSentence ≠ s (Formula.not arithGodelSentence)) ∧
    Equiv.swap arithGodelSentence (Formula.not arithGodelSentence) ∈
      LicenseStabilizer.licenseStabilizer provabilityObserver

        (Confusability.augmentObserver provabilityObserver s) truthTarget ↔
      s arithGodelSentence ≠ s (Formula.not arithGodelSentence)

    (∀ m m' c : G, BoundarySecrecy.cipherLaw (uniformKey G) groupEnc m c =

statement:
theorem halting_terminal_gap (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ cPos cNeg : Nat.Partrec.Code, (cPos.eval b).Dom ∧ ¬ (cNeg.eval b).Dom ∧
      Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln b cPos b = Nat.Partrec.Code.evaln b cNeg b ∧
      ∀ {A Y : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype Y] (R : BoundedRecordProtocol A Y),
        (∀ n bank, HistoryBank n bank →
          terminalMI (toProtocol b cPos cNeg R) n bank = 0 ∧
            entropy (toProtocol b cPos cNeg R).prior.mass -

    (∀ x : V, quotientAction K A C ((unobservable K A C).mkQ x) =
      (unobservable K A C).mkQ (A x)) ∧
    ∃! f : (V ⧸ unobservable K A C) →
      AdmissibleObservation.MinimalState (C : V → W)
        (fun _ : Unit => (A : V → V)),

label: kalman_example
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.KalmanSideRecord.kalman_example
statement:
theorem kalman_example (K : Type*) [Field K] {V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] V) (C : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    (∀ x y : V, behavioralRecord K A C x = behavioralRecord K A C y ↔
      x - y ∈ unobservable K A C) ∧
    (unobservable K A C =
      ⨅ i : Fin (Module.finrank K V), LinearMap.ker (C.comp (A ^ (i : ℕ)))) ∧
    (LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C) = unobservable K A C) ∧
    (∀ x y : V, MergedPair.IsMergedPair (behavioralRecord K A C) x y ↔
      x ≠ y ∧ x - y ∈ LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C)) ∧
    (∀ v : V, Equiv.addRight v ∈ licenseStabilizer (behavioralRecord K A C) ↔
      v ∈ LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C)) ∧
    (MergedPair.boundary (behavioralRecord K A C) = ∅ ↔
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (stackedObservability K A C)) =
        Module.finrank K V) ∧
    (∀ π : V →ₗ[K] V, LinearMap.IsProj (LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C)) π →
      ∀ x y : V, MergedPair.IsMergedPair (behavioralRecord K A C) x y → π x ≠ π y) ∧
    (∃ π : V →ₗ[K] V, LinearMap.IsProj (LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C)) π)

theorem behavioral_equiv_iff_mem_ker_obs (K : Type*) [Field K] {V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] V) (C : V →ₗ[K] W) (x y : V) :

    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] V) (C : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    Function.Injective (behavioralRecord K A C) ↔
      Module.finrank K (LinearMap.range (stackedObservability K A C)) =
        Module.finrank K V

label: unobservable_largest_invariant_subspace
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.LinearObservability.unobservable_largest_invariant_subspace
statement:
theorem unobservable_largest_invariant_subspace (K : Type*) [Field K] {V W : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V]
    [AddCommGroup W] [Module K W]
    (A : V →ₗ[K] V) (C : V →ₗ[K] W) :
    (∀ x ∈ LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C),
      A x ∈ LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C)) ∧
    LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C) ≤ LinearMap.ker C ∧
    ∀ S : Submodule K V, (∀ x ∈ S, A x ∈ S) →
      S ≤ LinearMap.ker C → S ≤ LinearMap.ker (stackedObservability K A C)

statement:
theorem mergedPair_separating_tests {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X] {x₀ x₁ : X} (hne : x₀ ≠ x₁) :
    (∀ f : X → Bool, f x₀ ≠ f x₁ →
        (f x₀ = decide (x₀ = x₀) ∧ f x₁ = decide (x₁ = x₀)) ∨
          (f x₀ = decide (x₀ = x₁) ∧ f x₁ = decide (x₁ = x₁))) ∧
      (∀ a ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), decide (a = x₁) = !decide (a = x₀)) ∧
      (∀ a : X, decide (Equiv.swap x₀ x₁ a = x₀) = decide (a = x₁)) ∧
      (∀ f : X → Bool, (∀ a, f (Equiv.swap x₀ x₁ a) = f a) ↔ f x₀ = f x₁)

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleFisher.fDivergence_quadratic_fisher
statement:
theorem fDivergence_quadratic_fisher {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] (P : ℝ → Y → ℝ) (θ : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => P t y) θ) (hpos : ∀ y, 0 < P θ y)
    (hsum : ∀ t, ∑ y, P t y = 1) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf1 : f 1 = 0) (hf : TwiceDifferentiableAt f 1) :
    (fun t => ∑ y, P θ y * f (P t y / P θ y) -
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * deriv (deriv f) 1 * fisherInformation P θ * (t - θ) ^ 2) =o[𝓝 θ]
      (fun t => (t - θ) ^ 2)

label: fisher_cost_value_forms
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleFisher.fisher_cost_value_forms
statement:
theorem fisher_cost_value_forms (c I ζ δθ : ℝ) (hζ : 0 < ζ) (hδ : δθ ≠ 0) :
    (0 < I → c * Real.log 2 / ((I / 2 + ζ) * δθ ^ 2) =
        2 * c * Real.log 2 / (I * δθ ^ 2) * (1 + 2 * ζ / I)⁻¹) ∧
      (I = 0 → c * Real.log 2 / ((I / 2 + ζ) * δθ ^ 2) = c * Real.log 2 / (ζ * δθ ^ 2))

label: fisher_repetition_attains
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleFisher.fisher_repetition_attains
statement:
theorem fisher_repetition_attains {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] (P : ℝ → Y → ℝ) (θ ζ : ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => P t y) θ) (hpos : ∀ y, 0 < P θ y)
    (hlaw : ∀ t, (∀ y, 0 ≤ P t y) ∧ ∑ y, P t y = 1) (hζ : 0 < ζ)
    (hζI : ζ < fisherInformation P θ / 2) (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 θ, t ≠ θ → ∃ N : ℕ,
      1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
          terminalMI (repeatProtocol (lawAt P hlaw θ) (lawAt P hlaw t) N) N
            (historyBank Unit Y N) ∧
        expectedCost (repeatProtocol (lawAt P hlaw θ) (lawAt P hlaw t) N) N
            (historyBank Unit Y N) = N ∧
        (N : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / ((fisherInformation P θ / 2 - ζ) * (t - θ) ^ 2)
          + 1

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleFisher.zero_fisher_cost_exceeds_every_multiple
statement:
theorem zero_fisher_cost_exceeds_every_multiple {H0 A Y : Type} [Fintype H0] [Fintype A]
    [Fintype Y] (P : ℝ → Y → ℝ) (θ : ℝ) (hP : ∀ y, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t => P t y) θ)
    (hpos : ∀ y, 0 < P θ y) (hI : fisherInformation P θ = 0) (c M : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hM : 0 < M) :
    ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 θ, ∀ (p : ProtocolResolution.ConditionalProtocol H0 Bool A Y)
      (_ : ConditionalPairMenu p (discrimination (P θ) (P t)))
      (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))),
      ProtocolResolution.HistoryBank n bank →
      c ≤ ProtocolResolution.conditionalJointInfo p n bank → t ≠ θ →
        M / (t - θ) ^ 2 ≤ ProtocolResolution.conditionalExpectedCost p n bank

label: fisher_loss_attained
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleProtocols.fisher_loss_attained
statement:
theorem fisher_loss_attained (F : ParametricFamily Ω) (K : Channel Ω Γ) :
    fisherInformation F - fisherInformation (attainedFamily F K) =
        ∑ γ, ∑ ω, F.probability ω * ((restrictAttained F K).row ω).mass γ *
          (score F ω - score (attainedFamily F K) γ) ^ 2 ∧
      fisherInformation F - fisherInformation (attainedFamily F K) =
        ∑ γ, (attainedFamily F K).probability γ *
          condScoreVar F (attainedFamily F K) (restrictAttained F K) γ ∧
      fisherInformation (attainedFamily F K) ≤ fisherInformation F ∧
      (fisherInformation (attainedFamily F K) = fisherInformation F ↔
        ∀ ω ω' (γ : Γ), 0 < (K.row ω).mass γ → 0 < (K.row ω').mass γ →
          score F ω = score F ω')

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleProtocols.fisher_loss_attained_deterministic
statement:

    (f : Ω → Γ) :
    (fisherInformation (attainedFamily F (Channel.deterministic f)) = fisherInformation F ↔
        ∀ ω ω', f ω = f ω' → score F ω = score F ω') ∧
      (fisherInformation (attainedFamily F (Channel.deterministic f)) < fisherInformation F ↔
        ∃ ω ω', f ω = f ω' ∧ score F ω ≠ score F ω')

    (ht : ∀ γ, G.tangent γ = ∑ ω, F.tangent ω * (K.row ω).mass γ) :
    fisherInformation F - fisherInformation G =
      ∑ γ, G.probability γ * condScoreVar F G K γ

theorem kernel_pair_no_readout (rows : I → V →ₗ[K] K) (b : I → K) (L : V →ₗ[K] K) (p k : V)
    (hp : Satisfies rows b p) (hk : ∀ i, rows i k = 0) (hl : L k ≠ 0) :
    Satisfies rows b (p + k) ∧ (fun i => rows i (p + k)) = (fun i => rows i p) ∧
      L p ≠ L (p + k) ∧

        mainCost (discrimination P.mass Q.mass) c ∧

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ObservationPrincipleProtocols.repeat_error_chain
statement:
theorem repeat_error_chain {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] (P Q : FiniteLaw Y) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ h ∈ historySet (Unit × Y) N,
        stoppedMass (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (!mapDecoder P Q h) h ≤
      1 / 2 * (bhattacharyya P.mass Q.mass) ^ N ∧
    1 / 2 * (bhattacharyya P.mass Q.mass) ^ N ≤
      1 / 2 * (1 - discrimination P.mass Q.mass / 4) ^ N ∧
    1 / 2 * (1 - discrimination P.mass Q.mass / 4) ^ N ≤
      1 / 2 * Real.exp (-(N * discrimination P.mass Q.mass / 4)) ∧
    expectedCost (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (historyBank Unit Y N) = N

statement:
theorem resolution_two_sided_discrimination (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Bool) (c : ℝ), BinaryMenu p ε →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Bool))), HistoryBank n bank →
        c ≤ terminalMI p n bank → 2 * c / (8 * ε ^ 2) ≤ expectedCost p n bank) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ 1 / 2 → ∃ N : ℕ,
      1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
          terminalMI (ResolutionAttainment.majorityProtocol ε hε0.le hε1 N) N
            (historyBank Unit Bool N) ∧
        expectedCost (ResolutionAttainment.majorityProtocol ε hε0.le hε1 N) N
            (historyBank Unit Bool N) = N ∧
        (N : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (8 * ε ^ 2) + 3)

        (e.state x) = e.state (run step (executedTrace q step test x) x) ∧
      evaluate q' step' (translate e.action e.record value test) (e.state x) =
        value (evaluate q step test x)

statement:
theorem swap_invariant_relations_four {X : Type*} [DecidableEq X] {x₀ x₁ : X} (hne : x₀ ≠ x₁)
    (R : X → X → Prop) :
    (∀ a ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), ∀ b ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X),
        (R (Equiv.swap x₀ x₁ a) (Equiv.swap x₀ x₁ b) ↔ R a b)) ↔
      ((∀ a ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), ∀ b ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), ¬ R a b) ∨
        (∀ a ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), ∀ b ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), (R a b ↔ a = b)) ∨
        (∀ a ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), ∀ b ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), (R a b ↔ a ≠ b)) ∨
        (∀ a ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), ∀ b ∈ ({x₀, x₁} : Set X), R a b))

    Realizable (contextVector context) p ↔
      ∃ w : (I → O) → ℝ, (∀ a, 0 ≤ w a) ∧ (∑ a, w a = 1) ∧
        ∀ c (s : {i // i ∈ context c} → O),
          p ⟨c, s⟩ = ∑ a, if (fun i : {i // i ∈ context c} => a i.1) = s then w a else 0

label: exists_stabilizer_matching_finsets
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairInvariants.exists_stabilizer_matching_finsets
statement:
theorem exists_stabilizer_matching_finsets {X Q : Type*} [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Q]
    (q : X → Q) (A : Finset X) :
    ∀ A' : Finset X,
      (∀ y : Q, (A.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card = (A'.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card) →
        ∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, ∀ z, z ∈ A' ↔ ∃ x ∈ A, σ x = z

label: finset_orbit_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairInvariants.finset_orbit_iff
statement:
theorem finset_orbit_iff {X Q : Type*} [DecidableEq X] [DecidableEq Q] (q : X → Q)
    (A A' : Finset X) :
    (∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, A.map σ.toEmbedding = A') ↔
      ∀ y : Q, (A.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card = (A'.filter (fun x => q x = y)).card

label: pair_invariant_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairInvariants.pair_invariant_iff
statement:
theorem pair_invariant_iff {X Q V : Type*} (q : X → Q) (F : X → X → V) :
    (∀ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, ∀ a a', F (σ a) (σ a') = F a a') ↔
      (∀ a a' b b', q a = q b → q a' = q b' → (a = a' ↔ b = b') → F a a' = F b b')

label: pair_orbit_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairInvariants.pair_orbit_iff
statement:
theorem pair_orbit_iff {X Q : Type*} (q : X → Q) (a a' b b' : X) :
    (∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, σ a = b ∧ σ a' = b') ↔
      (q a = q b ∧ q a' = q b' ∧ (a = a' ↔ b = b'))

label: point_stabilizer_invariant_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairInvariants.point_stabilizer_invariant_iff
statement:
theorem point_stabilizer_invariant_iff {C : Type*} (x : C) (f : C → Bool) :
    (∀ σ : Equiv.Perm C, σ x = x → ∀ c, f (σ c) = f c) ↔
      ∀ a b, a ≠ x → b ≠ x → f a = f b

label: point_stabilizer_transitive
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairInvariants.point_stabilizer_transitive
statement:
theorem point_stabilizer_transitive {C : Type*} (x a b : C) (ha : a ≠ x) (hb : b ≠ x) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm C, σ x = x ∧ σ a = b

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.bhattacharyya_le_one
statement:
theorem bhattacharyya_le_one (P Q : Y → ℝ) (hP0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ P y) (hQ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ Q y)
    (hP1 : ∑ y, P y = 1) (hQ1 : ∑ y, Q y = 1) : bhattacharyya P Q ≤ 1

label: bhattacharyya_le_one_sub_quarter_discrimination
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.bhattacharyya_le_one_sub_quarter_discrimination
statement:
theorem bhattacharyya_le_one_sub_quarter_discrimination (P Q : Y → ℝ) (hP0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ P y)
    (hQ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ Q y) (hP1 : ∑ y, P y = 1) (hQ1 : ∑ y, Q y = 1) :
    bhattacharyya P Q ≤ 1 - discrimination P Q / 4

label: bhattacharyya_level
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.bhattacharyya_level
statement:
theorem bhattacharyya_level (N : ℕ) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet (Unit × Y) N, if h.length = N then
      (h.map (fun ay => Real.sqrt (P.mass ay.2 * Q.mass ay.2))).prod else 0) =
      (bhattacharyya P.mass Q.mass) ^ N

label: bhattacharyya_nonneg
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.bhattacharyya_nonneg
statement: theorem bhattacharyya_nonneg (P Q : Y → ℝ) : 0 ≤ bhattacharyya P Q

label: deterministicRow_mass
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.deterministicRow_mass
statement:
theorem deterministicRow_mass (q : X → Y) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    (deterministicRow q x).mass y = if q x = y then 1 else 0

label: discrimination_le_four
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.discrimination_le_four
statement: theorem discrimination_le_four : discrimination P.mass Q.mass ≤ 4

label: discrimination_le_four_one_sub_bhattacharyya
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.discrimination_le_four_one_sub_bhattacharyya
statement:
theorem discrimination_le_four_one_sub_bhattacharyya (P Q : Y → ℝ) (hP0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ P y)
    (hQ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ Q y) (hP1 : ∑ y, P y = 1) (hQ1 : ∑ y, Q y = 1) :
    discrimination P Q ≤ 4 * (1 - bhattacharyya P Q)

label: discrimination_term_le_two_sq
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.discrimination_term_le_two_sq
statement:
theorem discrimination_term_le_two_sq (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    (a - b) ^ 2 / (a + b) ≤ 2 * (Real.sqrt a - Real.sqrt b) ^ 2

label: likelihood_append
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.likelihood_append
statement:
theorem likelihood_append (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Y)) (ay : Unit × Y) :
    likelihood P Q z (h ++ [ay]) = likelihood P Q z h * (row P Q z).mass ay.2

label: likelihood_false
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.likelihood_false
statement:
theorem likelihood_false (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    likelihood P Q false h = (h.map (fun ay => Q.mass ay.2)).prod

label: likelihood_nil
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.likelihood_nil
statement: theorem likelihood_nil (z : Bool) : likelihood P Q z [] = 1

label: likelihood_nonneg
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.likelihood_nonneg
statement: theorem likelihood_nonneg (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Y)) : 0 ≤ likelihood P Q z h

label: likelihood_rejected_le_min
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.likelihood_rejected_le_min
statement:
theorem likelihood_rejected_le_min (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    likelihood P Q (!mapDecoder P Q h) h ≤
      min (likelihood P Q true h) (likelihood P Q false h)

label: likelihood_true
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.likelihood_true
statement:
theorem likelihood_true (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    likelihood P Q true h = (h.map (fun ay => P.mass ay.2)).prod

label: merged_pair_no_information
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.merged_pair_no_information
statement:
theorem merged_pair_no_information (q : X → Y) (x x' : X) (hq : q x = q x') (N : ℕ) :
    terminalMI (repeatProtocol (deterministicRow q x) (deterministicRow q x') N) N
      (historyBank Unit Y N) = 0

label: min_le_sqrt_mul
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.min_le_sqrt_mul
statement:
theorem min_le_sqrt_mul (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hb : 0 ≤ b) :
    min a b ≤ Real.sqrt (a * b)

label: one_sub_bhattacharyya
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.one_sub_bhattacharyya
statement:
theorem one_sub_bhattacharyya (P Q : Y → ℝ) (hP0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ P y) (hQ0 : ∀ y, 0 ≤ Q y)
    (hP1 : ∑ y, P y = 1) (hQ1 : ∑ y, Q y = 1) :
    1 - bhattacharyya P Q = 1 / 2 * ∑ y, (Real.sqrt (P y) - Real.sqrt (Q y)) ^ 2

label: pair_resolution_two_sided
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.pair_resolution_two_sided
statement:
theorem pair_resolution_two_sided (P Q : FiniteLaw Y) (hΔ : 0 < discrimination P.mass Q.mass) :
    (∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Y) (c : ℝ),
      PairMenu p (discrimination P.mass Q.mass) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))), HistoryBank n bank →
        c ≤ terminalMI p n bank →
          c * Real.log 2 / discrimination P.mass Q.mass ≤ expectedCost p n bank) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ 1 / 2 → ∃ N : ℕ,
      1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
          terminalMI (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (historyBank Unit Y N) ∧
        expectedCost (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (historyBank Unit Y N) = N ∧
        (N : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass + 1)

label: prefixMass_repeat
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.prefixMass_repeat
statement:
theorem prefixMass_repeat (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Y)) (hl : h.length ≤ N) :
    prefixMass (repeatProtocol P Q N) z h = 1 / 2 * likelihood P Q z h

label: repeatProtocol_stop
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeatProtocol_stop
statement:
theorem repeatProtocol_stop (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    (repeatProtocol P Q N).stop h = decide (N ≤ h.length)

label: repeatProtocol_stop_false
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeatProtocol_stop_false
statement:
theorem repeatProtocol_stop_false {h : List (Unit × Y)} (hl : h.length < N) :
    (repeatProtocol P Q N).stop h = false

label: repeat_cost
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeat_cost
statement:
theorem repeat_cost :
    expectedCost (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (historyBank Unit Y N) = N

label: repeat_error_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeat_error_le
statement:
theorem repeat_error_le (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ h ∈ historySet (Unit × Y) N,
        stoppedMass (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (!mapDecoder P Q h) h ≤
      1 / 2 * (bhattacharyya P.mass Q.mass) ^ N

label: repeat_error_le_discrimination
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeat_error_le_discrimination
statement:
theorem repeat_error_le_discrimination (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ h ∈ historySet (Unit × Y) N,
        stoppedMass (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (!mapDecoder P Q h) h ≤
      1 / 2 * (1 - discrimination P.mass Q.mass / 4) ^ N

label: repeat_error_le_exp
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeat_error_le_exp
statement:
theorem repeat_error_le_exp (N : ℕ) :
    1 / 2 * (1 - discrimination P.mass Q.mass / 4) ^ N ≤
      1 / 2 * Real.exp (-(N * discrimination P.mass Q.mass / 4))

label: repeat_information
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeat_information
statement:
theorem repeat_information (N : ℕ) :
    1 - Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 * (bhattacharyya P.mass Q.mass) ^ N) / Real.log 2 ≤
      terminalMI (repeatProtocol P Q N) N (historyBank Unit Y N)

label: repeat_target
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.repeat_target
statement:
theorem repeat_target (hΔ : 0 < discrimination P.mass Q.mass) (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η)
    (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2) :
    1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
        terminalMI (repeatProtocol P Q ⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊)
          ⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊
          (historyBank Unit Y ⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊) ∧
      expectedCost (repeatProtocol P Q ⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊)
          ⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊
          (historyBank Unit Y ⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊) =
        ((⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      ((⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / discrimination P.mass Q.mass + 1

label: split_pair_one_reading
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.split_pair_one_reading
statement:
theorem split_pair_one_reading (q : X → Y) (x x' : X) (hq : q x ≠ q x') :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet (Unit × Y) 1,
      stoppedMass (repeatProtocol (deterministicRow q x) (deterministicRow q x') 1) 1
        (!mapDecoder (deterministicRow q x) (deterministicRow q x') h) h) = 0 ∧
    1 ≤ terminalMI (repeatProtocol (deterministicRow q x) (deterministicRow q x') 1) 1
        (historyBank Unit Y 1) ∧
    expectedCost (repeatProtocol (deterministicRow q x) (deterministicRow q x') 1) 1
        (historyBank Unit Y 1) = 1

label: sqrt_likelihood_mul
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.sqrt_likelihood_mul
statement:
theorem sqrt_likelihood_mul (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    Real.sqrt (likelihood P Q true h * likelihood P Q false h) =
      (h.map (fun ay => Real.sqrt (P.mass ay.2 * Q.mass ay.2))).prod

label: stoppedMass_repeat
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PairResolution.stoppedMass_repeat
statement:
theorem stoppedMass_repeat (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Y)) :
    stoppedMass (repeatProtocol P Q N) N z h =
      if h.length = N then 1 / 2 * likelihood P Q z h else 0

label: cycle
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.cycle
statement:
def cycle : Option Bool → Option Bool
  | none => some false
  | some false => some true
  | some true => none

label: negate
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.negate
statement:
def negate : Option Bool → Option Bool
  | none => none
  | some b => some (!b)

label: witnessEval
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.witnessEval
statement:
def witnessEval : Bool → Bool → Option Bool
  | c, false => some (!c)
  | _, true => none

label: cycle_closed_language_has_no_self_evaluator
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.cycle_closed_language_has_no_self_evaluator
statement:
theorem cycle_closed_language_has_no_self_evaluator {C : Type*}
    (eval : C → C → Option Bool) (cycleCode : C → C)
    (hcycle : ∀ c x, eval (cycleCode c) x = cycle (eval c x)) :
    ¬ ∃ s, ∀ c, eval s c = eval c c

label: cycle_has_no_fixed_point
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.cycle_has_no_fixed_point
statement: theorem cycle_has_no_fixed_point (v : Option Bool) : cycle v ≠ v

label: definite_readout
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.definite_readout
statement:
theorem definite_readout (b : Bool) :
    (some b : Option Bool).getD false = b ∧ (negate (some b)).getD false = !b

label: negate_fixed_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.negate_fixed_iff
statement: theorem negate_fixed_iff (v : Option Bool) : negate v = v ↔ v = none

label: negate_involutive
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.negate_involutive
statement: theorem negate_involutive (v : Option Bool) : negate (negate v) = v

label: negate_none
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.negate_none
statement: theorem negate_none : negate none = none

label: negate_some
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.negate_some
statement: theorem negate_some (b : Bool) : negate (some b) = some (!b)

label: no_readout_from_fixed_point
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.no_readout_from_fixed_point
statement:
theorem no_readout_from_fixed_point {X Y : Type*} (f : X → X) (g : Y → Y)
    (x : X) (hx : f x = x) (hg : ∀ y, g y ≠ y) :
    ¬ ∃ h : X → Y, ∀ z, h (f z) = g (h z)

label: no_total_boolean_readout
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.no_total_boolean_readout
statement:
theorem no_total_boolean_readout :
    ¬ ∃ h : Option Bool → Bool, ∀ v, h (negate v) = !(h v)

label: nonconstant_completion
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.nonconstant_completion
statement:
theorem nonconstant_completion :
    (∀ c x, witnessEval (!c) x = negate (witnessEval c x)) ∧
    (∀ c, witnessEval false c = witnessEval c c) ∧
    witnessEval false false = some true ∧ witnessEval true false = some false ∧
    witnessEval false true = none

label: self_evaluation_forces_none
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.self_evaluation_forces_none
statement:
theorem self_evaluation_forces_none {C : Type*} (eval : C → C → Option Bool)
    (negCode : C → C) (hneg : ∀ c x, eval (negCode c) x = negate (eval c x))
    (s : C) (hself : ∀ c, eval s c = eval c c) :
    eval s (negCode s) = none ∧ eval (negCode s) (negCode s) = none

label: witnessEval_false
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.witnessEval_false
statement: theorem witnessEval_false (c : Bool) : witnessEval c false = some (!c)

label: witnessEval_true
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.witnessEval_true
statement: theorem witnessEval_true (c : Bool) : witnessEval c true = none

label: witness_negation
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.witness_negation
statement: theorem witness_negation (c x : Bool) : witnessEval (!c) x = negate (witnessEval c x)

label: witness_self_evaluation
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PartialSelfEvaluation.witness_self_evaluation
statement: theorem witness_self_evaluation (c : Bool) : witnessEval false c = witnessEval c c

label: frozenRepeat_attainment
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PersistentBinaryCost.frozenRepeat_attainment
statement:
theorem frozenRepeat_attainment (n : ℕ) (c η : ℝ)
    (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hentropy : Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤ 1 - c) :
    ((frozenRepeatCount n η : ℕ) : ℝ) ∈ frozenCosts n c ∧
      ((frozenRepeatCount n η : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) /
          PersistentBinaryEvidence.discrimination n + 1

      (binaryKernelLaw (epsilon n) (epsilon_abs_le_half n) false).mass =
        PersistentBinaryEvidence.discrimination n

label: frozen_repeat_geometric_price
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PersistentBinaryCost.frozen_repeat_geometric_price
statement:
theorem frozen_repeat_geometric_price (n : ℕ) (η : ℝ) :

      8 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) * (4 : ℝ) ^ n

label: geometric_price_identity
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PersistentBinaryCost.geometric_price_identity

theorem geometric_price_identity (n : ℕ) (c : ℝ) :

    (p : ℕ → FiniteProtocol Bool A Bool) (horizon : ℕ → ℕ)

    (hinfo : ∀ n, c ≤ terminalMI (p n) (horizon n) (historyBank A Bool (horizon n))) :
    ¬ ∃ budget : ℝ, ∀ n,
      expectedCost (p n) (horizon n) (historyBank A Bool (horizon n)) ≤ budget

label: optimalFrozenCost_lower

label: optimalFrozenCost_two_sided

theorem optimalFrozenCost_two_sided (c : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1) :

      a * (4 : ℝ) ^ n ≤ optimalFrozenCost n c ∧

label: optimalFrozenCost_upper

  | left {a a' b : Trace} : EqGuardedStepCtx a a' → OperandStep (a, b) (a', b)
  | right {a b b' : Trace} : EqGuardedStepCtx b b' → OperandStep (a, b) (a, b')

label: PStep
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PersistentGuardContext.PStep
statement:
inductive PStep : Trace → Trace → Prop
  | R_int_delta (t : Trace) : PStep (integrate (delta t)) void
  | R_merge_void_left (t : Trace) : PStep (merge void t) t
  | R_merge_void_right (t : Trace) : PStep (merge t void) t
  | R_merge_cancel (t : Trace) : PStep (merge t t) t
  | R_rec_zero (b s : Trace) : PStep (recΔ b s void) b
  | R_rec_succ (b s n : Trace) : PStep (recΔ b s (delta n)) (app s (recΔ b s n))
  | R_eq_refl (a : Trace) : PStep (eqW a a) void
  | R_eq_diff (a b : Trace) (h : DiffLicense a b) : PStep (eqW a b) (integrate (merge a b))

label: PStepCtx
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PersistentGuardContext.PStepCtx
statement:
inductive PStepCtx : Trace → Trace → Prop
  | root {a b : Trace} : PStep a b → PStepCtx a b
  | delta {t u : Trace} : PStepCtx t u → PStepCtx (delta t) (delta u)
  | integrate {t u : Trace} : PStepCtx t u → PStepCtx (integrate t) (integrate u)
  | mergeL {a a' b : Trace} : PStepCtx a a' → PStepCtx (merge a b) (merge a' b)
  | mergeR {a b b' : Trace} : PStepCtx b b' → PStepCtx (merge a b) (merge a b')
  | appL {a a' b : Trace} : PStepCtx a a' → PStepCtx (app a b) (app a' b)
  | appR {a b b' : Trace} : PStepCtx b b' → PStepCtx (app a b) (app a b')
  | recB {b b' s n : Trace} : PStepCtx b b' → PStepCtx (recΔ b s n) (recΔ b' s n)
  | recS {b s s' n : Trace} : PStepCtx s s' → PStepCtx (recΔ b s n) (recΔ b s' n)
  | recN {b s n n' : Trace} : PStepCtx n n' → PStepCtx (recΔ b s n) (recΔ b s n')
  | eqWL {a a' b : Trace} : PStepCtx a a' → PStepCtx (eqW a b) (eqW a' b)
  | eqWR {a b b' : Trace} : PStepCtx b b' → PStepCtx (eqW a b) (eqW a b')

      bitSign c * coef E true false + bitSign e * coef E true true ≤ 1

        deterministicCorrelation ab.1 ab.2), facetForm s v ≤ 1) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ Set.range (fun ab : (Bool → Bool) × (Bool → Bool) =>
        deterministicCorrelation ab.1 ab.2),
      facetForm s v = 1 ↔ v ∈ Set.range (fun pq : Bool × Bool => hullVertex (pq.1, pq.2, s pq))) ∧
    AffineIndependent ℝ (fun pq : Bool × Bool => hullVertex (pq.1, pq.2, s pq))

    ∑ f ∈ Finset.univ.erase e, E f =

label: weighted_deterministicCorrelation_apply
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PitowskyPolytope.weighted_deterministicCorrelation_apply
statement:
private theorem weighted_deterministicCorrelation_apply {L : Type*} [Fintype L]
    (w : L → ℝ) (A B : Bool → L → Bool) (x y : Bool) :
    (∑ l, w l • deterministicCorrelation (fun z => A z l) (fun z => B z l)) (x, y) =
      (∑ l, w l) - 2 * ∑ l, if A x l ≠ B y l then w l else 0

label: common_alphabet_four_coordinates_two_orbits
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PlaceOrbitGeneral.common_alphabet_four_coordinates_two_orbits
statement:
theorem common_alphabet_four_coordinates_two_orbits (q : Fin 3 → Bool) (h0 : q 0 = false)
    (h1 : q 1 = false) (h2 : q 2 = true) :
    Fintype.card {p : Fin 3 → Fin 2 // Function.Injective (fun x => (q x, p x))} = 4 ∧
      ∃ p p' : Fin 3 → Fin 2,
        Function.Injective (fun x => (q x, p x)) ∧ Function.Injective (fun x => (q x, p' x)) ∧
        (¬ ∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, p' = p ∘ σ.symm) ∧
        ∀ r : Fin 3 → Fin 2, Function.Injective (fun x => (q x, r x)) →
          (∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, r = p ∘ σ.symm) ∨
            ∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, r = p' ∘ σ.symm

label: common_alphabet_two_orbits
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PlaceOrbitGeneral.common_alphabet_two_orbits
statement:
theorem common_alphabet_two_orbits (q : Fin 3 → Bool) (h0 : q 0 = false) (h1 : q 1 = false)
    (h2 : q 2 = true) :
    ∃ p p' : Fin 3 → Fin 2,
      Function.Injective (fun x => (q x, p x)) ∧ Function.Injective (fun x => (q x, p' x)) ∧
        ¬ ∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, p' = p ∘ σ.symm

    (hF : ∀ e, evalForm e φF ↔ f (e (vr a b 0)) = e (vr a b 4))
    (hG : ∀ e, evalForm e φG ↔ g (e (vr a b 8)) = e (vr a b 9)) (env : ℕ → ℕ) :
    evalForm env (precForm φF φG a b) ↔ precSeq f g (env a).unpair.1 (env a).unpair.2 = env b

label: rec_eq_precSeq
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.PrimrecDefinability.rec_eq_precSeq
statement:
theorem rec_eq_precSeq (f g : ℕ → ℕ) (z : ℕ) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ) (f z) (fun y IH => g (Nat.pair z (Nat.pair y IH))) n =
      precSeq f g z n
  | 0 => rfl
  | n + 1 => by
      show g (Nat.pair z (Nat.pair n (Nat.rec (motive := fun _ => ℕ) (f z)
        (fun y IH => g (Nat.pair z (Nat.pair y IH))) n))) =
        g (Nat.pair z (Nat.pair n (precSeq f g z n)))
      rw [rec_eq_precSeq f g z n]

label: BinaryMenu
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryMenu
statement:
structure BinaryMenu (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Bool) (ε : ℝ) where
  bias : List (A × Bool) → A → ℝ
  bound : ∀ h a, |bias h a| ≤ ε
  source : ∀ h a z y, (p.observation h a z).mass y = binaryKernel (bias h a) z y
  reading_cost : ∀ h a, 1 ≤ p.cost h a

label: BinaryTask
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryTask
statement:
structure BinaryTask {H0 A V R ι : Type} [Fintype H0] [Fintype A]
    (T : ProtocolTask H0 Bool A Bool V R ι) (ε : ℝ) (j : ι) where
  bias : H0 → List (A × Bool) → A → ℝ
  bound : ∀ u h a, T.permitted u h a → |bias u h a| ≤ ε
  source : ∀ u h a, T.permitted u h a → ∀ z y,
    (T.observation u h a z).mass y = binaryKernel (bias u h a) z y
  reading_cost : ∀ u h a, T.permitted u h a → 1 ≤ T.cost j u h a

label: ConditionalProtocol
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.ConditionalProtocol
statement:
structure ConditionalProtocol (H0 Z A Y : Type)
    [Fintype H0] [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y] where
  initialRecord : FiniteLaw H0
  initialJoint : FiniteLaw (H0 × Z)
  given : H0 → FiniteProtocol Z A Y
  initial_joint : ∀ h z, initialJoint.mass (h, z) =
    initialRecord.mass h * (given h).prior.mass z

label: FiniteLaw
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.FiniteLaw
statement:
structure FiniteLaw (A : Type) [Fintype A] where
  mass : A → ℝ
  nonnegative : ∀ a, 0 ≤ mass a
  total : ∑ a, mass a = 1

label: FiniteProtocol
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.FiniteProtocol
statement:
structure FiniteProtocol (Z A Y : Type) [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y] where
  prior : FiniteLaw Z
  policy : List (A × Y) → FiniteLaw A
  observation : List (A × Y) → A → Z → FiniteLaw Y
  stop : List (A × Y) → Bool
  cost : List (A × Y) → A → ℝ
  cost_nonnegative : ∀ h a, 0 ≤ cost h a

label: FiniteProtocolIso
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.FiniteProtocolIso
statement:
structure FiniteProtocolIso {Z A Y Z' A' Y' : Type}
    [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Z'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype Y']
    (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (q : FiniteProtocol Z' A' Y') where
  input : Z ≃ Z'
  action : A ≃ A'
  outcome : Y ≃ Y'
  prior : ∀ z, q.prior.mass (input z) = p.prior.mass z
  policy : ∀ h a, (q.policy (historyEquiv action outcome h)).mass (action a) = (p.policy h).mass a
  observation : ∀ h a z y,
    (q.observation (historyEquiv action outcome h) (action a) (input z)).mass (outcome y) =
      (p.observation h a z).mass y
  stopping : ∀ h, q.stop (historyEquiv action outcome h) = p.stop h
  cost : ∀ h a, q.cost (historyEquiv action outcome h) (action a) = p.cost h a

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.ProtocolStrategy
statement:
structure ProtocolStrategy (H0 A Y R : Type) [Fintype A] where

  repair : R

label: ProtocolTask
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.ProtocolTask
statement:
structure ProtocolTask (H0 Z A Y V R ι : Type) [Fintype H0] [Fintype Z] [Fintype A]
    [Fintype Y] where
  initialRecord : FiniteLaw H0
  prior : H0 → FiniteLaw Z
  observation : H0 → List (A × Y) → A → Z → FiniteLaw Y
  permitted : H0 → List (A × Y) → A → Prop
  target : H0 → Z → V
  licensed : R → Prop
  readout : R → H0 → List (A × Y) → Option V
  cost : ι → H0 → List (A × Y) → A → ℝ
  cost_nonnegative : ∀ j u h a, 0 ≤ cost j u h a

label: TaskIso
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.TaskIso
statement:
structure TaskIso {H0 Z A Y V R ι H0' Z' A' Y' V' R' ι' : Type}
    [Fintype H0] [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype H0'] [Fintype Z'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype Y']
    (S : ProtocolTask H0 Z A Y V R ι) (T : ProtocolTask H0' Z' A' Y' V' R' ι') where
  record : H0 ≃ H0'
  input : Z ≃ Z'
  action : A ≃ A'
  outcome : Y ≃ Y'
  answer : V ≃ V'
  repair : R ≃ R'
  coord : ι ≃ ι'
  initialRecord : ∀ u, T.initialRecord.mass (record u) = S.initialRecord.mass u
  prior : ∀ u z, (T.prior (record u)).mass (input z) = (S.prior u).mass z
  observation : ∀ u h a z y,
    (T.observation (record u) (historyEquiv action outcome h) (action a) (input z)).mass
      (outcome y) = (S.observation u h a z).mass y
  permitted : ∀ u h a,
    T.permitted (record u) (historyEquiv action outcome h) (action a) ↔ S.permitted u h a
  target : ∀ u z, T.target (record u) (input z) = answer (S.target u z)
  licensed : ∀ r, T.licensed (repair r) ↔ S.licensed r
  readout : ∀ r u h,
    T.readout (repair r) (record u) (historyEquiv action outcome h) =
      (S.readout r u h).map answer
  cost : ∀ j u h a,
    T.cost (coord j) (record u) (historyEquiv action outcome h) (action a) = S.cost j u h a

label: TaskSimulation
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.TaskSimulation
statement:
structure TaskSimulation {H0 Z A Y V R ι H0' Z' A' Y' V' R' ι' : Type}
    [Fintype H0] [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y]
    [Fintype H0'] [Fintype Z'] [Fintype A'] [Fintype Y']
    (S : ProtocolTask H0 Z A Y V R ι) (T : ProtocolTask H0' Z' A' Y' V' R' ι') (n : ℕ) where
  map : ProtocolStrategy H0 A Y R → ProtocolStrategy H0' A' Y' R'
  admissible : ∀ σ, S.Admissible σ → T.Admissible (map σ)
  information : ∀ σ, S.Admissible σ → S.information σ n ≤ T.information (map σ) n
  error : ∀ σ, S.Admissible σ → T.errorMass (map σ) n ≤ S.errorMass σ n
  refusal : ∀ σ, S.Admissible σ → T.refusalMass (map σ) n ≤ S.refusalMass σ n
  convert : (ι → ℝ) → ι' → ℝ
  convert_mono : ∀ b c : ι → ℝ, (∀ j, b j ≤ c j) → ∀ j', convert b j' ≤ convert c j'
  cost : ∀ σ, S.Admissible σ → ∀ j',
    T.expectedCostAt (map σ) n j' ≤ convert (fun j => S.expectedCostAt σ n j) j'

label: capacity
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryTask.capacity
statement:
theorem capacity (m : BinaryTask T ε j) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 2) (σ : ProtocolStrategy H0 A Bool R)
    (hσ : T.Admissible σ) (u : H0) :
    LocalCapacityBound ((T.costConditional σ j).given u) (4 * ε ^ 2)

label: frontier_lower
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryTask.frontier_lower
statement:
theorem frontier_lower (m : BinaryTask T ε j) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ)
    (q : ProtocolRequirement ι) (hq : T.Feasible n q) :
    q.information / (4 * ε ^ 2) ≤ q.budget j

label: informationLimit_le_budget
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryTask.informationLimit_le_budget
statement:
theorem informationLimit_le_budget (m : BinaryTask T ε j) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 2)
    (σ : ProtocolStrategy H0 A Bool R) (hσ : T.Admissible σ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ b)
    (hcost : T.extendedCostOf σ j ≤ ENNReal.ofReal b) :
    T.informationLimitOf σ ≤ 4 * ε ^ 2 * b

label: information_le_cost
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryTask.information_le_cost
statement:
theorem information_le_cost (m : BinaryTask T ε j) (hε : ε ≤ 1 / 2)
    (σ : ProtocolStrategy H0 A Bool R) (hσ : T.Admissible σ) (n : ℕ) :
    T.information σ n ≤ 4 * ε ^ 2 * T.expectedCostAt σ n j

label: limit_frontier_lower
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.BinaryTask.limit_frontier_lower
statement:

    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (budget : ι → ℝ≥0∞) (hbj : budget j = ENNReal.ofReal b)
    (h : T.LimitFeasible c budget) : c / (4 * ε ^ 2) ≤ b

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.binaryJointLaw_source
statement:
theorem binaryJointLaw_source (q δ : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 1 / 2) (b y : Bool) :
    (binaryJointLaw q δ hq0 hq1 hδ).mass (b, y) =
      (binaryPriorLaw q hq0 hq1).mass b * (binaryChannel δ hδ).prob b y

statement:
theorem binaryJoint_entropy (q δ : ℝ) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.binaryJoint_information
statement:
theorem binaryJoint_information (q δ : ℝ) :
    jointMI (binaryJoint q δ) =

        Real.log 2

label: binaryJoint_information_fair
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.binaryJoint_information_fair
statement:
theorem binaryJoint_information_fair (δ : ℝ) :

label: binaryTaskFlip_frontier
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.binaryTaskFlip_frontier
statement:
theorem binaryTaskFlip_frontier (q δ price : ℝ) (lic : Prop) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 1 / 2) (hp : 0 ≤ price) (hδ0 : δ ≠ 0) (n : ℕ) (r : ProtocolRequirement Unit) :
    ((binaryTask q (-δ) price lic hq0 hq1 (by rwa [abs_neg]) hp).Feasible n r ↔
      (binaryTask q δ price lic hq0 hq1 hδ hp).Feasible n r) ∧
    binaryKernel (-δ) true true ≠ binaryKernel δ true true

    (binaryTask q δ price lic hq0 hq1 hδ hp).expectedCostAt σ 0 j = 0

label: binaryTask_error_zero
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.binaryTask_error_zero
statement:
theorem binaryTask_error_zero (q δ price : ℝ) (lic : Prop) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)

    (σ : ProtocolStrategy Unit Unit Bool (List (Unit × Bool) → Option Bool)) :
    (binaryTask q δ price lic hq0 hq1 hδ hp).errorMass σ 0 =
      q * errorLoss true (σ.repair []) + (1 - q) * errorLoss false (σ.repair [])

label: conditionalJointInfo_bounds
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.conditionalJointInfo_bounds
statement:
theorem conditionalJointInfo_bounds (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y)
    (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))) (hb : HistoryBank n bank) (κ : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ) :
    conditionalJointInfo p n bank = conditionalMI p n bank ∧
      (∑ u, ∑ z, (bank.map (fun h => conditionalStoppedMass p n u z h)).sum) = 1 ∧
      (∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u →
        terminalMI (p.given u) n bank ≤ κ * expectedCost (p.given u) n bank) ∧
      0 ≤ conditionalJointInfo p n bank ∧
      conditionalJointInfo p n bank ≤ κ * conditionalExpectedCost p n bank

label: conditionalJointInfo_eq_conditionalMI
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.conditionalJointInfo_eq_conditionalMI
statement:
theorem conditionalJointInfo_eq_conditionalMI (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y)

label: conditionalJointInfo_eq_entropy_sub
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.conditionalJointInfo_eq_entropy_sub
statement:
theorem conditionalJointInfo_eq_entropy_sub (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y)
    (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))) (hb : HistoryBank n bank) :
    conditionalJointInfo p n bank = entropy p.initialJoint.mass - entropy p.initialRecord.mass -
      ∑ u, ∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n,
        massUncertainty (fun z => conditionalStoppedMass p n u z h)

label: conditionalMI_eq_gain_sum
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.conditionalMI_eq_gain_sum
statement:
theorem conditionalMI_eq_gain_sum (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y)
    (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))) (hb : HistoryBank n bank) :
    conditionalMI p n bank = ∑ u, p.initialRecord.mass u *
      (bank.map (fun h => if h.length < n ∧ (p.given u).stop h = false then
        historyMass (p.given u) h *
          ∑ a, ((p.given u).policy h).mass a * localGain (p.given u) h a else 0)).sum

theorem historySet_active_sum_succ {E : Type} [Fintype E]

    (∑ h ∈ historySet E (n + 1), activeValue stop (n + 1) f h) =
      ∑ h ∈ historySet E n, if stop h then 0 else f h

label: historySet_boundary_balance
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySet_boundary_balance
statement:
theorem historySet_boundary_balance {E : Type} [Fintype E]
    (stop : List E → Bool) (n : ℕ) (f : List E → ℝ)
    (hstop : ∀ h, stop h = true → ∀ e, f (h ++ [e]) = 0) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet E n, boundaryValue stop n f h) +
      (∑ h ∈ historySet E n,
        activeValue stop n (fun h => f h - ∑ e, f (h ++ [e])) h) = f []

label: historySet_mono
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySet_mono
statement:
theorem historySet_mono {E : Type} [Fintype E] {n m : ℕ} (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    historySet E n ⊆ historySet E m

label: historySet_stoppedMass_target_marginal
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySet_stoppedMass_target_marginal
statement:
theorem historySet_stoppedMass_target_marginal (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y)
    (n : ℕ) (z : Z) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n, stoppedMass p n z h) = p.prior.mass z

label: historySet_sum_restrict
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySet_sum_restrict
statement:
theorem historySet_sum_restrict {E : Type} [Fintype E] (n : ℕ) (f : List E → ℝ)
    (hf : ∀ h, h.length = n + 1 → f h = 0) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet E (n + 1), f h) = ∑ h ∈ historySet E n, f h

label: historySet_sum_succ
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySet_sum_succ
statement:
theorem historySet_sum_succ {E : Type} [Fintype E] (n : ℕ) (f : List E → ℝ) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet E (n + 1), f h) =
      f [] + ∑ h ∈ historySet E n, ∑ e, f (h ++ [e])

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySnoc_injective
statement: theorem historySnoc_injective {E : Type} : Function.Injective (@historySnoc E)

label: historySnoc_ne_nil
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historySnoc_ne_nil
statement: theorem historySnoc_ne_nil {E : Type} (he : List E × E) : historySnoc he ≠ []

label: historyUncertainty_after_stop
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historyUncertainty_after_stop
statement:
theorem historyUncertainty_after_stop (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y)

label: historyUncertainty_drop
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historyUncertainty_drop
statement:
theorem historyUncertainty_drop (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y)
    (h : List (A × Y)) (hs : p.stop h = false) :
    historyUncertainty p h - (∑ ay : A × Y, historyUncertainty p (h ++ [ay])) =
      historyMass p h * ∑ a, (p.policy h).mass a * localGain p h a

label: historyUncertainty_nil
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.historyUncertainty_nil

theorem historyUncertainty_nil (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) :

theorem historyUncertainty_nonnegative (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y)) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.informationLimit_le_extendedCost

theorem informationLimit_le_extendedCost (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (κ : ℝ)

theorem informationLimit_nonnegative (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) :
