label: jointMI_kernel
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.jointMI_kernel
statement:
theorem jointMI_kernel {Z Y : Type} [Fintype Z] [Fintype Y]
    (q : Z → ℝ) (K : Z → Y → ℝ) (hK : ∀ z, ∑ y, K z y = 1) :
    jointMI (fun zy : Z × Y => q zy.1 * K zy.1 zy.2) =
      entropy (fun y => ∑ z, q z * K z y) - ∑ z, q z * entropy (K z)

label: jointMI_kernel_nonnegative
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.jointMI_kernel_nonnegative
statement:
theorem jointMI_kernel_nonnegative {Z Y : Type} [Fintype Z] [Fintype Y]
    (q : Z → ℝ) (K : Z → Y → ℝ) (hq0 : ∀ z, 0 ≤ q z)
    (hq1 : ∑ z, q z = 1) (hK0 : ∀ z y, 0 ≤ K z y)
    (hK1 : ∀ z, ∑ y, K z y = 1) :
    0 ≤ jointMI (fun zy : Z × Y => q zy.1 * K zy.1 zy.2)

label: jointMI_product_zero
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.jointMI_product_zero
statement:
theorem jointMI_product_zero {Z A : Type} [Fintype Z] [Fintype A]
    (q : Z → ℝ) (r : A → ℝ) (hq : ∑ z, q z = 1) (hr : ∑ a, r a = 1) :
    jointMI (fun za : Z × A => q za.1 * r za.2) = 0

label: jointMI_reindex
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.jointMI_reindex
statement:
theorem jointMI_reindex {X Y U V : Type}
    [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] [Fintype U] [Fintype V]
    (ex : X ≃ U) (ey : Y ≃ V) (p : X × Y → ℝ) (q : U × V → ℝ)
    (h : ∀ x y, q (ex x, ey y) = p (x, y)) : jointMI q = jointMI p

label: licenseLoss_control
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.licenseLoss_control
statement:
theorem licenseLoss_control (q δ price : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 1 / 2) (hp : 0 ≤ price) :
    (binaryTask q δ price True hq0 hq1 hδ hp).Feasible 0 refusalTarget ∧
      (∀ n r, ¬ (binaryTask q δ price False hq0 hq1 hδ hp).Feasible n r) ∧
      IsEmpty (TaskIso (binaryTask q δ price True hq0 hq1 hδ hp)
        (binaryTask q δ price False hq0 hq1 hδ hp)) ∧
      Nonempty (TaskSimulation (binaryTask q δ price False hq0 hq1 hδ hp)
        (binaryTask q δ price True hq0 hq1 hδ hp) 0)

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.licensed_refusal_feasible

theorem licensed_refusal_feasible (q δ price : ℝ) (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (hδ : |δ| ≤ 1 / 2) (hp : 0 ≤ price) :
    (binaryTask q δ price True hq0 hq1 hδ hp).Feasible 0 refusalTarget

label: localGain_nonnegative

theorem localGain_nonnegative (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y)) (a : A) :

label: localGain_zero_of_historyMass_zero
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.localGain_zero_of_historyMass_zero

theorem localGain_zero_of_historyMass_zero (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y)

label: massUncertainty_children
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_children
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_children (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y))
    (hs : p.stop h = false) :
    (∑ a, ∑ y, massUncertainty (fun z => prefixMass p z (h ++ [(a, y)]))) =
      massUncertainty (fun z => prefixMass p z h) -
        historyMass p h * ∑ a, (p.policy h).mass a * localGain p h a

label: massUncertainty_kernel_sum
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_kernel_sum
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_kernel_sum {Z Y : Type} [Fintype Z] [Fintype Y]
    (q : Z → ℝ) (K : Z → Y → ℝ) (hK : ∀ z, ∑ y, K z y = 1) :
    (∑ y, massUncertainty (fun z => q z * K z y)) =
      entropy q - jointMI (fun zy : Z × Y => q zy.1 * K zy.1 zy.2)

label: massUncertainty_of_total_one
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_of_total_one
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_of_total_one {Z : Type} [Fintype Z] (m : Z → ℝ)
    (hm : ∑ z, m z = 1) : massUncertainty m = entropy m

label: massUncertainty_prefix
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_prefix
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_prefix (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y)) :
    massUncertainty (fun z => prefixMass p z h) =
      historyMass p h * entropy (posterior p h)

label: massUncertainty_scale
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_scale
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_scale {Z : Type} [Fintype Z] (c : ℝ) (m : Z → ℝ) :
    massUncertainty (fun z => c * m z) = c * massUncertainty m

label: massUncertainty_stopped
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_stopped
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_stopped (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ)
    (h : List (A × Y)) :
    massUncertainty (fun z => stoppedMass p n z h) =
      boundaryValue p.stop n (historyUncertainty p) h

label: massUncertainty_zero
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.massUncertainty_zero
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_zero {Z : Type} [Fintype Z] :

theorem mem_chargedHistorySet (n : ℕ) (h : List (A × Y)) :

label: mem_historySet
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.mem_historySet
statement:
theorem mem_historySet {E : Type} [Fintype E] (n : ℕ) (h : List E) :
    h ∈ historySet E n ↔ h.length ≤ n

label: native_entropy_joint_kernel
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.native_entropy_joint_kernel
statement:
theorem native_entropy_joint_kernel {Z Y : Type} [Fintype Z] [Fintype Y]
    (p : Z → ℝ) (K : Z → Y → ℝ) (hK : ∀ z, ∑ y, K z y = 1) :
    BitDivision.entropy (fun zy : Z × Y => p zy.1 * K zy.1 zy.2) =
      BitDivision.entropy p + ∑ z, p z * BitDivision.entropy (K z)

theorem posterior_le_one (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y)) (z : Z) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.posterior_total

label: prefixMass_action_marginal
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.prefixMass_action_marginal
statement:
theorem prefixMass_action_marginal (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y))
    (hs : p.stop h = false) (z : Z) (a : A) :
    (∑ y, prefixMass p z (h ++ [(a, y)])) / historyMass p h =
      posterior p h z * (p.policy h).mass a

label: prefixMass_append
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.prefixMass_append
statement:
theorem prefixMass_append (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (z : Z)
    (h : List (A × Y)) (a : A) (y : Y) :
    prefixMass p z (h ++ [(a, y)]) = if p.stop h then 0 else
      prefixMass p z h * (p.policy h).mass a * (p.observation h a z).mass y

label: prefixMass_children
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.prefixMass_children
statement:
theorem prefixMass_children (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (h : List (A × Y)) (z : Z) :
    (∑ a, ∑ y, prefixMass p z (h ++ [(a, y)])) =
      if p.stop h then 0 else prefixMass p z h

label: prefixMass_eq_source_fold
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.prefixMass_eq_source_fold
statement:
theorem prefixMass_eq_source_fold (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (z : Z)
    (h : List (A × Y)) :
    prefixMass p z h =
      (h.foldl (fun acc ay =>
        (acc.1 ++ [ay], if p.stop acc.1 then (0 : ℝ) else
          acc.2 * (p.policy acc.1).mass ay.1 * (p.observation acc.1 ay.1 z).mass ay.2))
        (([] : List (A × Y)), p.prior.mass z)).2

label: prefixMass_le_historyMass
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.prefixMass_le_historyMass
statement:
theorem prefixMass_le_historyMass (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y)

theorem prefixMass_nil (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (z : Z) :

statement:

label: stoppedExpectation_zero
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.stoppedExpectation_zero

theorem stoppedExpectation_zero {Z A Y : Type} [Fintype Z] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y]

label: stoppedMass_nonnegative

theorem stoppedMass_nonnegative (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ) (z : Z)

theorem stoppedUnitProtocol_zero_information_cost (n : ℕ)

label: terminalMI_eq_entropy_sub
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.terminalMI_eq_entropy_sub
statement:
theorem terminalMI_eq_entropy_sub (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ)
    (bank : List (List (A × Y))) (hb : HistoryBank n bank) :
    terminalMI p n bank = entropy p.prior.mass -
      ∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n, massUncertainty (fun z => stoppedMass p n z h)

label: terminalMI_eq_gain_sum
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.terminalMI_eq_gain_sum
statement:
theorem terminalMI_eq_gain_sum (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ)
    (bank : List (List (A × Y))) (hb : HistoryBank n bank) :
    terminalMI p n bank =
      (bank.map (fun h => if h.length < n ∧ p.stop h = false then
        historyMass p h * ∑ a, (p.policy h).mass a * localGain p h a else 0)).sum

label: terminalMI_eq_jointMI
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.terminalMI_eq_jointMI
statement:
theorem terminalMI_eq_jointMI (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ)

label: terminalMI_le_informationLimit

theorem terminalMI_le_informationLimit (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ) :

label: terminalMI_le_prior_entropy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ProtocolResolution.terminalMI_le_prior_entropy
statement:
theorem terminalMI_le_prior_entropy (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (n : ℕ)

label: recordChoice_conj
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.RecordChoiceOrbit.recordChoice_conj
statement:
theorem recordChoice_conj {X Q : Type*} (q : X → Q) (u u' : Set.range q → X)
    (hu : ∀ y, Set.rangeFactorization q (u y) = y)
    (hu' : ∀ y, Set.rangeFactorization q (u' y) = y) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm X, (∀ x, q (σ x) = q x) ∧ (∀ y, σ (u y) = u' y) ∧ σ.symm = σ ∧
      (∀ x, x ≠ u (Set.rangeFactorization q x) → x ≠ u' (Set.rangeFactorization q x) →
        σ x = x) ∧
      ∀ x, recordChoice q u' x = σ (recordChoice q u (σ.symm x))

label: recordChoice_conj_closed
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.RecordChoiceOrbit.recordChoice_conj_closed
statement:

    (hσ : ∀ x, q (σ x) = q x) :
    (∀ y, Set.rangeFactorization q (σ (u y)) = y) ∧
      ∀ x, σ (recordChoice q u (σ.symm x)) = recordChoice q (fun y => σ (u y)) x

label: recordChoice_conj_free_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.RecordChoiceOrbit.recordChoice_conj_free_iff
statement:
theorem recordChoice_conj_free_iff {X Q : Type*} (q : X → Q) (u : Set.range q → X)
    (hu : ∀ y, Set.rangeFactorization q (u y) = y) :
    (∀ σ : Equiv.Perm X, (∀ x, q (σ x) = q x) → (∀ y, σ (u y) = u y) → σ = 1) ↔
      ∀ a b : X, q a = q b → a ≠ u (Set.rangeFactorization q a) →
        b ≠ u (Set.rangeFactorization q a) → a = b

        leftEntropy (zeroTestOnPasses n)) ∧
    leftEntropy (fun i : Fin (n + 1) => i) = 0

label: likelihood_eq_pow
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.likelihood_eq_pow
statement:
theorem likelihood_eq_pow (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Bool)) :

label: likelihood_nil

label: likelihood_wrong_le

    (hl : h.length = 2 * n + 1) :
    likelihood ε (!majority n h) h ≤ (1 / 2 - ε) * (1 / 4 - ε ^ 2) ^ n

label: majority_error_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.majority_error_le
statement:
theorem majority_error_le (n : ℕ) :
    ∑ h ∈ historySet (Unit × Bool) (2 * n + 1),
        stoppedMass (majorityProtocol ε hε0 hε1 (2 * n + 1)) (2 * n + 1) (!majority n h) h ≤
      1 / 2 * (1 - 4 * ε ^ 2) ^ n

label: majority_error_le_exp
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.majority_error_le_exp
statement:
theorem majority_error_le_exp (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) :
    1 / 2 * (1 - 4 * ε ^ 2) ^ n ≤ 1 / 2 * Real.exp (-(4 * n * ε ^ 2))

label: majority_information
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.majority_information
statement:
theorem majority_information (n : ℕ) :
    1 - Real.binEntropy (1 / 2 * (1 - 4 * ε ^ 2) ^ n) / Real.log 2 ≤
      terminalMI (majorityProtocol ε hε0 hε1 (2 * n + 1)) (2 * n + 1)
        (historyBank Unit Bool (2 * n + 1))

label: majority_target
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.majority_target
statement:
theorem majority_target (hε : 0 < ε) (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2) :
    1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
        terminalMI (majorityProtocol ε hε0 hε1 (2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1))
          (2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1)
          (historyBank Unit Bool (2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1)) ∧
      expectedCost (majorityProtocol ε hε0 hε1 (2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1))
          (2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1)
          (historyBank Unit Bool (2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1)) =
        ((2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧
      ((2 * ⌈Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (4 * ε ^ 2)⌉₊ + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
        Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (2 * ε ^ 2) + 3

label: massUncertainty_bool
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.massUncertainty_bool
statement:
theorem massUncertainty_bool (m : Bool → ℝ) (hw : 0 < m true + m false) :
    massUncertainty m =
      (m true + m false) * Real.binEntropy (m true / (m true + m false)) / Real.log 2

label: prefixMass_majority
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.prefixMass_majority
statement:
theorem prefixMass_majority (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Bool)) (hl : h.length ≤ N) :
    prefixMass (majorityProtocol ε hε0 hε1 N) z h = 1 / 2 * likelihood ε z h

label: resolution_cost_two_sided
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.resolution_cost_two_sided
statement:
theorem resolution_cost_two_sided (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Bool) (c : ℝ), BinaryMenu p ε →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Bool))), HistoryBank n bank →
        c ≤ terminalMI p n bank → c / (4 * ε ^ 2) ≤ expectedCost p n bank) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ 1 / 2 → ∃ N : ℕ,
      1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
          terminalMI (majorityProtocol ε hε0.le hε1 N) N (historyBank Unit Bool N) ∧
        expectedCost (majorityProtocol ε hε0.le hε1 N) N (historyBank Unit Bool N) = N ∧
        (N : ℝ) ≤ Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (2 * ε ^ 2) + 3)

label: resolution_cost_two_sided_discrimination
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.resolution_cost_two_sided_discrimination
statement:
theorem resolution_cost_two_sided_discrimination (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] (p : FiniteProtocol Bool A Bool) (c : ℝ),
      BoundarySingularity.PairMenu p (8 * ε ^ 2) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Bool))), HistoryBank n bank →
        c ≤ terminalMI p n bank → c * Real.log 2 / (8 * ε ^ 2) ≤ expectedCost p n bank) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → η ≤ 1 / 2 → ∃ N : ℕ,
      1 - Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤
          terminalMI (majorityProtocol ε hε0.le hε1 N) N (historyBank Unit Bool N) ∧
        expectedCost (majorityProtocol ε hε0.le hε1 N) N (historyBank Unit Bool N) = N ∧
        (N : ℝ) ≤ 4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (8 * ε ^ 2) + 3)

label: stoppedMass_majority
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.stoppedMass_majority
statement:
theorem stoppedMass_majority (z : Bool) (h : List (Unit × Bool)) :
    stoppedMass (majorityProtocol ε hε0 hε1 N) N z h =
      if h.length = N then 1 / 2 * likelihood ε z h else 0

label: sum_massUncertainty_le_binEntropy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.sum_massUncertainty_le_binEntropy
statement:
theorem sum_massUncertainty_le_binEntropy {H : Type} (s : Finset H) (m : H → Bool → ℝ)
    (hm : ∀ h b, 0 ≤ m h b) (htot : ∑ h ∈ s, (m h true + m h false) = 1) (g : H → Bool) :
    ∑ h ∈ s, massUncertainty (m h) ≤ Real.binEntropy (∑ h ∈ s, m h (!g h)) / Real.log 2

label: wrong_mass_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResolutionAttainment.wrong_mass_le
statement:
theorem wrong_mass_le (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε ≤ 1 / 2) (n : ℕ) (h : List (Unit × Bool))
    (hl : h.length = 2 * n + 1) :
    1 / 2 * likelihood ε (!majority n h) h ≤
      1 / 2 * (1 - 4 * ε ^ 2) ^ n * (1 / 2) ^ (2 * n + 1)

label: confidence_sharpScaling
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.ResourceFrontier.confidence_sharpScaling
statement:
theorem confidence_sharpScaling (c η : ℝ) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2)

    ∃ A B ε0 : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ 0 < B ∧ 0 < ε0 ∧

label: bounded_record_pole

statement:
theorem bounded_record_pole
    (P : Nat.Partrec.Code → Bool)

    (hNon : ¬ ((∀ c, P c = true) ∨ (∀ c, P c = false)))
    (b : ℕ) :
    ∃ cPos cNeg : Nat.Partrec.Code,
      P cPos = true ∧ P cNeg = false ∧
      boundedRecord b cPos = boundedRecord b cNeg ∧
      ∀ (Y : Type) [Fintype Y] (K : BoundaryPole.Reading Nat.Partrec.Code Y),
        BoundaryPole.RecordDetermined (boundedRecord b) K →

    {A Y : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype Y]

    (K : List (A × Y) → A → BoundaryPole.Reading Nat.Partrec.Code Y)
    (hdet : ∀ h a, BoundaryPole.RecordDetermined (boundedRecord b) (K h a))

label: halting_one_sided
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.RiceBoundary.halting_one_sided
statement:
theorem halting_one_sided :
    ({c : Nat.Partrec.Code | (c.eval 0).Dom} =
      ⋃ b : ℕ, {c : Nat.Partrec.Code |
        boundedRecord b c ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ b⟩ ≠ none}) ∧
    (∀ b : ℕ, Nonempty (DecidablePred
      (fun c : Nat.Partrec.Code =>
        boundedRecord b c ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ b⟩ ≠ none))) ∧
    REPred (fun c : Nat.Partrec.Code => (c.eval 0).Dom) ∧
    ¬ REPred (fun c : Nat.Partrec.Code => ¬ (c.eval 0).Dom) ∧
    (∀ R : Nat.Partrec.Code → Prop,
      ComputablePred R ↔ REPred R ∧ REPred (fun c => ¬ R c))

theorem conditionalPrivacy_finite_cost_bounds {H0 A Y : Type}
    [Fintype H0] [Fintype A] [Fintype Y]
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Bool A Y) (ε c : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (hrows : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ∀ h a,
      IndistinguishableRows ε ((p.given u).observation h a true).mass
        ((p.given u).observation h a false).mass)
    (hcost : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ∀ h a, 1 ≤ (p.given u).cost h a)
    (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Y))) (hb : HistoryBank n bank)
    (hc : c ≤ conditionalJointInfo p n bank) :
    c * Real.log 2 / (2 * Real.tanh (ε / 2) ^ 2) ≤ conditionalExpectedCost p n bank ∧
      2 * c * Real.log 2 / ε ^ 2 ≤ conditionalExpectedCost p n bank

    (hrows : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ∀ h a,

        ((p.given u).observation h a false).mass)
    (hcost : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ∀ h a, 1 ≤ (p.given u).cost h a)
    (hb : 0 ≤ budget) (hc : c ≤ conditionalInformationLimit p)
    (hbudget : conditionalExtendedCost p ≤ ENNReal.ofReal budget) :

    (∃ p : ConditionalProtocol Bool Bool Unit Bool,
      (∀ u z, p.initialJoint.mass (u, z) = p.initialRecord.mass u * binaryPrior (1 / 2) z) ∧
      (∀ u h a z y, ((p.given u).observation h a z).mass y = if y = z then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ u h a, (p.given u).cost h a = 1) ∧
      conditionalMI p 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = c ∧
      conditionalExpectedCost p 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = c) ∧
    (∀ (H0 Z A : Type) [Fintype H0] [Fintype Z] [Fintype A]
      (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Bool),
      (∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ∀ h a, 1 ≤ (p.given u).cost h a) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (bank : List (List (A × Bool))), HistoryBank n bank →
        conditionalMI p n bank ≤ conditionalExpectedCost p n bank)

label: real_readouts_full
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.SelfEvaluationBounds.real_readouts_full
statement:
theorem real_readouts_full :
    (∀ p : ReadoutProbability, (p : ℝ) = 1 - (p : ℝ) ↔ (p : ℝ) = 1 / 2) ∧
    (∀ p : Option Bool → ReadoutProbability,
      (∀ v b, (realReadoutKernel p).mass (negate v) (!b) =
        (realReadoutKernel p).mass v b) ↔
      (p none : ℝ) = 1 / 2 ∧
        (p (some true) : ℝ) = 1 - (p (some false) : ℝ)) ∧
    (∀ v b, (realReadoutKernel realFairReadout).mass (negate v) (!b) =
      (realReadoutKernel realFairReadout).mass v b) ∧
    (¬ ∃ h : Option Bool → Bool, ∀ v, h (negate v) = !(h v))

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.SequentialRatioTest.biasRows_discrimination
statement:
theorem biasRows_discrimination (ε : ℝ) (hε : |ε| < 1 / 2) :
    BoundarySingularity.discrimination (biasRow ε hε).mass (biasRow (-ε) (neg_abs_lt ε hε)).mass =
      8 * ε ^ 2

label: biasRows_kl
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.SequentialRatioTest.biasRows_kl

theorem biasRows_kl (ε : ℝ) (hε : |ε| < 1 / 2) :

    kl (biasRow (-ε) (neg_abs_lt ε hε)).mass (biasRow ε hε).mass = 2 * ε * biasStep ε

label: biasRows_llr

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.SequentialRatioTest.biasStep_ge
statement: theorem biasStep_ge (ε : ℝ) (h0 : 0 ≤ ε) (h1 : ε < 1 / 2) : 4 * ε ≤ biasStep ε

label: biased_walk_test
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.SequentialRatioTest.biased_walk_test
statement:
theorem biased_walk_test (ε : ℝ) (hε0 : 0 < ε) (hε1 : ε < 1 / 2) (k : ℕ) (prior : FiniteLaw Bool)
    (hpt : 0 < prior.mass true) (hpf : 0 < prior.mass false) (n : ℕ) :
    upperMass (biasRow ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))
        (biasRow (-ε) (neg_abs_lt ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))) (k * biasStep ε) prior
        false n ≤ Real.exp (-(4 * ε * k)) * prior.mass false ∧
    lowerMass (biasRow ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))
        (biasRow (-ε) (neg_abs_lt ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))) (k * biasStep ε) prior
        true n ≤ Real.exp (-(4 * ε * k)) * prior.mass true ∧
    activeBelow (sprt (biasRow ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))
        (biasRow (-ε) (neg_abs_lt ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))) (k * biasStep ε) prior)
        true n ≤ prior.mass true * (k + 1) / (2 * ε) ∧
    activeBelow (sprt (biasRow ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))
        (biasRow (-ε) (neg_abs_lt ε (by rw [abs_of_pos hε0]; exact hε1))) (k * biasStep ε) prior)
        false n ≤ prior.mass false * (k + 1) / (2 * ε)

label: chromaticNumber_le_iff_decoder
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StochasticGraph.chromaticNumber_le_iff_decoder

    (K : X → Y → ℝ) (P : X → V) (n : ℕ) :
    (conflictGraph K P).chromaticNumber ≤ n ↔
      ∃ side : X → Fin n, ∃ d, Decodes K P side d

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StochasticGraph.common_output_decoder_iff
statement:
theorem common_output_decoder_iff {X Y V C : Type*} [Nonempty V]

    (y : Y) (hy : ∀ x, 0 < K x y) :
    (∃ d, Decodes K P side d) ↔ ∀ x x', side x = side x' → P x = P x'

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StochasticGraph.cycle_positive

theorem cycle_positive (x y : Fin 5) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StochasticGraph.decoder_iff_coloring
statement:
theorem decoder_iff_coloring {X Y V C : Type*} [Nonempty V]

      ∀ ⦃x x'⦄, (conflictGraph K P).Adj x x' → side x ≠ side x'

label: full_support_repetition_decoder_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StochasticGraph.full_support_repetition_decoder_iff
statement:
theorem full_support_repetition_decoder_iff {X Y V C : Type*} [Nonempty Y] [Nonempty V]

      ∀ x x', side x = side x' → P x = P x'

statement:

theorem fullError_le_horizonErrorAll (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (g : List (A × Y) → Z) (n : ℕ) :

label: horizonErrorAll_eq
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StoppedHorizonError.horizonErrorAll_eq
statement:
theorem horizonErrorAll_eq (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (g : List (A × Y) → Z) (n : ℕ) :
    horizonErrorAll p g n = fullError p g + ∑ z, activeMass p n z - activeError p g n

label: horizonError_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.StoppedHorizonError.horizonError_le
statement:
theorem horizonError_le (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (g r : List (A × Y) → Z) (n : ℕ) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.budget_lower_of_terminalGapLimit_le
statement:
theorem budget_lower_of_terminalGapLimit_le
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (κ g budget : ℝ) (hk : 0 < κ)
    (hb : 0 ≤ budget)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ)
    (hcost : conditionalExtendedCost p ≤ ENNReal.ofReal budget)
    (hg : terminalGapLimit p ≤ g) :
    max (terminalEnvelope Z - g) 0 / κ ≤ budget

label: conditionalCost_mono
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.conditionalCost_mono
statement:
theorem conditionalCost_mono (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :
    Monotone (fun n => conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n))

label: conditionalInformation_increase_le_costIncrease
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.conditionalInformation_increase_le_costIncrease
statement:
theorem conditionalInformation_increase_le_costIncrease
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (κ : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ)
    (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    conditionalJointInfo p m (historyBank A Y m) -
        conditionalJointInfo p n (historyBank A Y n) ≤
      κ * (conditionalExpectedCost p m (historyBank A Y m) -
        conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n))

label: conditionalInformation_mono
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.conditionalInformation_mono
statement:
theorem conditionalInformation_mono (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.conditionalInformation_nonnegative
statement:
theorem conditionalInformation_nonnegative (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ conditionalJointInfo p n (historyBank A Y n)

label: continuation_cost_lower_of_terminalGap_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.continuation_cost_lower_of_terminalGap_le
statement:
theorem continuation_cost_lower_of_terminalGap_le
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (κ g : ℝ) (hk : 0 < κ)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ)
    (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m) (hg : terminalGap p m ≤ g) :
    max (terminalGap p n - g) 0 / κ ≤
      conditionalExpectedCost p m (historyBank A Y m) -
        conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n)

label: cost_lower_of_terminalGap_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.cost_lower_of_terminalGap_le
statement:
theorem cost_lower_of_terminalGap_le (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y)
    (n : ℕ) (κ g : ℝ) (hk : 0 < κ)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ)
    (hg : terminalGap p n ≤ g) :
    max (terminalEnvelope Z - g) 0 / κ ≤
      conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n)

label: entropy_eq_envelope_iff_uniform
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.entropy_eq_envelope_iff_uniform
statement:
theorem entropy_eq_envelope_iff_uniform [Nonempty Z] (q : FiniteLaw Z) :
    entropy q.mass = terminalEnvelope Z ↔ q.mass = uniformMass Z

label: extendedCost_bound_of_terminalGapLimit_le
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.extendedCost_bound_of_terminalGapLimit_le
statement:
theorem extendedCost_bound_of_terminalGapLimit_le
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (κ g : ℝ) (hk : 0 ≤ κ)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ)
    (hg : terminalGapLimit p ≤ g) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (max (terminalEnvelope Z - g) 0) ≤
      ENNReal.ofReal κ * conditionalExtendedCost p

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorEntropy_eq_joint_sub
statement:
theorem priorEntropy_eq_joint_sub (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :
    priorEntropy p = entropy p.initialJoint.mass - entropy p.initialRecord.mass

label: priorEntropy_le_envelope
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorEntropy_le_envelope
statement:
theorem priorEntropy_le_envelope [Nonempty Z] (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :

label: priorSlack_eq_weighted_deficits
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorSlack_eq_weighted_deficits
statement:
theorem priorSlack_eq_weighted_deficits (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :
    priorSlack p = ∑ u, p.initialRecord.mass u *
      (terminalEnvelope Z - entropy (p.given u).prior.mass)

label: priorSlack_le_terminalGap

statement:
theorem priorSlack_le_terminalGap (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (n : ℕ) :
    priorSlack p ≤ terminalGap p n

label: priorSlack_le_terminalGapLimit
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorSlack_le_terminalGapLimit
statement:
theorem priorSlack_le_terminalGapLimit (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :

label: priorSlack_nonnegative
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorSlack_nonnegative
statement:
theorem priorSlack_nonnegative [Nonempty Z] (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :

label: priorSlack_zero_iff_uniform
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorSlack_zero_iff_uniform
statement:
theorem priorSlack_zero_iff_uniform [Nonempty Z] (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) :
    priorSlack p = 0 ↔ ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u →
      (p.given u).prior.mass = uniformMass Z

label: priorSlack_zero_of_uniform
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.priorSlack_zero_of_uniform
statement:
theorem priorSlack_zero_of_uniform [Nonempty Z] (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y)
    (hu : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u →
      (p.given u).prior.mass = uniformMass Z) : priorSlack p = 0

label: protocolCapacitySlack_mono
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.protocolCapacitySlack_mono
statement:
theorem protocolCapacitySlack_mono (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (κ : ℝ)
    (hc : LocalCapacityBound p κ) :
    Monotone (fun n => κ * expectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n) -
      terminalMI p n (historyBank A Y n))

label: protocolInformation_increase_le_costIncrease
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCost.protocolInformation_increase_le_costIncrease
statement:
theorem protocolInformation_increase_le_costIncrease (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y)
    (κ : ℝ) (hc : LocalCapacityBound p κ) (n m : ℕ) (hnm : n ≤ m) :
    terminalMI p m (historyBank A Y m) - terminalMI p n (historyBank A Y n) ≤
      κ * (expectedCost p m (historyBank A Y m) -
        expectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n))

label: residualEntropy_nonnegative

theorem residualEntropy_nonnegative (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (n : ℕ) :

statement:

label: terminalGapLimit_extendedCost_bound

label: binary_terminalGap_bounds
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.binary_terminalGap_bounds
statement:
theorem binary_terminalGap_bounds (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Bool A Y)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (menu : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ActivePairMenu (p.given u) δ)
    (fair : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u →
      (p.given u).prior.mass = uniformMass Bool) (n : ℕ) :
    terminalGap p n = residualEntropy p n ∧
      max 0 (1 - binaryDiscriminationCapacity δ *
        conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n)) ≤ terminalGap p n

label: binary_terminalGap_price
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.binary_terminalGap_price
statement:
theorem binary_terminalGap_price (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Bool A Y)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (menu : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → ActivePairMenu (p.given u) δ)
    (n : ℕ) (g : ℝ) (hg : g < 1) (hgap : terminalGap p n ≤ g) :
    (1 - g) * Real.log 2 / δ ≤ (1 - g) / binaryDiscriminationCapacity δ ∧
      (1 - g) / binaryDiscriminationCapacity δ ≤
        conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n)

label: optimalGapCost_inverse_bounds
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.optimalGapCost_inverse_bounds
statement:
theorem optimalGapCost_inverse_bounds (menu : Set BinaryGapExperiment)
    (P Q : FiniteLaw Y) (δ a g η : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hg : g < 1) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hηg : Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤ g)
    (hd : a * δ ≤ BoundarySingularity.discrimination P.mass Q.mass)
    (cap : ∀ e ∈ menu, e.HasCap δ)
    (permitted : repeatGapExperiment P Q (repeatGapCount P Q η) ∈ menu) :
    0 < (1 - g) * Real.log 2 ∧
      0 < 4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / a + 1 ∧
      ((1 - g) * Real.log 2) / δ ≤ optimalGapCost menu g ∧
      optimalGapCost menu g ≤
        (4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / a + 1) / δ

label: optimalGapCost_le_repeat
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.optimalGapCost_le_repeat
statement:
theorem optimalGapCost_le_repeat (menu : Set BinaryGapExperiment) (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hd : 0 < BoundarySingularity.discrimination P.mass Q.mass)
    (g η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hηg : Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤ g)
    (permitted : repeatGapExperiment P Q (repeatGapCount P Q η) ∈ menu) :
    optimalGapCost menu g ≤ (repeatGapCount P Q η : ℝ)

label: optimalGapCost_lower
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.optimalGapCost_lower
statement:
theorem optimalGapCost_lower (menu : Set BinaryGapExperiment) (δ g : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hg : g < 1)
    (cap : ∀ e ∈ menu, e.HasCap δ) (hne : (binaryGapCosts menu g).Nonempty) :
    (1 - g) * Real.log 2 / δ ≤ optimalGapCost menu g

label: optimalGapCost_two_sided
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.optimalGapCost_two_sided
statement:
theorem optimalGapCost_two_sided (menu : Set BinaryGapExperiment)
    (P Q : FiniteLaw Y) (δ a g η : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hg : g < 1) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hηg : Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ≤ g)
    (hd : a * δ ≤ BoundarySingularity.discrimination P.mass Q.mass)
    (cap : ∀ e ∈ menu, e.HasCap δ)
    (permitted : repeatGapExperiment P Q (repeatGapCount P Q η) ∈ menu) :
    (1 - g) * Real.log 2 / δ ≤ optimalGapCost menu g ∧
      optimalGapCost menu g ≤
        ((⌈4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) / (a * δ)⌉₊ : ℕ) : ℝ)

label: paidDrop_card_bound

label: pairedRetainedInformation_increment_bounds
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.pairedRetainedInformation_increment_bounds
statement:
theorem pairedRetainedInformation_increment_bounds

label: repeatGap_target
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.repeatGap_target
statement:
theorem repeatGap_target (P Q : FiniteLaw Y)
    (hd : 0 < BoundarySingularity.discrimination P.mass Q.mass)
    (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η ≤ 1 / 2) :
    terminalGap (repeatGapProtocol P Q (repeatGapCount P Q η))
        (repeatGapCount P Q η) ≤ Real.binEntropy η / Real.log 2 ∧
      conditionalExpectedCost (repeatGapProtocol P Q (repeatGapCount P Q η))
        (repeatGapCount P Q η) (historyBank Unit Y (repeatGapCount P Q η)) =
          (repeatGapCount P Q η : ℝ) ∧
      (repeatGapCount P Q η : ℝ) ≤
        4 * Real.log (1 / (2 * η)) /
          BoundarySingularity.discrimination P.mass Q.mass + 1

label: retainedContinuationInformation_chain
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationInformation_chain
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationInformation_chain
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    conditionalJointInfo p n (historyBank A Y n) =
      conditionalJointInfo p m (historyBank A Y m) +
        retainedContinuationInformation p m n

label: retainedContinuationInformation_cost_bounds
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationInformation_cost_bounds
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationInformation_cost_bounds
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (κ : ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → LocalCapacityBound (p.given u) κ)
    (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    0 ≤ retainedContinuationInformation p m n ∧
      retainedContinuationInformation p m n ≤
        κ * (conditionalExpectedCost p n (historyBank A Y n) -
          conditionalExpectedCost p m (historyBank A Y m))

label: retainedContinuationInformation_eq_residual_sub
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationInformation_eq_residual_sub
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationInformation_eq_residual_sub
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    retainedContinuationInformation p m n = residualEntropy p m - residualEntropy p n

label: retainedContinuationMass_earlier_marginal
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationMass_earlier_marginal
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationMass_earlier_marginal
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    (u : H0) (z : Z) (g : historySet (A × Y) m) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n,
      retainedContinuationMass p m n u z g.val h) =
      conditionalStoppedMass p m u z g.val

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationMass_later_marginal
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationMass_later_marginal
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ)
    (u : H0) (z : Z) (h : List (A × Y)) :
    (∑ g ∈ historySet (A × Y) m, retainedContinuationMass p m n u z g h) =
      conditionalStoppedMass p n u z h

label: retainedContinuationMass_nonnegative
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationMass_nonnegative
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationMass_nonnegative
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ)
    (u : H0) (z : Z) (g h : List (A × Y)) :
    0 ≤ retainedContinuationMass p m n u z g h

label: retainedContinuationMass_total
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationMass_total
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationMass_total
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ) :
    (∑ u, ∑ z, ∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n,
      ∑ g ∈ historySet (A × Y) m, retainedContinuationMass p m n u z g h) = 1

label: retainedContinuationMass_uncertainty_marginal
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.retainedContinuationMass_uncertainty_marginal
statement:
theorem retainedContinuationMass_uncertainty_marginal
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ)
    (u : H0) (h : List (A × Y)) :
    (∑ g ∈ historySet (A × Y) m,
      massUncertainty (fun z => retainedContinuationMass p m n u z g h)) =
      massUncertainty (fun z => conditionalStoppedMass p n u z h)

label: silent_reset_control
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.silent_reset_control
statement:
theorem silent_reset_control :
    (∀ z, InstrumentLoss.silentErase.post z = false) ∧
      (∀ z, InstrumentLoss.silentErase.read z = ()) ∧
      entropy ResolutionAttainment.fairLaw.mass = 1 ∧
      entropy resetStateMass = 0 ∧ jointMI resetJointLaw.mass = 0 ∧
      (∑ rx : Unit × Bool, massUncertainty
        (fun z => resetJointMass z rx.1 rx.2)) = 1

label: stoppedMass_take_marginal
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.stoppedMass_take_marginal
statement:
theorem stoppedMass_take_marginal (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (z : Z)
    (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (g : historySet (A × Y) m) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n,
      if h.take m = g.val then stoppedMass p n z h else 0) =
      stoppedMass p m z g.val

label: stoppedMass_take_test
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.stoppedMass_take_test
statement:
theorem stoppedMass_take_test (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) (z : Z)
    (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (φ : List (A × Y) → ℝ) :
    (∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) n,
      stoppedMass p n z h * φ (h.take m)) =
    ∑ h ∈ historySet (A × Y) m, stoppedMass p m z h * φ h

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.task_count_change_with_retained_information
statement:
theorem task_count_change_with_retained_information
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (Lold Lnew : ℝ) :
    (Lold - conditionalJointInfo p m (historyBank A Y m)) -
      (Lnew - conditionalJointInfo p n (historyBank A Y n)) =
        (Lold - Lnew) + retainedContinuationInformation p m n

label: terminalGapLimit_eq_countable_logRatio

label: terminalGapLimit_eq_slack_add_transcript
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalGapLimit_eq_slack_add_transcript

theorem terminalGapLimit_eq_slack_add_transcript [Nonempty Z]

label: terminalGap_drop_eq_retainedInformation
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalGap_drop_eq_retainedInformation
statement:
theorem terminalGap_drop_eq_retainedInformation
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (m n : ℕ) (hmn : m ≤ n) :

label: terminalGap_eq_weighted_uniformRelativeEntropy_add_residual
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalGap_eq_weighted_uniformRelativeEntropy_add_residual
statement:
theorem terminalGap_eq_weighted_uniformRelativeEntropy_add_residual [Nonempty Z]
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (n : ℕ) :
    terminalGap p n =
      (∑ u, p.initialRecord.mass u * uniformRelativeEntropy (p.given u).prior) +
        residualEntropy p n

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalGap_finite_paid_events

label: terminalGap_task_change
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalGap_task_change
statement:
theorem terminalGap_task_change
    (old : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (new : ConditionalProtocol H1 Z1 A1 Y1)

    terminalGap old m - terminalGap new n =
      (terminalEnvelope Z - terminalEnvelope Z1) +

label: terminalGap_zero_iff_uniform_and_zero_residual
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalGap_zero_iff_uniform_and_zero_residual
statement:
theorem terminalGap_zero_iff_uniform_and_zero_residual [Nonempty Z]
    (p : ConditionalProtocol H0 Z A Y) (n : ℕ) :
    terminalGap p n = 0 ↔
      (∀ u, 0 < p.initialRecord.mass u → (p.given u).prior.mass = uniformMass Z) ∧
        residualEntropy p n = 0

label: terminalMI_horizon_one
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.terminalMI_horizon_one
statement:
theorem terminalMI_horizon_one (p : FiniteProtocol Z A Y) :
    terminalMI p 1 (historyBank A Y 1) =
      if p.stop [] = false then ∑ a, (p.policy []).mass a * localGain p [] a else 0

label: two_to_one_restriction_control
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.two_to_one_restriction_control
statement:
theorem two_to_one_restriction_control (n : ℕ) :
    Fintype.card Bool = 2 ∧ Fintype.card Unit = 1 ∧
      terminalGap (noReadingConditional ResolutionAttainment.fairLaw) n = 1 ∧
      terminalGap (noReadingConditional unitLaw) n = 0 ∧
      conditionalJointInfo (noReadingConditional ResolutionAttainment.fairLaw) n
        (historyBank Unit Unit n) = 0 ∧
      conditionalJointInfo (noReadingConditional unitLaw) n (historyBank Unit Unit n) = 0 ∧
      terminalGap (noReadingConditional ResolutionAttainment.fairLaw) n -
        terminalGap (noReadingConditional unitLaw) n = 1

label: uniformRelativeEntropy_eq_envelope_sub_entropy
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.uniformRelativeEntropy_eq_envelope_sub_entropy
statement:
theorem uniformRelativeEntropy_eq_envelope_sub_entropy [Nonempty Z] (q : FiniteLaw Z) :

label: uniformRelativeEntropy_eq_zero_iff_uniform
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.uniformRelativeEntropy_eq_zero_iff_uniform
statement:
theorem uniformRelativeEntropy_eq_zero_iff_uniform [Nonempty Z] (q : FiniteLaw Z) :

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.uniformRelativeEntropy_nonnegative

theorem uniformRelativeEntropy_nonnegative [Nonempty Z] (q : FiniteLaw Z) :

label: unitRecordProtocol_information

label: zeroSignalConditional_capacity

name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TerminalGapCostExtensions.zeroSignalConditional_control
statement:
theorem zeroSignalConditional_control :

      0 < historyMass (zeroSignalConditional.given ()) [] ∧
      (zeroSignalConditional.given ()).stop [] = false ∧
      0 < ((zeroSignalConditional.given ()).policy []).mass () ∧
      conditionalExpectedCost zeroSignalConditional 1 (historyBank Unit Bool 1) = 1 ∧
      priorSlack zeroSignalConditional = 0 ∧
      terminalGap zeroSignalConditional 1 = 1 ∧

label: independent_invariant_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TupleInvariants.independent_invariant_iff
statement:
theorem independent_invariant_iff {X Q I V : Type*} (q : X → Q) (F : (I → X) → V) :
    (∀ σ : I → Equiv.Perm X, (∀ i, σ i ∈ licenseStabilizer q) →
      ∀ a, F (fun i => σ i (a i)) = F a) ↔
      ∀ a b, (∀ i, q (a i) = q (b i)) → F a = F b

label: match_finite_tuple
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TupleInvariants.match_finite_tuple
statement:
theorem match_finite_tuple {X Q I : Type*} (q : X → Q) (a b : I → X) (S : Finset I)
    (hq : ∀ i ∈ S, q (a i) = q (b i))
    (heq : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ j ∈ S, a i = a j ↔ b i = b j) :
    ∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, ∀ i ∈ S, σ (a i) = b i

label: shared_reference_is_necessary
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TupleInvariants.shared_reference_is_necessary
statement:
theorem shared_reference_is_necessary {X Q : Type*} (q : X → Q) {x y : X}
    (hne : x ≠ y) (hq : q x = q y) :
    (∀ σ : Equiv.Perm X, σ x = σ y ↔ x = y) ∧
      ∃ σ τ : Equiv.Perm X, σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q ∧ τ ∈ licenseStabilizer q ∧
        σ x ≠ τ x

label: tuple_invariant_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TupleInvariants.tuple_invariant_iff
statement:
theorem tuple_invariant_iff {X Q I V : Type*} [Fintype I] (q : X → Q) (F : (I → X) → V) :
    (∀ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, ∀ a, F (σ ∘ a) = F a) ↔
      ∀ a b, (∀ i, q (a i) = q (b i)) →
        (∀ i j, a i = a j ↔ b i = b j) → F a = F b

label: tuple_orbit_iff
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryObserver.TupleInvariants.tuple_orbit_iff
statement:
theorem tuple_orbit_iff {X Q I : Type*} [Fintype I] (q : X → Q) (a b : I → X) :
    (∃ σ ∈ licenseStabilizer q, ∀ i, σ (a i) = b i) ↔
      (∀ i, q (a i) = q (b i)) ∧ (∀ i j, a i = a j ↔ b i = b j)

label: BoundaryOperatorData
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.BoundaryOperator.BoundaryOperatorData
statement:
structure BoundaryOperatorData (X : Type u) (Y : Type v) where
  domain : X → Prop
  apply : (x : X) → domain x → Y
  gauge_group : Type u
  gauge_struct : Group gauge_group
  gauge_action_X : gauge_group → X → X
  gauge_action_Y : gauge_group → Y → Y
  channel : Channel X Y
  Payload : Type v
  payload_extract : X → Payload
  floor_cost : (x : X) → domain x → CostValue
  cost_unit : ℝ
  cost_scale : ℝ
  partiality : ¬ ∀ x : X, domain x
  irreversibility :
    ∀ y : Y, ¬ ∃! xh : {x : X // domain x}, apply xh.1 xh.2 = y
  gaugeCovariance :
    ∀ g : gauge_group, ∀ x : X, ∀ h : domain x,
      ∀ h' : domain (gauge_action_X g x),
        apply (gauge_action_X g x) h' = gauge_action_Y g (apply x h)
  channelPreservation :
    ∀ x : X, ∀ h : domain x,
      channel.send x = some (apply x h)
  payloadDiscarding :
    ¬ ∃ recover : Y → Payload,
        ∀ xh : {x : X // domain x},
          recover (apply xh.1 xh.2) = payload_extract xh.1
  floorCost :
    ∀ x : X, ∀ h : domain x,
      cost_unit * cost_scale * Real.log 2 ≤ floor_cost x h

label: MissingAdapterStructure
name: OperatorKO7.ClosedCarrierSemanticsAdapters.MissingAdapterStructure
statement:
inductive MissingAdapterStructure : AdapterFamily → Prop
  /-- Absent: complete all-rule dependency-pair extraction together with SCC /
  processor soundness transporting the pair certificate to source termination.
  The available `DPPair` covers the `rec_succ` rule only, and the available
  fixed-system license closes source termination with the independent
  polynomial rank. -/
  | noCompleteExtractionAndProcessorSoundness :
      MissingAdapterStructure .dependencyPairProcessor
  /-- Absent: a well-founded target relation on `Trace` plus a source
  orientation theorem. The signature-transformation carrier records a
  non-identity signature change only. -/
  | signatureCarrierIncompatibilityOnly :
      MissingAdapterStructure .signatureTransformation
  /-- Absent: a deterministic well-founded target relation. The probabilistic
  carrier records distribution data only. -/
  | probabilisticCarrierIncompatibilityOnly :
      MissingAdapterStructure .probabilisticSubstrate
  /-- Absent: a single well-founded target relation on the combined substrate.
  The union carrier records a second component only. -/
  | unionCarrierIncompatibilityOnly :
      MissingAdapterStructure .unionHierarchySubstrate
  /-- Absent: any strict orientation field. The complexity-only carrier records
  a complexity conclusion with no orientation. -/
  | complexityCarrierIncompatibilityOnly :
      MissingAdapterStructure .complexityOnly

label: AdditiveCompositionalMeasure.eval
name: OperatorKO7.CompositionalImpossibility.AdditiveCompositionalMeasure.eval
statement:
@[simp] def AdditiveCompositionalMeasure.eval
    (M : AdditiveCompositionalMeasure) : Trace → Nat
  | void        => M.w_void
  | delta t     => M.w_delta + M.eval t
  | integrate t => M.w_integrate + M.eval t
  | merge a b   => M.w_merge + M.eval a + M.eval b
  | app a b     => M.w_app + M.eval a + M.eval b
  | recΔ b s n  => M.w_rec + M.eval b + M.eval s + M.eval n
  | eqW a b     => M.w_eq + M.eval a + M.eval b

label: AffineCompositionalMeasure.eval
name: OperatorKO7.CompositionalImpossibility.AffineCompositionalMeasure.eval
statement:
@[simp] def AffineCompositionalMeasure.eval
    (M : AffineCompositionalMeasure) : Trace → Nat
  | void        => M.c_void
  | delta t     => M.succ_bias + M.succ_scale * M.eval t
  | integrate t => M.int_bias + M.int_scale * M.eval t
  | merge a b   => M.merge_const + M.merge_left * M.eval a + M.merge_right * M.eval b
  | app a b     => M.app_const + M.app_left * M.eval a + M.app_right * M.eval b
  | recΔ b s n  => M.rec_const + M.rec_base * M.eval b + M.rec_step * M.eval s + M.rec_counter * M.eval n
  | eqW a b     => M.eq_const + M.eq_left * M.eval a + M.eq_right * M.eval b

@[simp] def CompositionalMeasure.eval (CM : CompositionalMeasure) : Trace → Nat
  | void        => CM.c_void
  | delta t     => CM.c_delta (CM.eval t)
  | integrate t => CM.c_integrate (CM.eval t)
  | merge a b   => CM.c_merge (CM.eval a) (CM.eval b)
  | app a b     => CM.c_app (CM.eval a) (CM.eval b)
  | recΔ b s n  => CM.c_recΔ (CM.eval b) (CM.eval s) (CM.eval n)
  | eqW a b     => CM.c_eqW (CM.eval a) (CM.eval b)

label: tau
name: OperatorKO7.MetaCM.tau
statement:
@[simp] def tau : Trace → Nat
| void            => 0
| delta t         => tau t
| integrate t     => 1 + tau t            -- baseIntegrate = 1
| merge a b       => 2 + tau a + tau b    -- baseMerge = 2
| app a b         => 1 + tau a + tau b    -- baseApp = 1
| recΔ b s n      => 3 + tau b + tau s + tau n  -- baseRec = 3
| eqW a b         => 4 + tau a + tau b

label: measure_decreases_safe_c
name: OperatorKO7.MetaCM.measure_decreases_safe_c
statement:
lemma measure_decreases_safe_c : ∀ {a b}, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep a b → Lex3c (mu3c b) (mu3c a)
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_int_delta t => by simpa using drop_R_int_delta_c t
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_merge_void_left t hδ => by simpa using drop_R_merge_void_left_c t hδ
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_merge_void_right t hδ => by simpa using drop_R_merge_void_right_c t hδ
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_merge_cancel t hδ h0 => by simpa using drop_R_merge_cancel_c t hδ h0
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_rec_zero b s hδ => by simpa using drop_R_rec_zero_c b s hδ
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_rec_succ b s n => by simpa using drop_R_rec_succ_c b s n
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_eq_refl a _h0 => by
    -- Guard redundant for τ; we provide an unguarded drop
    simpa using drop_R_eq_refl_c a
| _, _, MetaSN_KO7.SafeStep.R_eq_diff a b _ => by simpa using drop_R_eq_diff_c a b

label: freeConstructorFold
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.freeConstructorFold
statement:
def freeConstructorFold {α : Type}
    (z : α) (hs : α → α) (hw : α → α → α) (hr : α → α → α → α) :
    FreeTerm → α
  | .base => z
  | .succ t => hs (freeConstructorFold z hs hw hr t)
  | .wrap x y => hw (freeConstructorFold z hs hw hr x) (freeConstructorFold z hs hw hr y)
  | .recur b s n =>
      hr (freeConstructorFold z hs hw hr b)
        (freeConstructorFold z hs hw hr s)
        (freeConstructorFold z hs hw hr n)

label: ConservationBasedGeneratorEmitter
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.ConservationBasedGeneratorEmitter
statement:
structure ConservationBasedGeneratorEmitter
    (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T)
    extends FaithfulRecordEmitter Sys b s where
  project : Sys.T → Sys.T
  projectedRankFn : Sys.T → Nat
  projected_base : projectedRankFn Sys.base = 0
  projected_succ :
    ∀ t, projectedRankFn (Sys.succ t) = projectedRankFn t + 1
  projected_wrap :
    ∀ x y, projectedRankFn (Sys.wrap x y) = 0
  projected_recur :
    ∀ b s n, projectedRankFn (Sys.recur b s n) = projectedRankFn n
  conservation_at_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k →
      projectedRankFn (project (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i))
        + decodeRecord (recordObs (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i)) = k
  conservation_at_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      projectedRankFn (project (Sys.wrapChain s k b))
        + decodeRecord (recordObs (Sys.wrapChain s k b)) = k

label: ConstructorRecursor
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.ConstructorRecursor
statement:
structure ConstructorRecursor (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) where
  fold :
    {α : Type} →
      α →
      (α → α) →
      (α → α → α) →
      (α → α → α → α) →
      Sys.T → α
  fold_base :
    ∀ {α : Type} (z : α) (hs : α → α)
      (hw : α → α → α) (hr : α → α → α → α),
      fold z hs hw hr Sys.base = z
  fold_succ :
    ∀ {α : Type} (z : α) (hs : α → α)
      (hw : α → α → α) (hr : α → α → α → α) (t : Sys.T),
      fold z hs hw hr (Sys.succ t) = hs (fold z hs hw hr t)
  fold_wrap :
    ∀ {α : Type} (z : α) (hs : α → α)
      (hw : α → α → α) (hr : α → α → α → α) (x y : Sys.T),
      fold z hs hw hr (Sys.wrap x y) =
        hw (fold z hs hw hr x) (fold z hs hw hr y)
  fold_recur :
    ∀ {α : Type} (z : α) (hs : α → α)
      (hw : α → α → α) (hr : α → α → α → α) (b s n : Sys.T),
      fold z hs hw hr (Sys.recur b s n) =
        hr (fold z hs hw hr b) (fold z hs hw hr s) (fold z hs hw hr n)

statement:
structure FaithfulRecordEmitter (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T) where
  LiveObs : Type
  liveObsDecEq : DecidableEq LiveObs
  RecordObs : Type
  liveObs : Sys.T → LiveObs
  recordObs : Sys.T → RecordObs
  liveToken : LiveObs
  terminalToken : LiveObs
  decodeRecord : RecordObs → Nat
  live_at_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k → liveObs (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i) = liveToken
  live_at_terminal :
    ∀ k, liveObs (Sys.wrapChain s k b) = terminalToken
  live_token_ne_terminal : liveToken ≠ terminalToken
  decode_record_at_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k → decodeRecord (recordObs (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i)) = i
  decode_record_at_terminal :
    ∀ k, decodeRecord (recordObs (Sys.wrapChain s k b)) = k

label: GeneratorPreservingRecordEmitter
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.GeneratorPreservingRecordEmitter
statement:
structure GeneratorPreservingRecordEmitter
    (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T)
    extends FaithfulRecordEmitter Sys b s where
  project : Sys.T → Sys.T
  generatorCoord : Sys.T → Nat
  generator_base : generatorCoord Sys.base = 0
  generator_succ : ∀ t, generatorCoord (Sys.succ t) = generatorCoord t + 1
  generator_wrap : ∀ x y, generatorCoord (Sys.wrap x y) = 0
  generator_recur : ∀ b s n, generatorCoord (Sys.recur b s n) = generatorCoord n
  project_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k →
      generatorCoord (project (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i))
        = BaseDuplicatingSystem.trace_ctr k i
  project_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      generatorCoord (project (Sys.wrapChain s k b)) = 0

structure ProjectedGeneratorWitness
    (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T)
    extends FaithfulRecordEmitter Sys b s where
  project : Sys.T → Sys.T
  projectedRankFn : Sys.T → Nat
  projected_base : projectedRankFn Sys.base = 0
  projected_succ :
    ∀ t, projectedRankFn (Sys.succ t) = projectedRankFn t + 1
  projected_wrap :
    ∀ x y, projectedRankFn (Sys.wrap x y) = 0
  projected_recur :
    ∀ b s n, projectedRankFn (Sys.recur b s n) = projectedRankFn n
  project_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k →
      projectedRankFn (project (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i))
        = BaseDuplicatingSystem.trace_ctr k i
  project_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      projectedRankFn (project (Sys.wrapChain s k b)) = 0

statement:
structure ProjectiveRecordEmitter (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T)

  projectedRank : ProjectionRank Sys.toStepDuplicatingSchema
  project_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k →
      projectedRank.rank (project (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i))
        = BaseDuplicatingSystem.trace_ctr k i
  project_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      projectedRank.rank (project (Sys.wrapChain s k b)) = 0

label: RankLevelProjectionKernel
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.RankLevelProjectionKernel
statement:
structure RankLevelProjectionKernel (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) where
  project : Sys.T → Sys.T
  projectedRank : ProjectionRank Sys.toStepDuplicatingSchema
  projected_base : projectedRank.rank (project Sys.base) = 0
  projected_succ :
    ∀ t, projectedRank.rank (project (Sys.succ t))
      = projectedRank.rank (project t) + 1
  projected_wrap :
    ∀ x y, projectedRank.rank (project (Sys.wrap x y))
      = projectedRank.rank (project y)
  projected_recur :
    ∀ b s n, projectedRank.rank (project (Sys.recur b s n))
      = projectedRank.rank (project n)

structure RecordEmissionWitness (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T) where
  liveCoord : Sys.T → Nat
  recordCoord : Sys.T → Nat
  live_at_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k → liveCoord (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i) = 1
  record_at_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k → recordCoord (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i) = i
  live_at_terminal :
    ∀ k, liveCoord (Sys.wrapChain s k b) = 0
  record_at_terminal :
    ∀ k, recordCoord (Sys.wrapChain s k b) = k

    (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T)
    extends ConservationBasedGeneratorEmitter Sys b s where
  project_base : project Sys.base = Sys.base
  project_succ : ∀ t, project (Sys.succ t) = Sys.succ (project t)
  project_wrap : ∀ x y, project (Sys.wrap x y) = project y
  project_recur :

      Sys.recur (project b) (project s) (project n)

label: SemanticProjectionKernel
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.SemanticProjectionKernel
statement:
structure SemanticProjectionKernel (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) where
  project : Sys.T → Sys.T
  projectedRank : ProjectionRank Sys.toStepDuplicatingSchema
  project_base : project Sys.base = Sys.base
  project_succ : ∀ t, project (Sys.succ t) = Sys.succ (project t)
  /-- Wrapper payload is forgotten while the recursive continuation is kept. -/
  project_wrap : ∀ x y, project (Sys.wrap x y) = project y
  project_recur :
    ∀ b s n, project (Sys.recur b s n) =
      Sys.recur (project b) (project s) (project n)

label: StageIndexedConservationEmitter
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.StageIndexedConservationEmitter
statement:
structure StageIndexedConservationEmitter
    (Sys : BaseDuplicatingSystem) (b s : Sys.T)
    extends FaithfulRecordEmitter Sys b s where
  projectedStageCoord : Nat → Nat → Nat
  projectedTerminalCoord : Nat → Nat
  conservation_at_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k →
      projectedStageCoord k i
        + decodeRecord (recordObs (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i)) = k
  conservation_at_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      projectedTerminalCoord k
        + decodeRecord (recordObs (Sys.wrapChain s k b)) = k

label: CanonicalShadowConservationInterface
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.StageIndexedConservationEmitter.CanonicalShadowConservationInterface
statement:
structure CanonicalShadowConservationInterface where
  materialize : ShadowObservation → Sys.T
  projectedCoord : ShadowObservation → Nat
  recordCoord : ShadowObservation → Nat
  conservation_live :
    ∀ k i (hik : i ≤ k),
      projectedCoord (.live k i hik) + recordCoord (.live k i hik) = k
  conservation_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      projectedCoord (.terminal k) + recordCoord (.terminal k) = k
  projected_live :
    ∀ k i (hik : i ≤ k),
      projectedCoord (.live k i hik) = BaseDuplicatingSystem.trace_ctr k i
  projected_terminal :
    ∀ k, projectedCoord (.terminal k) = 0

label: Extension
name: OperatorKO7.StepDuplicating.StepDuplicatingSchema.BaseDuplicatingSystem.StageIndexedConservationEmitter.Extension

structure Extension
    (E : StageIndexedConservationEmitter Sys b s) where
  project : Sys.T → Sys.T
  projectedRankFn : Sys.T → Nat
  projected_base : projectedRankFn Sys.base = 0
  projected_succ :
    ∀ t, projectedRankFn (Sys.succ t) = projectedRankFn t + 1
  projected_wrap :
    ∀ x y, projectedRankFn (Sys.wrap x y) = 0
  projected_recur :
    ∀ b s n, projectedRankFn (Sys.recur b s n) = projectedRankFn n
  extends_canonical :
    ∀ k i, i ≤ k →
      projectedRankFn (project (Sys.canonicalTrace b s k i))
        = E.projectedStageCoord k i
  extends_terminal :
    ∀ k,
      projectedRankFn (project (Sys.wrapChain s k b))
        = E.projectedTerminalCoord k

label: confession_crossing_law
name: OperatorKO7.Meta.ConfessionCrossingPoint.confession_crossing_law
statement:
theorem confession_crossing_law (p licenseCost : Nat) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    crossingPoint p licenseCost hp ≤ licenseCost
      ∧ CarryExceedsConfess p licenseCost (crossingPoint p licenseCost hp)
      ∧ (∀ k, k < crossingPoint p licenseCost hp →
          ¬ CarryExceedsConfess p licenseCost k)
      ∧ (∀ k, CarryExceedsConfess p licenseCost k ↔
          crossingPoint p licenseCost hp ≤ k)
      ∧ (∀ b, BudgetDerived p licenseCost b hp →
          ∀ k, b ≤ k → CarryExceedsConfess p licenseCost k)
      ∧ (∀ k, ¬ CarryExceedsConfess 0 licenseCost k)

label: applyConstructorwiseFilter
name: OperatorKO7.ConfessionMethodFamily.applyConstructorwiseFilter
statement:
def applyConstructorwiseFilter (F : ConstructorwiseArgumentFilter) : Trace → Option FilteredCounterTerm
  | void => F.onBase
  | delta t => F.onSucc (applyConstructorwiseFilter F t)
  | integrate t => F.onIntegrate (applyConstructorwiseFilter F t)
  | merge x y => F.onMerge (applyConstructorwiseFilter F x) (applyConstructorwiseFilter F y)
  | app x y => F.onWrap (applyConstructorwiseFilter F x) (applyConstructorwiseFilter F y)
  | recΔ b s n =>
      F.onRecur
        (applyConstructorwiseFilter F b)
        (applyConstructorwiseFilter F s)
        (applyConstructorwiseFilter F n)
  | eqW x y => F.onEqW (applyConstructorwiseFilter F x) (applyConstructorwiseFilter F y)

  | recΔ _ _ n => argumentFilterTrace n

  filteredDupLhs :
    ∀ b s n,

        Option.map FilteredCounterTerm.succ (argumentFilterTrace n)
  filteredDupRhs :
    ∀ b s n,

  payloadErased :
    ∀ s n,

    ∀ b s n m,

      argumentFilterTrace (recΔ b s (delta n)) = some (FilteredCounterTerm.succ m)
      ∧ argumentFilterTrace (app s (recΔ b s n)) = some m
      ∧ FilteredCounterStep (FilteredCounterTerm.succ m) m

  | .universalConfessionCharacterization =>

  | .confessionCostFloor =>

        .theoremProjected,
        none,
        none⟩
  | .canonicalConfessionMinimizesDiscardedInformation =>
      ⟨.canonicalConfessionMinimizesDiscardedInformation,
        universalTheoremName .canonicalConfessionMinimizesDiscardedInformation,
        .theoremProjected,
        none,
        none⟩
  | .gaugeFixingIdentity =>
      ⟨.gaugeFixingIdentity,
        universalTheoremName .gaugeFixingIdentity,

label: SCTClosureSummary
name: OperatorKO7.ConfessionMethodFamily.SCTClosureSummary
statement:
structure SCTClosureSummary where
  compositeGraph : SizeChangeGraph 3
  compositeCounterDescent :
    compositeGraph.arcs ⟨2, by decide⟩ ⟨2, by decide⟩ = SCArc.strictDecrease
  compositeBaseNonIncreasing :
    compositeGraph.arcs ⟨0, by decide⟩ ⟨0, by decide⟩ = SCArc.nonIncreasing
  compositeStepNonIncreasing :
    compositeGraph.arcs ⟨1, by decide⟩ ⟨1, by decide⟩ = SCArc.nonIncreasing

label: SCTRouteEvidence
name: OperatorKO7.ConfessionMethodFamily.SCTRouteEvidence
statement:
structure SCTRouteEvidence where
  witness : SCTWitness
  descendingThread :
    witness.graph.arcs ⟨2, by decide⟩ ⟨2, by decide⟩ = SCArc.strictDecrease
  baseDiagonalNonIncreasing :
    witness.graph.arcs ⟨0, by decide⟩ ⟨0, by decide⟩ = SCArc.nonIncreasing
  stepDiagonalNonIncreasing :
    witness.graph.arcs ⟨1, by decide⟩ ⟨1, by decide⟩ = SCArc.nonIncreasing
  constantCounterThread :
    Nat → Fin 3
  constantCounterThread_is_counter :
    ∀ k, constantCounterThread k = ⟨2, by decide⟩
  thread_descends_at_every_step :
    ∀ k,
      witness.graph.arcs (constantCounterThread k) (constantCounterThread (k + 1)) =
        SCArc.strictDecrease
  closureSummary : SCTClosureSummary

label: confession_routes_converge
name: OperatorKO7.ConfessionMethodFamily.confession_routes_converge

theorem confession_routes_converge :
    schemaDPWitness.selectedCoordinate = ⟨2, by decide⟩
    ∧ schemaDirectCounterProjectionWitness.selectedCoordinate = ⟨2, by decide⟩
    ∧ (∀ i : Fin 3,
        schemaSCTWitness.graph.arcs i i = SCArc.strictDecrease →
        i = ⟨2, by omega⟩)
    ∧ schemaArgumentFilteringWitness.keepRecurCoordinate = ⟨2, by decide⟩
    ∧ counterProjectionConfession.rank = dpConfession.rank
    ∧ sctConfession.rank = dpConfession.rank
    ∧ argumentFilteringConfession.rank = dpConfession.rank

label: linearWeight
name: OperatorKO7.MetaConjectureBoundary.linearWeight
statement:
def linearWeight (c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq : Nat) : Trace → Nat
  | .void => c_void
  | .delta t => c_delta + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq t
  | .integrate t => c_int + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq t
  | .merge a b => c_merge + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq a + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq b
  | .app a b => c_app + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq a + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq b
  | .recΔ b s n => c_rec + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq b + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq s + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq n
  | .eqW a b => c_eq + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq a + linearWeight c_void c_delta c_int c_merge c_app c_rec c_eq b

label: nestingDepth
name: OperatorKO7.MetaConjectureBoundary.nestingDepth
statement:
@[simp] def nestingDepth : Trace → Nat
  | .void => 0
  | .delta t => nestingDepth t + 1
  | .integrate t => nestingDepth t + 1
  | .merge a b => max (nestingDepth a) (nestingDepth b)
  | .app a b => max (nestingDepth a) (nestingDepth b) + 1
  | .recΔ b s n => max (max (nestingDepth b) (nestingDepth s)) (nestingDepth n) + 1
  | .eqW a b => max (nestingDepth a) (nestingDepth b) + 1

label: nodeCount
name: OperatorKO7.MetaConjectureBoundary.nodeCount
statement:
@[simp] def nodeCount : Trace → Nat
  | .void => 1
  | .delta t => nodeCount t + 1
  | .integrate t => nodeCount t + 1
  | .merge a b => nodeCount a + nodeCount b + 1
  | .app a b => nodeCount a + nodeCount b + 1
  | .recΔ b s n => nodeCount b + nodeCount s + nodeCount n + 1
  | .eqW a b => nodeCount a + nodeCount b + 1

label: polyMul
name: OperatorKO7.MetaConjectureBoundary.polyMul
statement:
@[simp] def polyMul (w : Nat) : Trace → Nat
  | .void => w
  | .delta t => polyMul w t + 1
  | .integrate t => polyMul w t + 1
  | .merge a b => polyMul w a + polyMul w b
  | .app a b => polyMul w a + polyMul w b
  | .recΔ b s n => polyMul w b + polyMul w s * polyMul w n
  | .eqW a b => polyMul w a + polyMul w b

label: treeDepth
name: OperatorKO7.MetaConjectureBoundary.treeDepth
statement:
@[simp] def treeDepth : Trace → Nat
  | .void => 0
  | .delta t => treeDepth t + 1
  | .integrate t => treeDepth t + 1
  | .merge a b => max (treeDepth a) (treeDepth b) + 1
  | .app a b => max (treeDepth a) (treeDepth b) + 1
  | .recΔ b s n => max (max (treeDepth b) (treeDepth s)) (treeDepth n) + 1
  | .eqW a b => max (treeDepth a) (treeDepth b) + 1

      (notAdditive : ¬ ∃ c : Nat, ∀ b s n : Trace,
        PolyInterpretation.W (recΔ b s n) =
          c + PolyInterpretation.W b + PolyInterpretation.W s + PolyInterpretation.W n) →
      (notAffine : ¬ ∃ α β γ δ_r : Nat, ∀ b s n : Trace,
        PolyInterpretation.W (recΔ b s n) =
          α + β * PolyInterpretation.W b + γ * PolyInterpretation.W s +
            δ_r * PolyInterpretation.W n) →
      PermittedW1Import .globalPolynomial
  | importedWholeWitness :
      (witness : BenchmarkedPRCFamily.HasImportedWholeWitness BenchmarkedPRCFamily.fullDuplicating) →
      (notW0Direct : ¬ BenchmarkedPRCFamily.HasDirectWitness BenchmarkedPRCFamily.fullDuplicating) →
      PermittedW1Import .importedWholeWitness
  | transparencyEssentiality :
      (orientsStep : ∀ {a b : Trace}, Step a b → PolyInterpretation.W b < PolyInterpretation.W a) →
      (violatesTransparency : ¬ StepDuplicatingSchema.TransparentAtBase ko7Schema PolyInterpretation.W) →
      PermittedW1Import .transparencyEssentiality

  | .w1MPO => some mpo_w1_success

  | .w2FullLinear => some fullLinear_w2_success

name: OperatorKO7.ConstructionRouteCatalogPayload.fullDuplicating_route_payloads_separate_from_direct_search
statement:
theorem fullDuplicating_route_payloads_separate_from_direct_search :
    (canonicalWitnessW1Success? .w1ImportedWhole = some importedWhole_w1_success ∧
      importedWhole_w1_success.route ≠ .W0 ∧
      HasImportedWholeWitness fullDuplicating ∧
      ¬ HasDirectWitness fullDuplicating) ∧
      (canonicalWitnessW2Success? .w2FullDuplicating = some fullDuplicating_w2_success ∧
        fullDuplicating_w2_success.route ≠ .W0 ∧
        HasTransformedCallWitness fullDuplicating ∧
        ¬ HasDirectWitness fullDuplicating)

label: ctxFuel_decreases_ctx
name: MetaSN_KO7.ctxFuel_decreases_ctx
statement:
lemma ctxFuel_decreases_ctx : ∀ {a b : Trace}, SafeStepCtx a b → ctxFuel b < ctxFuel a
| _, _, SafeStepCtx.root hs => ctxFuel_decreases_safe hs
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.integrate t u h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel u < ctxFuel t := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    simpa [ctxFuel, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right ih 1)
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.mergeL a a' b h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel a' < ctxFuel a := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    simpa [ctxFuel, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right ih (ctxFuel b + 2))
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.mergeR a b b' h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel b' < ctxFuel b := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    have h₁ : ctxFuel a + ctxFuel b' < ctxFuel a + ctxFuel b := Nat.add_lt_add_left ih (ctxFuel a)
    simpa [ctxFuel, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right h₁ 2)
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.appL a a' b h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel a' < ctxFuel a := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    simpa [ctxFuel, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right ih (ctxFuel b + 1))
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.appR a b b' h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel b' < ctxFuel b := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    have h₁ : ctxFuel a + ctxFuel b' < ctxFuel a + ctxFuel b := Nat.add_lt_add_left ih (ctxFuel a)
    simpa [ctxFuel, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right h₁ 1)
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.recB b b' s n h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel b' < ctxFuel b := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    let C : Nat := 2 ^ (ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s + 5)
    have h₁ : C + ctxFuel b' < C + ctxFuel b := Nat.add_lt_add_left ih C
    simpa [ctxFuel, C, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right h₁ 1)
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.recS b s s' n h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel s' < ctxFuel s := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    let E' : Nat := ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s' + 5
    let E : Nat := ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s + 5
    have hExp : E' < E := by
      have h₁ : ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s' < ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s := Nat.add_lt_add_left ih (ctxFuel n)
      simpa [E', E] using Nat.add_lt_add_right h₁ 5
    have hPow : 2 ^ E' < 2 ^ E := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right one_lt_two_nat hExp
    simpa [ctxFuel, E', E, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right hPow (ctxFuel b + 1))
| _, _, @SafeStepCtx.recN b s n n' h => by
    have ih : ctxFuel n' < ctxFuel n := ctxFuel_decreases_ctx h
    let E' : Nat := ctxFuel n' + ctxFuel s + 5
    let E : Nat := ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s + 5
    have hExp : E' < E := by
      have h₁ : ctxFuel n' + ctxFuel s < ctxFuel n + ctxFuel s := Nat.add_lt_add_right ih (ctxFuel s)
      simpa [E', E] using Nat.add_lt_add_right h₁ 5
    have hPow : 2 ^ E' < 2 ^ E := Nat.pow_lt_pow_right one_lt_two_nat hExp
    simpa [ctxFuel, E', E, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using
      (Nat.add_lt_add_right hPow (ctxFuel b + 1))

label: ctxFuel_decreases_safe
name: MetaSN_KO7.ctxFuel_decreases_safe
statement:
lemma ctxFuel_decreases_safe : ∀ {a b : Trace}, SafeStep a b → ctxFuel b < ctxFuel a
| _, _, SafeStep.R_int_delta t => by
    simp [ctxFuel]
| _, _, SafeStep.R_merge_void_left t _ => by
    simp [ctxFuel]
| _, _, SafeStep.R_merge_void_right t _ => by
    simp [ctxFuel]
| _, _, SafeStep.R_merge_cancel t _ _ => by
    simp [ctxFuel]
    omega
| _, _, SafeStep.R_rec_zero b s _ => by
    have h₁ : ctxFuel b < ctxFuel b + 1 := Nat.lt_succ_self (ctxFuel b)
    have h₂ : ctxFuel b + 1 ≤ 2 ^ (ctxFuel s + 5) + (ctxFuel b + 1) := Nat.le_add_left _ _
    have h₃ : ctxFuel b < 2 ^ (ctxFuel s + 5) + (ctxFuel b + 1) := lt_of_lt_of_le h₁ h₂
    simpa [ctxFuel, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using h₃
| _, _, SafeStep.R_rec_succ b s n => by
    simpa [ctxFuel] using ctxFuel_rec_succ_drop b s n
| _, _, SafeStep.R_eq_refl a _ => by
    simp [ctxFuel]
| _, _, SafeStep.R_eq_diff a b _ => by
    simp [ctxFuel]

inductive StepCtxFull : Trace → Trace → Prop
| root {a b : Trace} : Step a b → StepCtxFull a b
| delta {t u : Trace} : StepCtxFull t u → StepCtxFull (delta t) (delta u)
| integrate {t u : Trace} : StepCtxFull t u → StepCtxFull (integrate t) (integrate u)
| mergeL {a a' b : Trace} : StepCtxFull a a' → StepCtxFull (merge a b) (merge a' b)
| mergeR {a b b' : Trace} : StepCtxFull b b' → StepCtxFull (merge a b) (merge a b')
| appL {a a' b : Trace} : StepCtxFull a a' → StepCtxFull (app a b) (app a' b)
| appR {a b b' : Trace} : StepCtxFull b b' → StepCtxFull (app a b) (app a b')
| recB {b b' s n : Trace} : StepCtxFull b b' → StepCtxFull (recΔ b s n) (recΔ b' s n)
| recS {b s s' n : Trace} : StepCtxFull s s' → StepCtxFull (recΔ b s n) (recΔ b s' n)
| recN {b s n n' : Trace} : StepCtxFull n n' → StepCtxFull (recΔ b s n) (recΔ b s n')
| eqWL {a a' b : Trace} : StepCtxFull a a' → StepCtxFull (eqW a b) (eqW a' b)
| eqWR {a b b' : Trace} : StepCtxFull b b' → StepCtxFull (eqW a b) (eqW a b')

label: W_orients_stepCtxFull
name: MetaSN_KO7.W_orients_stepCtxFull
statement:
theorem W_orients_stepCtxFull : ∀ {a b : Trace}, StepCtxFull a b → W b < W a
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.root h => W_orients_step h
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.delta h => by
      simpa [W] using Nat.succ_lt_succ (W_orients_stepCtxFull h)
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.integrate h => by
      simpa [W] using Nat.succ_lt_succ (W_orients_stepCtxFull h)
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.mergeL h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      omega
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.mergeR h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      omega
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.appL h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      omega
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.appR h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      omega
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.recB (s := s) (n := n) h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      have hs : 1 ≤ W s := W_pos s
      have hn : 1 ≤ W n := W_pos n
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      nlinarith
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.recS (b := b) (n := n) h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      have hb : 1 ≤ W b := W_pos b
      have hn : 1 ≤ W n := W_pos n
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      nlinarith
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.recN (b := b) (s := s) h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      have hb : 1 ≤ W b := W_pos b
      have hs : 1 ≤ W s := W_pos s
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      nlinarith
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.eqWL h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      omega
  | _, _, StepCtxFull.eqWR h => by
      have hh := W_orients_stepCtxFull h
      simp only [W] at hh ⊢
      omega

@[simp] def copyBudget : Trace → Nat
| void            => 0
| delta t         => copyBudget t + 1
| integrate t     => copyBudget t
| merge a b       => max (copyBudget a) (copyBudget b)
| app a b         => max (copyBudget a) (copyBudget b)
| recΔ b s n      => max (copyBudget b) (max (copyBudget s) (copyBudget n))
| eqW a b         => max (copyBudget a) (copyBudget b)

| void            => 0
| delta t         => ctxDupPotential t
| integrate t     => ctxDupPotential t + 1
| merge a b       => ctxDupPotential a + ctxDupPotential b + 1
| app a b         => ctxDupPotential a + ctxDupPotential b
| recΔ b s n      =>
    ctxDupPotential b +
      ctxDupPotential n +
      (copyBudget n + 1) * (ctxDupPotential s + 1) + 1
| eqW a b         => ctxDupPotential a + ctxDupPotential b + 3
